Method: 提出Mixture of Layers（MoL）方法，基于文本查询在视觉编码器的不同中间层之间动态分配路由权重，通过top-k稀疏聚合机制在图像级、补丁级或混合模式下选择最相关的隐藏状态，实现查询条件下的层间特征融合。

Abstract: Pre-trained vision encoders contain layer-wise visual representations that differ in spatial granularity, semantic abstraction, and sensitivity to local details. However, most Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) rely on only the final or penultimate vision encoder representations or fixed aggregation rules, making visual abstraction largely query-agnostic and limiting access to fine-grained cues such as small objects, spatial details, text, and subtle visual attributes. In this work, we propose Mixture of Layers (MoL), an instruction-conditioned layer routing approach at the visual patch level that dynamically aggregates query-relevant latent representations from intermediate vision encoder layers. Given a text query, MoL predicts routing probabilities over vision encoder layers and performs a top-k sparse aggregation over selected hidden states at either the image level, patch level, or through a hybrid routing mechanism. In doing so, MoL enables query-adaptive access to layer-specific visual features for fine-grained visual reasoning. Our experiments across 7 fine-grained visual reasoning tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements, especially across fine-grained visual grounding and understanding tasks such as +18.9% improvement on V* in overall accuracy, +4.5% on HRBench4K, and +16.3% on CharXiv compared to the baseline MLLMs, without resorting to multi-resolution inputs, simple interleaving of multiple vision encoders, or increasing the number of patch tokens. Abstract: Microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) and high tumor mutational burden (TMB-H) are clinically relevant biomarkers, yet their histopathological prediction remains challenging when models are transferred across morphologically distinct cancer types. To address this limitation, we propose TIRA (Tumor Immune Representation Adaptation), a target-free framework that refines frozen foundation-model representations using spatial immune topology, without requiring target-domain data during model development or test-time adaptation. TIRA uses a topology-supervised biology representation to condition tile-level attention while pooling only morphological features for joint MSI and TMB prediction. Abstract: Forecasting future 3D occupancy from surround-view cameras is essential for autonomous driving, yet existing approaches rely on dense voxel or bird's-eye-view representations whose cost grows rapidly with spatial resolution and prediction horizon. Because these representations do not explicitly maintain object identities, they also struggle to preserve instance consistency over time. We present LighTROcc, a lightweight instance-centric framework that represents movable objects with a compact set of learned queries and predicts present and future occupancy in a single forward pass. LighTROcc localizes each query through attention-guided forward lifting, combining image-space cross-attention, query-specific depth, and camera geometry to estimate its 3D center. Each instance is modeled as a mixture of anisotropic 3D Gaussians and propagated across future steps using predicted displacements, producing continuous, temporally consistent occupancy forecasts. Experiments on nuScenes and supplemented nuScenes-Occupancy show that LighTROcc outperforms the evaluated dense and instance-wise baselines in instance-level forecasting accuracy while maintaining strong voxel-level occupancy quality. Across different model configurations, LighTROcc achieves a favorable balance between forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency, demonstrating the potential of compact instance-centric modeling for camera-based 4D occupancy forecasting.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于CLIP的方法在零样本中文字符识别中依赖单一全局图像-汉字构形描述序列（IDS）相似性，忽视了部件的空间布局信息，且隐式学习的特征难以泛化至未见类别；此外，全局匹配虽能召回正确字符但常无法将其排在首位，尤其在仅存在细微局部差异的字符间表现不佳。

Method: 提出全局到局部两阶段框架：1）STG-CLIP在IDS中引入显式的树位置与部件级几何先验，生成空间感知原型，增强跨类别一致性，提升全局检索召回率；2）设计Radical Verification Module（RVM），以候选字符的部件实例为查询，匹配输入字形中空间上兼容的区域，结合边距门控机制，在主候选相似度接近时激活验证，优化排名精度。

Conclusion: 本文提出的全局到局部两阶段框架有效解决了传统方法在空间布局建模与未见类别泛化方面的缺陷，通过显式几何先验与可选的部件级验证机制，实现了更高精度的零样本中文字符识别，为未来基于结构理解的视觉-语言对齐任务提供了新思路。

Abstract: Zero-shot Chinese character recognition (ZS-CCR) aims to recognize characters whose categories are never observed during training, and typically relies on the compositional structure shared between seen and unseen characters. Recent CLIP-style methods represent this structure with the Ideographic Description Sequence (IDS) and align it with glyph images in a shared embedding space. However, they rely on a single global image--IDS similarity that discards the spatial layout of radicals and, being learned only implicitly from seen classes, generalizes poorly to unseen ones; moreover, global matching often retrieves the correct character within the top candidates yet fails to rank it first when characters differ only in subtle local radicals. To address these issues, we propose a global-to-local two-stage framework. In the first stage, STG-CLIP augments the IDS with explicit tree-position and radical-level geometric priors, yielding a spatial-aware prototype that provides a consistent spatial description across seen and unseen categories for high-recall global retrieval. In the second stage, the Radical Verification Module (RVM) uses the radical instances of each retrieved candidate as queries to verify whether the corresponding radicals can be matched to spatially compatible regions in the input glyph. A margin-based gating rule activates the RVM only when the leading global candidates receive similar similarity scores. Experiments on the ICDAR2013 benchmark demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance under the character-level zero-shot setting, obtaining 83.06% top-1 accuracy with 2,755 seen classes. Ablation studies further show that the explicit geometric priors and radical-level verification provide complementary improvements.

</details>


### [58] [Iris-3B: Going Beyond the Latent with Pixel-Space Diffusion Training, Conversion and Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09450)
*Hanqiu Li Cai,Chema Garabito*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了像素空间扩散模型在细粒度任务中的表现，通过预训练30亿参数的Iris-3B像素空间文本到图像Transformer，并将预训练的潜空间模型FLUX.2 Klein转换为像素空间进行对比。实验表明，在单目深度估计和图像恢复/超分辨率任务中，像素空间模型并未显著优于潜空间模型。尽管如此，Iris-3B展示了像素空间预训练可扩展至30亿参数并达到与潜空间模型相当的生成质量，且在1024²分辨率下性能匹配Qwen-Image。作者公开了模型权重和代码以推动后续研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证像素空间扩散模型是否在需要精细细节的下游任务中具有优势，避免潜空间模型中损失严重的VAE环节。

Method: 采用从256→512→1024的课程学习方式预训练Iris-3B（3B参数）像素空间文本到图像变压器；同时将预训练的潜空间模型FLUX.2 Klein base 4B转换为像素空间；在单目深度估计和图像恢复/超分辨率任务上对两类模型进行微调比较。

Result: 在深度估计和4倍超分辨率任务中，像素空间模型未表现出显著优势，甚至部分落后于潜空间模型。但Iris-3B在1024²分辨率下生成质量与潜空间模型相当，且可扩展至30亿参数规模。

Conclusion: 尽管像素空间模型在当前实验中未带来性能提升，但其可扩展性与生成质量已证明具备潜力，未来工作值得继续探索。作者公开资源以促进该领域发展。

Abstract: Pixel-space diffusion models avoid the lossy VAE of latent models, which suggests an advantage on downstream tasks where fine-grained detail matters. We test this claim along both routes to a pixel-space backbone. We pretrain Iris-3B, a 3B-parameter pixel-space text-to-image transformer, from scratch through a $256\to512\to1024$ curriculum, after first ablating the prediction target and representation alignment at $256^2$ to decide what to scale. We also convert a pretrained latent model, FLUX.2 Klein base 4B, to pixel space. We fine-tune both families for monocular depth estimation and for image restoration/super-resolution. We find no significant improvement from using a pixel-space generative prior. Fine-tuned for depth with one matched direct-regression recipe, Iris-3B is level with the latent FLUX.2 Klein and the converted pixel FLUX.2 Klein falls behind it, and on $4\times$ DIV2K restoration neither pixel model beats a latent FLUX.2 Klein fine-tune, the converted one trailing it slightly. We document the recipes, the failure modes and the remaining confounds behind this negative result. Nevertheless, Iris-3B shows that pixel-space pretraining with the pixel-transformer (PiT) head of PixelDiT scales to 3B parameters and to text-to-image quality competitive with latent models, matching Qwen-Image on OneIG under the official evaluators at $1024^2$. We release its weights and training code in the hope that they help pave the way for further work on pixel-space generation.

</details>


### [59] [RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09455)
*Seungjun Moon,Subin Jeon,Sangwoo Kim,Hanbyul Joo,Jinwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RLHND，一种基于视频基础模型的手部跟踪模型，联合估计单目视角视频中的手部姿态和真实的触觉信息。通过干净潜在条件化将预训练的Cosmos 3视频扩散主干转为确定性片段级特征提取器，保留了对手部运动和手物交互的先验知识。在姿态估计方面，预测解剖学上合理的关节角度，并可选地对形状参数进行条件控制以保持同一视频甚至同演员不同视频间的手形一致性。触觉估计方面，独立的触觉专家流在姿态流冻结的情况下预测手表面密集接触与受力情况。采用基于LBS的特征传播实现无需高成本逐顶点注意力的顶点级特征提取。在多个基准数据集上达到最先进的姿态估计性能，并在接触与力估计方面也达到先进水平。通过重定向结果和真实机器人实验展示了其在机器人学习中的实用性。代码将公开于https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在从裁剪帧中回归手部姿态时缺乏对手部运动和物体交互的先验知识，导致估计不准确且物理上不一致；同时缺少物理线索如接触和力，限制了人类视频在机器人策略训练中的应用。

Method: 使用预训练的Cosmos 3视频扩散模型作为主干，通过干净潜在条件化将其转换为确定性片段级特征提取器；设计姿态估计分支，预测解剖合理关节角并支持形状参数条件控制；引入独立触觉专家流，冻结姿态流后训练以预测密集接触与力；采用基于LBS的特征传播机制，实现高效顶点级特征提取。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，姿态估计性能达到当前最优；触觉估计（接触与力）同样达到领先水平；通过重定向结果和真实机器人实验验证了其在机器人学习中的有效性。

Conclusion: RLHND成功实现了从单目视角视频中联合估计精确手部姿态与真实触觉信息，显著提升了手部跟踪的物理一致性与可用性，为基于人类视频的机器人策略训练提供了有力支持。

Abstract: Recently, approaches that leverage human video datasets for robot policy training have become increasingly prevalent. However, most existing hand trackers regress pose from cropped frames with limited priors on hand motion and object interaction, resulting in inaccurate and physically inconsistent estimates. Moreover, the lack of physical cues, e.g., contact and force, limits the use of human videos for robot policy training. To this end, we propose RLHND, a video foundation model-based hand tracking model that jointly estimates hand pose and realistic tactile information from monocular egocentric videos. RLHND turns the pre-trained Cosmos 3 video diffusion backbone into a deterministic clip-level feature extractor via clean-latent conditioning, carrying its learned priors on hand motion and hand-object interaction into tracking. For pose estimation, RLHND (i) predicts hand poses with anatomically plausible joint angles and (ii) enables optional conditioning on the shape parameter to maintain consistent hand shape within the same video and even across videos recorded by the same actor. For tactile estimation, a separate tactile expert stream, trained with the pose stream frozen, predicts dense contact and force over the hand surface. We further adopt LBS-based feature spreading to enable vertex-wise feature extraction without costly per-vertex attention. RLHND achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmark datasets for pose estimation, while also achieving state-of-the-art performance in contact and force estimation. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of RLHND for robot learning through retargeting results and real-world robot experiments. The code will be publicly available at https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/.

</details>


### [60] [An Invariant Tangent-Angle Descriptor and a Band U-Net for 2D Fragment Adjacency Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09459)
*Guillaume Brouillette,Alain Goupil,Pierre-Olivier Parisé,Fadel Touré*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究改进了贝勒克在硕士论文中提出的两阶段架构，通过使用切线角轮廓对比替代原有的图像窗口局部评分，实现了对碎片旋转不变性和起始点无关性。同时，用带状U-Net取代原模型的分类器，以同时输出共享弧段和配对决策。在合成数据集上，新方法表现优于或等同于原有方法；在真实数据上的PairingNet基准测试中，达到0.93 AUC和0.82 Recall@10，显著优于原始方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提高2D碎片邻接预测的准确性与鲁棒性，解决原方法对旋转敏感及起始点依赖的问题，并增强模型在真实场景下的泛化能力。

Method: 采用切线角轮廓对比作为局部特征描述符，实现旋转不变性；引入一维卷积模型或训练自由似然比进行匹配评分；使用带状U-Net进行带状区域分割与分类，联合输出邻接关系与共享弧段。

Result: 在合成数据集上性能持平或超越原方法；在真实数据的PairingNet基准测试中，达到98%准确率（原为93%-95%），AUC达0.93，Recall@10提升至0.82，显著优于原模型。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于切线角轮廓与带状U-Net的新方法在邻接预测任务中表现出更高的精度、鲁棒性和泛化能力，尤其在真实数据上具有显著优势，且无需额外训练即可适用于新场景。

Abstract: This paper addresses the prediction of adjacency between pairs of 2D fragments based on their contours. We improved the two-stage architecture proposed in Beaulac's thesis, in which a rotation-equivariant Siamese convolutional neural network scores pairs of local image windows along the two contours of two fragments. The scores are gathered in an adjacency matrix in which a ResNet detects the partial anti-diagonal band that reveals the adjacency of two fragments. In the current work, we keep the pipeline and replace the local score by a comparison of tangent-angle profiles of contour windows, making it, by construction, invariant to fragment rotation and agnostic to the selected contour-starting point. These adaptations may be either a training-free likelihood ratio or a small one-dimensional convolutional model trained on corresponding points. We also replaced the final classifier by a band U-Net that segments the band and classifies the pair, so that the shared arc is obtained along with the decision. In the synthetic data set of the original thesis, the tangent descriptor performs as well as or better than the image-window approach in all tested configurations. The proposed pipeline reaches an accuracy of 98%, vs 93% to 95% for the original approach once its evaluation is corrected. We tested our pipeline, with models trained only on synthetic data, on the PairingNet benchmark, and obtained an AUC of 0.93. Furthermore, under the PairingNet pair-searching protocol conditions, our learned descriptor obtains a Recall@10 of 0.82 on the real set against 0.56 from the best model of the original paper.

</details>


### [61] [InstanceBench: Diagnosing Referential Reasoning and Target Identity in Referring Expression Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09478)
*Yuchen Li,Shaoyang Zhou,Yiran Wang,Ruiyi Deng,Haoyu Wang,Ziru Wei,Zhen Zhao,Luping Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出InstanceBench诊断基准，针对参考表达分割（RES）中的实例级推理问题，通过6,194张图像、9,264个目标实例和25,077条人工验证表达，系统评估不同参照逻辑下的目标保持能力，并分离选择与掩码生成错误。使用身份感知指标与逻辑分类体系，揭示模型主要瓶颈在目标选择而非掩码生成，且可通过针对性监督提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准评估无法区分参照逻辑、测试目标在多种有效定位路径中的保留情况，也难以分离目标选择与掩码生成错误，限制了对实例级参照推理的深入理解。

Method: 构建以目标为中心的表达集（TCES），固定图像和目标掩码，配对最小表达与同目标但使用不同有效线索的变体；设计紧凑的参照逻辑分类体系（包括直接证据、同类别选择、关系与复合定位、排除等）；采用逻辑关键构造抑制简单捷径；引入身份感知指标衡量目标保留率与整体成功度。

Result: 22个主流模型中最强者达67.1% mIoU，但仅59.6% All@0.7；控制实验表明语言敏感性显著，失败分解显示目标选择是主要瓶颈；在受控训练子集上，匹配监督可提升身份感知性能。

Conclusion: InstanceBench支持‘测量-诊断-改进’循环：量化目标在不同定位路径中的一致性，定位失败根源，并评估针对性干预效果，推动更可靠、可解释的参考表达分割模型发展。

Abstract: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) links natural-language descriptions to pixel-level object masks. Yet standard evaluation provides limited insight into instance-level referential reasoning: it does not systematically distinguish referential logics, test target preservation across valid grounding paths, or separate target-selection from mask-generation errors. We introduce InstanceBench, an instance-centered diagnostic benchmark comprising 6,194 images, 9,264 target instances, and 25,077 human-verified expressions. Each target-centric expression set (TCES) fixes the image and target mask while pairing a minimal expression with a same-target variant that uses another valid cue or grounding path. A compact referential-logic taxonomy spans direct target evidence, same-class selection, relational and compositional grounding, and exclusion, while logic-critical construction suppresses simpler shortcuts. Identity-aware metrics measure target retention and set-level success while separating selection from mask-generation errors. Across 22 native-mask RES checkpoints from 18 model families, the strongest checkpoint reaches 67.1% mIoU but only 59.6% All@0.7. Controlled interventions confirm language sensitivity, while failure decomposition identifies target selection rather than mask decoding as the main bottleneck. On a controlled training subset, matched supervision improves identity-aware performance, showing that the diagnosed capability responds to targeted supervision. Collectively, InstanceBench supports a measure-diagnose-improve cycle: measuring target consistency across grounding paths, localizing failure sources, and evaluating targeted interventions.

</details>


### [62] [Gaussian Material Fields for Volumetric Multi-Energy CT Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09492)
*Jian Lin,Jiancheng Fang,Hongming Shan,Shaoyu Wang,Yang Chen,Qiegen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为高斯材料场的新方法，用于多能CT中的体积材料分解。该方法通过共享的各向异性3D高斯基元和独立的非负材料系数来表示多个材料分布，实现空间几何与材料组成的联合优化。引入了面向材料的自适应密度控制，以保留材料特异性细节并动态调整局部表示能力。在15个合成数据集上，相比最强基线，平均PSNR提升4.03 dB，SSIM提升4.96%，NRMSE降低33.45%。结果表明该方法在结构恢复、计算效率和可扩展性方面均表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以在共同空间域中有效组织多材料三维分布，同时保持成分差异和局部结构特征。需要一种既能共享空间结构又能适应材料特异性重建需求的表示方式。

Method: 提出高斯材料场，利用共享的各向异性3D高斯基元作为连续空间基，结合独立的非负系数表示各材料分布；设计可微分的光谱前向模型，整合高斯路径积分与校准基矩阵，支持联合优化；引入材料感知的自适应密度控制机制，动态调节局部表示容量。

Result: 在15个合成案例中，平均PSNR提高4.03 dB，SSIM提高4.96%，NRMSE降低33.45%；材料级对比和消融实验验证了对局部结构的更好恢复能力；运行时间和内存消耗显示良好的计算可扩展性。

Conclusion: 高斯材料场是一种显式且自适应的体积多材料重建表示方法，能够有效平衡空间一致性与材料特异性，在精度和效率上显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Volumetric material decomposition in multi-energy computed tomography requires a representation that organizes multiple three-dimensional material fields in a common spatial domain while retaining differences in composition and local structure. We observe that spatial primitives can be shared across materials without tying their coefficients, but their local capacity must respond to material-specific reconstruction needs. We introduce Gaussian material fields, which represent multiple material distributions with shared anisotropic 3D Gaussian primitives and independent nonnegative material coefficients. The shared geometry defines a continuous spatial basis, while the coefficients determine each primitive's contribution to the individual material fields. To reconstruct this representation from multi-energy projections, a differentiable spectral forward model combines Gaussian material path integrals with a calibrated basis matrix, enabling joint optimization of spatial geometry and material composition. Material-aware adaptive density control retains material-specific refinement evidence before aggregation and adjusts local representation capacity to accommodate both spatially extensive components and sparse details. Experiments use synthesized multi-energy projections generated from pseudo-reference material maps constructed by conventional methods from publicly available CT data. Across 15 cases, our approach improves average PSNR by 4.03 dB and SSIM by 4.96% over the strongest baseline, while reducing NRMSE by 33.45%. Material-wise comparisons and component ablations support improved recovery of localized structures, while runtime and memory measurements show favorable computational scaling. These results establish Gaussian material fields as an explicit, adaptive representation for volumetric multi-material reconstruction.

</details>


### [63] [SpatialUQ: Post-Hoc Uncertainty Quantification from Spatial Consistency in Black-Box Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09498)
*Md Kawsher Mahbub,Milon Biswas,Mirza Niaz Morshed,Wei Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpatialUQ 是一种仅使用输出概率的后处理不确定性估计方法，通过计算全局预测与五个固定空间裁剪区域平均预测之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度来衡量空间一致性。该方法在 NIH ChestX-ray14 数据集上以五分之一的计算成本实现了 0.784 的失败检测 AUC，优于 MC-Dropout（0.664），且具有更好的校准性（SCE=0.049）。结合熵、置信度和 ℓ₁ 的监督融合进一步提升至 0.832，超过五成员集成。MUS 随模型性能提升，但在严重分布外情况下失效，对小病灶如结节不敏感。代码公开可用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床视觉模型常以冻结黑盒形式部署，缺乏内部访问、重训练或推理时真实标签，因此需要一种无需额外训练、仅依赖输出概率的后处理不确定性估计方法，以提升模型可靠性与可解释性。

Method: SpatialUQ 采用六次确定性前向传播：一次全图预测与五次固定空间裁剪区域的预测，计算全局预测与裁剪区域均值之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度，构建多裁剪不确定性分数（MUS），基于‘可信预测应具有空间一致性’的假设。

Result: 在 NIH ChestX-ray14 上，MUS 达到 0.784 的失败检测 AUC，显著优于 MC-Dropout（0.664，p<10⁻⁶），且计算成本仅为其五分之一；具备良好校准性（SCE=0.049）；融合多指标后达到 0.832，超越五成员集成（0.813）；在 BiomedCLIP 上达 0.899，但严重分布偏移下相关性下降（VinBigData，ρ=0.027）。

Conclusion: SpatialUQ 是一种高效、可部署的后处理不确定性估计方法，适用于临床视觉模型，尤其在模型质量高时表现优异，但对小焦点病变效果有限，且在极端分布外场景下可靠性下降。

Abstract: Clinical vision models are often deployed as frozen black boxes with no access to internals, retraining, or ground truth at inference time. We introduce \textbf{SpatialUQ}, a post-hoc uncertainty method using only output probabilities. It measures the Jensen-Shannon divergence between the global prediction and the mean of five fixed spatial crops in six deterministic forward passes. The premise is simple, trustworthy predictions are spatially consistent. On NIH ChestX-ray14 (DenseNet-121, $N{=}25{,}596$), our Multicrop Uncertainty Score (MUS) reaches $0.784$ failure-detection AUC versus $0.664$ for MC-Dropout ($p{<}10^{-6}$) at one-fifth the compute, with native calibration ($\text{SCE}{=}0.049$ vs.\ $0.127$ for $\ell_1$), the best-calibrated among methods above 0.78 AUC. A supervised fusion of MUS with entropy, confidence, and $\ell_1$ reaches $0.832$, outperforming a five-member ensemble ($0.813$). MUS scales with model quality, reaching $0.899$ with BiomedCLIP ($ρ= 0.846$), while this relationship remains meaningful in-distribution ($ρ= 0.523$) but breaks down under severe distribution shift (VinBigData, $ρ= 0.027$). MUS is well-suited to diffuse findings but is less dependable for small focal lesions such as nodules. Code and experimental materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kawsher11/SpatialUQ.

</details>


### [64] [RT-DETR-World: Transferring Rich LLM Semantics to Real-Time Open-Vocabulary Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09502)
*Yupeng Zhang,Ziyi Zhao,Juntao Cheng,Sheng Wang,Ningnan Guo,Ruize Han,Liang Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RT-DETR-World，一种轻量级DETR风格的开放词汇检测模型，通过多层级语义监督与双路径描述对齐（DDA）和关系感知负样本松弛（RNR）提升零样本泛化能力，在保持实时效率的同时实现强泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实时开放词汇检测方法在词汇覆盖和高效匹配方面表现良好，但在严格效率约束下难以吸收丰富的实例语义和场景上下文信息，因此需要一种既能保留轻量化设计又能有效利用训练时语义监督的方法。

Method: 构建GroundingCapv2多层级监督数据集，包含类别名、对象描述和图像描述；引入双路径描述对齐（DDA），结合部署一致的MiniLM路径与仅训练用的LLM教师模型，分别实现查询-类别监督、对象描述对齐以及全局视觉表征对齐；采用关系感知负样本松弛（RNR），利用教师模型生成的语义相似度动态放松相关负样本。

Result: 实验表明，RT-DETR-World在零样本检测任务中达到有竞争力的准确率，并在准确率与效率之间取得良好平衡，且所有教师模块在训练后移除，不影响推理效率。

Conclusion: RT-DETR-World通过有效的语义迁移机制，在保持轻量级结构的前提下显著提升了开放词汇检测的零样本泛化能力，为实时高效通用检测提供了新思路。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) recognizes categories unseen during training through textual category queries, yet achieving strong generalization with real-time efficiency remains challenging. Beyond vocabulary scaling, zero-shot generalization may benefit from reusable visual--semantic cues learned from seen data, including attributes, actions, states, and contextual relations. Existing real-time OVD methods primarily emphasize vocabulary coverage and efficient region/query--text matching; under strict efficiency constraints, compact detectors may struggle to absorb rich instance semantics and scene context. We propose RT-DETR-World, a compact DETR-style detector that transfers the rich semantics conveyed by descriptions during training while retaining lightweight query--text matching at inference. We construct GroundingCapv2 with three levels of supervision: category names for standard OVD, object descriptions conveying instance-level semantics, and image descriptions conveying object relations and scene context. These descriptions serve only as training-time semantic supervision. To help the compact detector absorb these semantics, we propose Dual-Path Description Alignment (DDA), combining a deployment-consistent MiniLM pathway with a training-only LLM teacher. MiniLM provides query--category supervision and object-description alignment, while offline teacher features supervise matched queries and global visual representations at the object and image levels, respectively. All teacher features are precomputed, and the teacher-side modules are removed after training. We further propose Relation-Aware Negative Relaxation (RNR), which uses teacher-derived semantic similarities to relax related negatives while preserving exact positives. Experiments demonstrate competitive zero-shot accuracy and a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off. The code will be released.

</details>


### [65] [TERRA: Learning Transportable Latent Actions through Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09509)
*Tianxingjian Ding,Mubarak Shah,Yu Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TERRA introduces a method to improve robot policy learning by using latent actions derived from visual transitions. It addresses two key challenges: preserving meaningful temporal effects while avoiding noise, and ensuring that learned actions remain consistent across different contexts. TERRA represents transitions via a compact temporal effect combining net feature change and low-order dynamics, then uses Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) to align these effects across different initial states. This enables more robust and transferable action representations. The approach outperforms UniVLA and a LAPA-style baseline in accuracy, resilience to visual distractors, and faithful transition transport, achieving 93.4% success on LIBERO.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing methods for learning robot policies from visual transitions struggle with balancing the retention of meaningful motion information against nuisance variations and ensuring action consistency across different contexts. Reconstruction-based approaches fail to address how a latent code's meaning changes when reused in new states. This work aims to resolve both issues by grounding action representations in invariant temporal effects and enabling context-aware alignment.

Method: TERRA models transitions using a compact temporal effect—capturing net feature change and low-order within-window dynamics—and learns a continuous latent space based on this effect. Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) decodes latents in new initial states while anchoring their effect to the original observed effect, ensuring consistency across contexts. Frozen linear readers are used for action prediction.

Result: TERRA achieves higher action prediction accuracy than UniVLA and a LAPA-style baseline, shows better robustness under visual distractors, maintains faithful transition transport even as context distance increases, and attains 93.4% average success on LIBERO at matched pretraining scale—outperforming UniVLA's 91.8%. A control experiment confirms that most gains stem from EAT.

Conclusion: TERRA demonstrates that modeling transitions through invariant temporal effects and using effect-anchored transport enables more accurate, robust, and transferable robot policies. The integration of EAT is critical for performance gains, showing that context-aware alignment of action semantics significantly improves generalization.

Abstract: Latent actions supervise robot policies with action-like codes inferred from visual transitions, and their usefulness hinges on two questions: what a code keeps from a transition, and whether it still means the same thing when reused in a different initial state. The first is a tension in time: an endpoint difference discards how motion unfolds, while the full sequence admits nuisance variation. The second is left open by reconstruction, which only ever observes a latent together with the state it came from. We argue that both questions can be answered in the same place. TERRA (Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment) describes a transition by a compact temporal effect, its net feature change together with a low-order within-window dynamics component, and learns a continuous latent from this effect. The same effect space then serves as the reference for reuse: Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) decodes a latent in other initial states and anchors the resulting effect to the one observed at its source, so that the latent is shaped by what it does across contexts rather than only by the transition it came from. With frozen linear readers, TERRA predicts actions more accurately than UniVLA and a LAPA-style baseline, degrades more slowly under visual distractors, and keeps transported transitions faithful to the donor action as the recipient context moves farther away; a same-budget control shows that these gains come largely from EAT. At matched pretraining scale, the complete system reaches 93.4% average success on LIBERO, compared with 91.8% for UniVLA.

</details>


### [66] [LiG-DETR: Local-in-Global Reassembly in Latent Space for Aerial Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09511)
*Yupeng Zhang,Fangzhuo Gao,Juntao Cheng,Ziyi Zhao,Liang Wan,Ruize Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LiG-DETR框架，通过高保真局部特征获取与全局重装配，解决航拍目标检测中尺度和密度变化带来的特征退化问题。结合上下文感知选择性重装配与密度自适应查询分配，实现高效端到端检测，在小中目标上显著提升性能，同时保持大目标表现并改善跨域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在航拍目标检测中面临小目标易被下采样和特征压缩破坏、大目标需全局上下文的问题；图像切片虽提供清晰局部信息但依赖独立预测与后处理，而特征/查询级优化则基于已压缩表示，难以恢复细粒度信息。因此亟需一种能在特征退化前直接获取高保真局部证据，并融入统一端到端框架的方法。

Method: 提出LiG-DETR框架，利用共享编码器提取全局与局部放大特征，将其投影至检测器特征空间，再按原始空间位置重装配形成全局对齐的局部特征层；使用单个DETR解码器联合解码全局与局部特征；引入上下文保留的选择性重装配以减少冗余计算，以及密度感知的自适应查询分配以优化解码器查询预算。

Result: 在小目标和中等目标上取得显著性能提升，大目标性能保持良好，具备优良的准确率-效率权衡，并增强了跨域泛化能力。

Conclusion: LiG-DETR成功实现了在特征退化前获取高保真局部证据并融合到统一检测框架中，为复杂航拍场景下的目标检测提供了有效解决方案。代码将公开发布。

Abstract: Aerial object detection faces substantial scale and density variations. Small objects are easily degraded by downsampling and feature compression, while medium and large objects require sufficient global context. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: image slicing provides clearer local evidence but relies on independent crop-level prediction and post-processing, whereas feature- and query-level optimization preserves unified inference but operates on already compressed full-image representations, limiting recovery of fine-grained information. This raises a key question: can aerial detection directly acquire high-fidelity local evidence before feature degradation and integrate it into a unified end-to-end framework? To this end, we propose LiG-DETR, an Efficient Global-Local Reassembly framework that reformulates image slicing as high-fidelity local feature acquisition. A shared encoder extracts global and locally magnified features, which are projected into the detector feature space. The projected local features are reassembled according to their original spatial locations to form a globally aligned local feature level, and a single DETR decoder jointly decodes global and local features. To reduce redundant computation, Context-Preserved Selective Reassembly focuses high-resolution encoding on informative regions while preserving a dense feature layout, and Density-Aware Adaptive Query Allocation adapts the decoder query budget using encoder proposal scores. Experiments show substantial gains on small and medium objects while retaining strong large-object performance, with favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-offs and improved cross-domain generalization. The code will be released.

</details>


### [67] [OmniCam: Omni-Camera Trajectory Generation via Geometry-Grounded Pose Token Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09513)
*Zhenyang Liu,Chenjie Cao,Yisu Zhang,Xuhui Zuo,Xiangyang Xue,Yanwei Fu,Tengfei Wang,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniCam 是一个自回归模型，能够从单个全景图和文本轨迹描述中生成相机位姿序列。它通过全景点云编码器获取全方位几何上下文，采用混合绝对旋转与相对平移的标记化方式，并保持四元数符号的时间一致性。模型还设计了独立的几何与语义条件流以及显式的3D目标锚点。研究构建了包含26.77万条轨迹的 OmniCaT 数据集。在 OmniCaT 评估中，OmniCam 相较于重新训练的 GenDoP，轨迹误差降低 28–47%，碰撞率下降 65.8%；相比各指标最优基线，ATE 降低 43.0%，碰撞率降低 62.3%。消融实验验证了几何与目标感知条件的有效性，下游实验展示了其在视频生成与机器人主动感知中的应用潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在从语言生成相机轨迹时，难以同时兼顾场景几何结构与目标导向的构图需求。为实现更精确、自然的视角控制，需要一种能融合几何信息与语义目标的相机轨迹生成模型。

Method: OmniCam 采用自回归框架，结合全景点云编码器提取几何上下文；使用混合绝对旋转与相对平移的标记化策略，并确保四元数符号的时间一致性；引入分离的几何与语义条件流，辅以显式3D目标锚点，增强对目标的关注与空间定位能力。

Result: 在 OmniCaT 数据集上，OmniCam 显著降低轨迹误差（28–47%）和碰撞率（65.8%），相较最优基线，ATE 减少 43.0%，碰撞率减少 62.3%。消融实验表明几何与目标感知条件对性能至关重要。下游任务如视频生成与机器人感知也表现出良好效果。

Conclusion: OmniCam 有效实现了从语言与全景图生成高质量、目标导向且几何一致的相机轨迹，显著提升生成精度与安全性，具备在视频生成、场景重建与机器人感知等领域的广泛应用前景。

Abstract: Camera trajectories control viewpoint changes in video generation, scene reconstruction, and robotic perception. Generating them from language requires both scene geometry and target-aware framing. We introduce OmniCam, an autoregressive model that generates camera pose sequences from a single panorama and textual trajectory descriptions. Its geometry-grounded pose token learning combines three components: a panoramic point-cloud encoder for omnidirectional geometric context; hybrid absolute-rotation and relative-translation tokenization with temporally consistent quaternion signs; and separate geometric and semantic conditioning streams with an explicit 3D target anchor. We also construct OmniCaT, containing 267,700 trajectories across four camera behaviors. On the reported OmniCaT evaluation, OmniCam reduces trajectory errors by 28--47% and collision rate by 65.8% relative to GenDoP retrained on OmniCaT. Against the best baseline for each metric, the ATE and collision reductions are 43.0% and 62.3%, respectively. Component ablations support the use of geometric and target-aware conditioning, while downstream experiments examine camera-controlled video generation and robotic active perception.

</details>


### [68] [STRIKE: Learning Visual State Transitions for Physical World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09514)
*Wenbin Teng,Tianshuo Xu,Depu Meng,Yuelei Li,Quentin Herau,Yihan Hu,Yajie Zhao,Wei Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STRIKE是一种分离视觉状态转换学习与密集视频生成的框架，通过事件对齐监督学习物理场景的动态变化。它利用图像、局部转换描述和时间偏移来预测下一场景配置，并结合预训练的视觉-语言规划器与递归状态转换模型生成未来视觉状态序列，再由动态模型生成完整视频。在多个物理世界建模基准测试中，STRIKE在物理一致性与操作视频保真度上均优于基线方法，验证了视觉状态转换作为有效中间表示的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法多关注生成连贯运动，但缺乏对物理交互如何改变场景的准确建模。本文旨在通过学习视觉状态间的物理转变，提升对复杂物理动态的建模能力。

Method: 构建事件对齐的监督信号，使用图像、时间偏移与转换描述作为输入；训练一个基于图像的过渡模型以预测下一状态；结合预训练的视觉-语言规划器生成时间转换规范，递归应用过渡模型生成状态序列；最后用独立训练的动态模型生成完整视频。

Result: 在Physics-IQ Verified、PhyGenBench、Pisa-Experiments和RoboTwin2.0等多个数据集上，STRIKE在物理一致性与视频生成质量方面显著优于视频骨干基线模型，证明其有效性。

Conclusion: 学习视觉状态转换作为中间表示，能够有效支持物理世界建模，为未来视频生成与物理推理提供了新范式。

Abstract: Physical world modeling requires predicting how interactions change a scene, not merely generating coherent motion. We propose STRIKE, a framework that separates visual state transition learning from dense video generation. We construct event-aligned supervision by extracting observed states from training videos and pairing them with transition descriptions and temporal offsets. An image-based transition model learns to predict the next scene configuration from the current image, a local transition specification, and elapsed time. At inference, a pretrained vision-language planner predicts time transition specifications, and recursive application of the learned transition model produces a sequence of future visual states. A separately trained dynamic model then generates the complete rollout conditioned on these states and their temporal locations. Experiments on Physics-IQ Verified, PhyGenBench, Pisa-Experiments, and RoboTwin2.0 show improvements of STRIKE over the corresponding video-backbone baselines in benchmark measures of physical consistency and manipulation-video fidelity. These results support learned visual state transitions as an effective intermediate representation for physical world modeling.

</details>


### [69] [It Is Not Seeing the Hazard: A Frozen Vision-Language Safety Score Measures Its Caption Bank](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09517)
*Samuel Tetteh,Cody Fleming*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种受控评估方法，检验冻结的CLIP提示-边缘安全评分在强化学习中的安全性信号有效性。通过对比有无该评分的策略轨迹、匹配接触前后的场景观测，并改变描述文本、编码器和摄像头视角，发现该评分在接触前约20步下降，但其变化主要反映与提示的相似性而非真实危险感知。恒定置信度对照实验表明，政策提升并不证明其具备危险感知能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的安全信号假设图像与危险语言描述的相似性即代表危险本身，但缺乏对这些信号是否真正反映危险还是仅依赖于提示结构、嵌入几何或相机视角的验证。这导致安全信号的有效性存疑，亟需更严谨的评估方法。

Method: 采用受控实验设计，包括：1）使用未接收该安全评分的策略生成轨迹；2）将接触前与无接触的观测进行几何匹配；3）系统性地改变提示文本、编码器和摄像头视角；4）分析安全评分随时间的变化模式及机制影响因素。

Result: 安全评分在接触前约20步出现下降趋势，但其变化主要受提示文本间的分离度和摄像头视角的影响，与共享场景内容相关。恒定置信度控制下仍保持较低灾难率估计值，说明政策性能提升不能证明其具备真正的危险感知能力。

Conclusion: 现有基于冻结CLIP的安全评分虽在基准测试中表现良好，但其有效性可能源于提示设计与环境特征的共现，而非对真实危险的感知。因此，应谨慎解读其在安全强化学习中的应用效果，并加强机制可解释性验证。

Abstract: Frozen vision-language models increasingly provide safety signals for reinforcement learning. Their use assumes that similarity to language describing danger indicates the hazard itself. Yet policy return and collision rate cannot reveal whether a score detects hazards or responds to correlated features of the scene. VLM-based methods have reported gains in driving and safe-RL benchmarks by converting image-text similarity into rewards, costs, or confidence weights. Such signals promise to reduce reliance on manually designed feedback. They may also reflect prompt structure, embedding geometry, or camera viewpoint, leaving their safety meaning unverified. To address this gap, we present a controlled evaluation of a frozen CLIP prompt-margin safety score. We apply the score to trajectories generated by policies that never receive it, match pre-contact observations to contact-free observations with comparable hazard geometry, and vary the captions, encoder, and camera view. Across three policies, 180 episodes, and 130 isolated contact onsets, the score decreases for about twenty steps before contact. Mechanism controls indicate that the score mainly tracks resemblance to the scene shared by its captions and changes with caption separation and camera view. A constant-confidence control retains the lower catastrophe-rate point estimate, so policy gains do not establish hazard perception.

</details>


### [70] [ActiveLang: Active Open-Vocabulary 3D Mapping with Semantic-Uncertainty-Guided Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09518)
*Liyan Chen,Hairong Yin,Huangying Zhan,Yi Xu,Raymond A. Yeh,Philippos Mordohai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ActiveLang是一种用于主动开放词汇3D建图的自主系统，通过语义不确定性引导探索，实现在线语言特征适应，在紧凑的双高斯表示上联合重建场景几何、外观和开放词汇语义，具有较低的内存开销。其规划器能高效选择信息丰富的视角，减少观测次数和计算成本。在Replica和ScanNet++上的实验表明，与在线和离线基线相比，该方法在2D和3D开放词汇分割任务中均有显著提升，证明主动探索能更高效地构建语言标注的3D地图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在陌生环境中执行新任务时，需要具备对环境的几何和语义理解能力，且无法提前知晓相关概念。因此，需要一种支持开放词汇场景理解的语言标注3D地图系统，以促进人机交互。

Method: 提出ActiveLang系统，采用紧凑的双高斯表示进行在线语言特征适应，联合重建场景几何、外观和开放词汇语义；通过语义不确定性引导的规划器选择最有信息量的观测视角，实现高效探索与建图。

Result: 在Replica和ScanNet++数据集上的实验显示，ActiveLang在2D和3D开放词汇分割任务中均优于现有在线和离线基线方法，显著提升了建图效率和语义理解能力。

Conclusion: 主动探索结合语义不确定性引导的规划策略，能够更高效地构建语言标注的3D地图，显著提升开放词汇场景理解能力，适用于复杂、未知环境中的机器人自主操作。

Abstract: As robots increasingly assist humans with diverse tasks, they need both geometric and semantic understanding of their surroundings. Moreover, robots often operate in unfamiliar environments and take on new tasks without knowing the relevant concepts ahead of time. This motivates language-annotated 3D maps that support open-vocabulary scene understanding and human-robot interaction. We introduce ActiveLang, an autonomous system for active open-vocabulary 3D mapping with semantic-uncertainty-guided exploration. ActiveLang performs online language-feature adaptation on a compact dual-Gaussian representation to jointly reconstruct scene geometry, appearance, and open-vocabulary semantics with modest memory overhead. Its planner efficiently selects informative viewpoints, enabling effective mapping with fewer observations and lower computational cost. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ demonstrate substantial improvements in 2D and 3D open-vocabulary segmentation over both online and offline baselines, highlighting that actively exploring scenes builds language-annotated 3D maps more efficiently.

</details>


### [71] [KASALv2: Fully Automatic 3D Rotational Symmetry Classification and Axis Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09534)
*Mengxin Zhang,Yulin Wang,Chen Luo,Yongzhe Li,Yijun Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种完全自动、无需参考的框架，用于对3D物体的8种标准旋转对称类型进行分类、识别旋转阶数并定位完整对称轴。该方法通过自洽性分析定位主导高阶轴，并重建完整的对称结构，同时引入纹理感知扩展以建模外观引起的旋转阶数降低。在理想和真实数据集上实验验证了其高精度与强泛化能力，在GSO数据集上达到94.75%准确率；将这些先验知识用于训练FoundationPose，使五个BOP数据集上的6D姿态估计精度提升最高达0.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前3D物体的旋转对称性标注主要依赖人工或半自动方式，需预定义类型或阶数，难以扩展。亟需一种全自动、无需参考的对称性分析方法以支持更广泛的应用。

Method: 提出一种层次引导的框架，首先定位主导高阶旋转轴，通过自洽性分析推断其旋转阶数，并重建完整的对称结构；进一步引入纹理感知模块，建模外观导致的旋转阶数降低，同时保持轴方向不变。

Result: 在438个对称物体的GSO数据集上达到94.75%的对称类型分类准确率；使用该框架生成的对称先验训练FoundationPose，在五个BOP数据集上平均提升0.9%的姿态估计精度，表明自动估计的旋转先验可有效提升下游任务性能。

Conclusion: 本工作实现了全自动化、无参考的3D旋转对称性分析，具备良好的准确性与泛化能力，显著提升了6D姿态估计的性能，为对称性建模提供了可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Rotational symmetry is an important prior in 6D pose estimation, improving pose accuracy and supporting symmetry-aware evaluation. However, current symmetry annotations for 3D objects remain largely manual or semi-automatic, often requiring predefined types or orders, which limits scalability. This work introduces a fully automatic, reference-free framework for symmetry-type classification, rotational-order identification, and full-axis localization across all eight canonical 3D rotational symmetry types. The method localizes a dominant high-order axis, infers its rotational order through self-consistency analysis, and reconstructs the complete symmetry structure under a hierarchy-guided formulation. A texture-aware extension further models appearance-induced reductions in rotational order while preserving axis orientations. Experiments on idealized and real-world datasets demonstrate strong accuracy and generalization, achieving 94.75% accuracy on 438 symmetric objects in GSO. Training FoundationPose with these priors improves accuracy by up to 0.9% across five BOP datasets, showing that automatically estimated rotational priors improve downstream 6D pose estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/KASAL.

</details>


### [72] [WAPR: A Foundation Model for Wide-Angle Refinement in Unseen Object Pose Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09535)
*Yulin Wang,Mengting Hu,Hongli Li,Jianghao Zhou,Chen Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WAPR是一个零样本广角姿态精炼模型，能够在仅12个候选姿态的情况下实现每帧1秒内的快速推理，支持每秒25个物体实例的位姿估计吞吐量。它通过旋转对称性先验对称等价姿态目标进行归一化，并结合大规模数据集SA6D（包含约50K增强物体实例和200万渲染的RGB-D图像）进行训练。角度平衡损失提升了不同角度范围下的学习稳定性。在七个BOP核心数据集上，WAPR在未见物体的6D姿态定位与检测任务中均达到当前最优性能，适用于快速与非约束推理场景。

  <summary>Details</summary>

In addition, an angle-balanced loss stabilizes learning across different angular ranges by reducing the influence of uninformative large-error cases. Experiments on seven BOP core datasets show that WAPR achieves state-of-the-art performance in unseen-object 6D pose localization and detection under both fast and unconstrained inference settings.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Trajectory optimisation for cone-beam computed tomography (CT) determines which information sparse-view scans acquire. Fixed candidate pools prevent off-grid refinement and require new object-specific precomputation for each acquisition manifold. We make every source pose an individual continuous variable and move all poses jointly by gradient ascent on the scanner's kinematic manifold. The objective combines soft-Tuy plane coverage, continuous View Covariance Loss, and an analytic attenuation-aware ray-bundle penalty. The same optimiser handles circular, limited C-arm, two-axis, and freesphere parametrisations. On a Defrise flange, continuous selection recovers laminar defects invisible to a circular orbit, matches discrete swap search on the free sphere at the sparser budget, and leads at the denser one, with the same objective evaluated in every arm. A moderate elevation band already recovers most of the free-sphere gain at the defects, so the same optimiser transfers to bounded scanner envelopes. Photon noise preserves the ordering on the flange and compresses it on a dense fuel nozzle. Sparseprescan planning benefits from matching prescan and planned acquisition manifolds. Selection takes seconds rather than minutes without an object-specific reconstruction basis. Prescan-planned poses were executed on a robot CT bench and reconstructed in a common frame, demonstrating feasibility but no consistent metric gain over uniform band sampling. Continuous pose optimisation incorporates attenuation and scanner constraints directly into sparse-view acquisition design.

Abstract: Uterine contractions in fetal MRI are typically identified manually and discarded, limiting insights into contraction dynamics. We formalize Uterine Contractile Activity Detection (UCAD) as a weakly-supervised learning problem and introduce STORK, a multi-instance learning model trained on dynamic MRI series using only coarse, series-level labels. STORK factorizes 3D spatio-temporal convolutions into parallel branches across temporal hyperplanes to capture coherent tissue motion without the cost of full 4D convolutions. Per-frame embeddings, combining intensity and Demons-estimated displacement fields, are aggregated by a linear mean-pooling head. This ensures that frame-level contraction scores can be recovered post-hoc without frame-level training supervision. Evaluated on around 700 multi-vendor dynamic fetal MRI series, STORK achieves a series-level AUROC of 95.0% and AUPRC of 94.6%, substantially outperforming 3D ResNet and ConvNeXt baselines. Grad-CAM analysis suggests that the model draws on predictive features extending beyond the placenta into the uterine tissue, offering an automated tool for richer phenotyping of uterine behavior.

TL;DR: 本文提出HAPPEN，一种用于审计全国家级T1加权脑部MRI数据仓库中身份重复问题的人机协作流水线。该方法结合SHA-256指纹识别精确重复项，并利用监督对比检索潜在非相同但来自同一人的扫描图像。所有检索到的配对由人工在本地界面审核，而非自动分类。在包含95,129个扫描的聚合数据仓库中部署后，识别出1,316组完全重复扫描和1,275组经评审支持的近似重复受试者组，其中56%和82%跨越了数据集边界。所有54个基因参考对均被成功恢复。外部机构在不重新训练模型或传输图像的情况下独立完成全流程，验证了方法的可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着国家级MRI数据库整合多来源数据，单一数据集内的受试者标识符在聚合后可能失去全局唯一性，导致同一受试者被赋予多个标识符（即身份重复），从而引发训练与测试数据泄露，虚高下游研究性能。现有方法缺乏端到端、基于图像的规模化审计流程，亟需一种有效工具来检测并管理此类问题。

Method: HAPPEN采用双阶段策略：首先通过SHA-256指纹技术检测完全重复扫描；其次使用监督对比学习进行非相同但可能源自同一人的扫描检索。所有候选配对由人工在本地界面审查，避免自动化误判。整个流程设计为可本地部署，无需重训练模型或传输原始图像，确保隐私与灵活性。

Conclusion: HAPPEN提供了一种高效、可扩展且隐私友好的人机协作方案，适用于大规模多源MRI数据仓库中的身份重复审计。其端到端特性与无需重训练的部署能力显著提升了数据质量保障水平，为真实世界生物医学研究提供了可靠基础。

Abstract: National-scale magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) repositories increasingly integrate data from different studies and institutions. However, subject identifiers that are valid only within individual datasets are no longer guaranteed to remain globally unique after aggregation, making it possible for the same subject to be assigned multiple identifiers, which we define as identity duplication. Such duplication can create leakage between training and test data and inflate apparent performance in downstream biomedical studies. Existing methods do not provide an end-to-end, image-based workflow for auditing this problem at repository scale. In this work, we present HAPPEN, a human-in-the-loop pipeline for auditing identity duplication in T1-weighted brain MRI repositories. It combines SHA-256 fingerprinting for exact-duplicate detection with supervised contrastive retrieval of non-identical scans that may originate from the same person. Retrieved pairs are reviewed as candidates in a locally hosted interface rather than automatically classified as duplicates. We deployed the workflow in a 95,129-scan aggregated repository and assessed end-to-end recovery using 54 genetic-reference pairs. Transferability was assessed by locally deploying the same workflow on 22,386 scans at an independent institution without model retraining or image transfer. Deployment in the study repository identified 1,316 exact-duplicate scan groups and 1,275 reviewer-supported near-duplicate subject groups. Of these groups, 56% and 82%, respectively, crossed dataset boundaries. All 54 genetic-reference pairs were recovered. The external team independently completed the full workflow using a locally selected operating threshold and review standard.

</details>


### [77] [Quasi-Binarized Autoencoders: An Architecture-Independent Information Bottleneck for Medical Image Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09670)
*Shouhei Hanaoka,Takahiro Nakao,Atsushi Takamatsu,Takeharu Yoshikawa,Osamu Abe*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为准二值化（QB）层的新方法，通过在编码器-解码器路径中引入受差分隐私约束的噪声，限制信息流以防止身份映射，从而在无需数据集特定调整的情况下实现高性能的无监督异常检测。基于此构建了QBAE模型，在MedIAnomaly基准的七个数据集上达到0.828的平均图像级AUROC，优于现有非适配方法，并在BraTS2021上取得最佳结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有重建类无监督异常检测方法易因信息过载导致身份映射，难以有效区分正常与异常图像；当前解决方案依赖于手动设计的网络结构，缺乏通用性且不可量化。因此需要一种可量化、普适性强的方法来控制编码信息量，避免异常被重建。

Method: 引入准二值化（QB）层，将每个潜在变量压缩到[0,1]区间并添加尺度为1/ε的拉普拉斯噪声，使每个元素满足ε-局部差分隐私，从而理论上限制图像与重构之间的互信息。将该层部署于整个U-Net结构的编码器-解码器路径及所有跳跃连接中，构建QBAE模型，使用32,768个QB元素，保持测试时噪声以维持信息边界。

Result: 在MedIAnomaly基准的七个数据集上，QBAE以单一架构和配置实现0.828的平均图像级AUROC，为非适配方法中的最高水平；在BraTS2021上取得0.911的AUROC和0.838的像素级AP，为目前最优结果。即使不引入输入扰动，仅靠瓶颈层也显著优于基线（0.805 vs 0.590）。

Conclusion: QB层提供了一种可理论保证的信息限制机制，使无监督异常检测模型具备更强的泛化能力与稳定性。QBAE展示了在不依赖数据集特定调参的前提下，实现高性能异常检测的可行性，为医学图像分析中的无监督异常检测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection, which learns only from normal images, is a central task in medical image analysis and remains an open problem. Reconstruction-based methods pass an image through an encoder-decoder network trained on normal data and detect anomalies from the residual between the image and its reconstruction. This works only if the information passed from the encoder to the decoder is limited; otherwise the network learns an identity mapping and reconstructs anomalies too. This limit is usually imposed through architectural choices, tuned per dataset, that cannot be stated in bits. We introduce the quasi-binarizing (QB) layer, which squashes each latent element into [0, 1] and adds Laplace noise of scale 1/epsilon. Each element is then epsilon-locally differentially private, and the mutual information between an image and its reconstruction is bounded by a quantity that depends only on epsilon and the number of QB elements, whatever the encoder and decoder. Placing a QB layer on every encoder-decoder path, including all skip connections, we build QBAE, a seven-level attention U-Net with 32,768 QB elements. On the seven datasets of the MedIAnomaly benchmark, QBAE with one architecture and one configuration reaches a mean image-level AUROC of 0.828, the highest among methods that do not adapt to each dataset, and the best reported results on BraTS2021 (AUROC 0.911, pixel-level AP 0.838). The noise is kept at test time, so that every reconstruction satisfies the bound. Without input corruption, the bottleneck alone prevents identity collapse (mean AUROC 0.805 vs. 0.590). Code is available at https://github.com/hanaokalog/MedIAnomalyQB.

</details>

Motivation: 现有自监督异常检测方法多局限于单一解剖结构或任务，缺乏对正常超声图像普遍表征能力的评估，亟需一个涵盖多种解剖区域、成像方式的综合性基准来检验模型泛化能力。

Method: 构建SADUSI多源超声数据集，涵盖广泛正常超声分布及可见结构异常，用于评估自监督异常检测方法在单张图像上的性能。

Result: 当前主流自监督方法在SADUSI上表现不佳：重建类方法（如AnoDDPM、DeCo-Diff）像素级AUROC为0.56–0.72，最大F1为0.10–0.26；特征类方法（如PatchCore）AUROC为0.76–0.83，最大F1为0.14–0.40，均存在病理与正常区域分离困难的问题。

Conclusion: 多源超声异常检测仍面临重大挑战，SADUSI可作为推动通用化方法发展的关键资源。

Abstract: Self-supervised anomaly detection is a promising paradigm for medical ultrasound, as normal images are often easier to obtain than exhaustive annotations of all possible pathologies. However, most existing evaluations are limited to a single anatomy or task, making it unclear whether models learn a robust notion of normal ultrasound appearance or only a source-specific representation. We introduce the SADUSI benchmark, a multi-source ultrasound dataset designed to train and evaluate anomaly detection methods across a broad range of anatomical regions, views, and acquisition protocols. The goal of SADUSI is to provide a diverse normal ultrasound distribution and a benchmark for visible structural anomalies that can be assessed from single images. We evaluate representative self-supervised anomaly detection methods and find that current approaches struggle in this setting. In particular, reconstruction-based diffusion methods such as AnoDDPM and DeCo-Diff achieve pixel-level AUROC values of 0.56-0.72 and maximum F1 scores of 0.10-0.26, indicating limited separation of pathology from normal image regions. Feature-based PatchCore variants perform better, reaching pixel-level AUROC values of 0.76-0.83, but remain limited with maximum F1 scores of 0.14-0.40. These findings suggest that broad multi-source ultrasound anomaly detection remains an open challenge and that SADUSI can serve as a resource for developing methods that generalize beyond anatomy-specific settings.

</details>


### [79] [What Makes Synthetic Hard Negatives Work in Vision-Language Pretraining?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09700)
*Nikos Giakoumoglou,Paschalis Giakoumoglou,Andreas Floros,Kleanthis Marios Papadopoulos,Tania Stathaki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文分析了六种在表示空间中生成合成难样本的策略，发现其在视觉-语言预训练中存在两种失效模式：跨模态构造导致负样本过于简单或向查询拉近，而单模态构造则会引入匹配的正样本。此外，研究还观察到使用可学习温度时出现logit尺度饱和现象，固定温度可提升下游性能。基于此几何分析，提出SNAP方法，生成不涉及任一模态正样本的单模态难样本，完全避免上述问题。SNAP具有模型无关性，无需外部生成模型，训练开销增加小于10%。在多个架构和数据集上对CLIP和FLIP进行评估，SNAP在零样本检索、分类和线性探测任务中均带来一致性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将表示空间中生成合成难样本的方法从单模态自监督学习迁移到视觉-语言预训练面临挑战，现有方法存在生成负样本过于简单或引入正样本的问题，且可学习温度导致训练不稳定。因此需要一种更鲁棒、有效且通用的难样本生成机制。

Method: 提出SNAP方法，通过几何分析识别失败模式，设计一种不包含任一模态正样本的单模态难样本生成策略，避免跨模态与内模态构造中的问题；采用固定温度以缓解logit尺度饱和，提升训练稳定性。

Result: SNAP在多个视觉-语言模型（如CLIP、FLIP）和数据集上显著提升零样本检索、零样本分类及线性探测性能，训练开销增加低于10%，具备良好的泛化性和实用性。

Conclusion: SNAP通过避免现有合成难样本方法的失效模式，提供了一种高效、通用且稳定的视觉-语言预训练增强方案，为后续多模态学习提供了新思路。

Abstract: Synthetic hard negatives generated in the representation space have proven effective for unimodal self-supervised learning, but transferring this idea to vision-language pretraining is not straightforward. We analyze six representation-space synthesis strategies and identify two failure modes in their transfer to vision-language pretraining: cross-modal constructions that produce overly easy negatives or pull them toward the query, and intra-modal constructions that incorporate the matched positive. We also observe logit-scale saturation when training with synthetic hard negatives and a learnable temperature, and find that fixing the temperature improves downstream performance. Using this geometric analysis we propose SNAP, which generates intra-modal hard negatives that never involve the positive from either modality, avoiding both failure modes entirely. SNAP is model-agnostic, requires no external generative models, and adds less than 10% training time overhead. Evaluated on top of CLIP and FLIP across multiple architectures and datasets, SNAP delivers consistent improvements on zero-shot retrieval, zero-shot classification, and linear probe evaluation.

</details>


### [80] [Latent Watermarks under Generative Editing: A Benchmark and Analysis of Detection Survival](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09702)
*Sung Ju Lee,Nam Ik Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究评估了八种水印方法在五种编辑器、四种生成模型、四种编辑强度和五种语义类别下的表现，发现普通提示编辑会导致潜在水印检测失败，且不需直接针对水印。通过分离编辑与七种后续失真，发现仅编辑主要影响Tree-Ring水印，而添加失真则暴露更广泛的检测存活情况。连续编辑揭示了评分分离可能下降但检测率仍保持高位的现象。标准化的干净评分分离（$d'$）可有效组织复合存活层级，而空间重叠对预测仅编辑存活帮助有限。在两种方法中，嵌入强度干预显示更高的干净分离对应更高的编辑后分离。HSTR中边际对比为正，角度布局对比在匹配干净分离时仍未解决。结果分解与连续分离揭示了聚合TPR所隐藏的差异。方法层级在阈值重新校准和不同复合权重下稳定，表明干净$d'$是此基准中的有用经验诊断工具，但对未见方法的泛化能力有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示编辑方法可能导致潜在水印检测失败，但其机制尚不明确。本研究旨在系统评估不同水印方法在多种编辑场景下的鲁棒性，揭示编辑对水印检测的影响机制，并提出有效的诊断指标。

Method: 通过构建包含八种水印方法、五种编辑器、四种生成模型、四种编辑强度和五种语义类别的大规模基准测试，结合编辑有效性与阈值检查，分离编辑过程与七种后续失真，分析评分分离与空间重叠的影响，并引入标准化干净评分分离（$d'$）作为诊断指标。

Result: 编辑本身主要影响Tree-Ring水印；加入失真后检测存活范围扩大；连续编辑中评分分离下降但检测率仍高；干净$d'$能有效组织方法存活层级，对编辑后分离具有预测力；嵌入强度干预验证了干净分离与编辑后分离的正相关；不同方法在$ d'$上表现出稳定层级，阈值和权重变化下结果稳健。

Conclusion: 干净评分分离（$d'$）是评估水印方法在编辑环境下生存能力的有效经验诊断工具，尽管其跨方法泛化能力有限。研究揭示了传统聚合指标（如TPR）无法捕捉的深层差异，为水印设计与编辑防御提供了新视角。

Abstract: Ordinary prompt-based editing can cause latent watermark detection to fail without explicitly targeting the watermark. We benchmark eight watermark methods against five editors across four generative backbones, four editing strengths, and five semantic categories, with edit-validity and threshold checks. Separating editing from seven subsequent distortions reveals that editing alone primarily distinguishes Tree-Ring, while added distortions expose a broader spectrum of detection survival. Sequential edits reveal a second hidden difference: score separation can decline while detection rates remain near their ceiling. Across methods, standardized clean score separation ($d'$) organizes composite-survival tiers, whereas spatial overlap adds little to predicting edit-only survival beyond clean detectability. Embedding-strength interventions in two methods link higher clean separation to higher post-edit separation. In HSTR, the margin contrast is positive, while the angular layout contrast at matched clean separation remains unresolved. Together, outcome decomposition and continuous separation expose differences hidden by aggregate TPR. Method tiers are stable under threshold recalibration at the main operating points and alternative composite weights. Clean $d'$ is thus a useful empirical diagnostic within this benchmark, with mixed transfer to unseen methods. Code and supporting artifacts are planned for a separate release.

</details>


### [81] [Enhancing Multi-Region Stylization with Interior-Guided Boundary Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09706)
*Hong-Son Nguyen,Thi-Ngoc-Hanh Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种轻量级、模型无关的边界修复方法IGBR，用于改善多区域风格迁移中的边界伪影问题。该方法通过内部引导传播和基于距离的向内混合策略，在不引入对象间风格泄露的前提下，有效修复边界像素。其基于区域约束的公式具有闭式解，可无缝集成到现有风格迁移流程中，无需重新训练。同时，作者提出了新的定量评估指标，用于衡量边界一致性、梯度伪影、风格泄漏和内部保持性，实验表明IGBR在多个方面均优于现有技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多区域风格迁移虽能实现精细的艺术控制，但区域拼接常导致边界伪影，影响视觉质量，亟需一种高效且通用的边界修复方法。

Method: Interior-Guided Boundary Repair (IGBR) 方法通过内部引导传播修复边界像素，并采用限制在物体-背景边界的向内距离加权混合策略，避免跨对象风格泄露；其理论基础为区域约束的优化问题，具有闭式解，便于集成。

Result: IGBR在边界一致性、梯度稳定性与内部结构保持性方面均显著优于现有融合技术，且无需额外训练即可嵌入现有流程，验证了其有效性与实用性。

Conclusion: IGBR是一种高效、通用的边界修复方法，能够显著提升多区域风格迁移的视觉质量，适用于多种风格迁移框架。

Abstract: Region-based neural style transfer enables fine-grained artistic control by allowing independent stylization of semantic image regions. However, compositing these regions often leads to boundary artifacts, degrading visual quality. We propose Interior-Guided Boundary Repair (IGBR), a lightweight and model-agnostic method that improves boundary handling in multi-region stylization. IGBR repairs boundary pixels using interior-guided propagation and applies inward, distance-based blending restricted to object-background boundaries, preventing inter-object style leakage. The method is derived from a region-wise constrained formulation with a closed-form solution and can be seamlessly integrated into existing stylization pipelines without retraining. To evaluate efficiency of our IGBR, we introduce quantitative metrics that measure boundary consistency, gradient artifacts, inter-object leakage, and interior preservation without requiring annotated stylized images. Our experiments and evaluations demonstrate that the proposed IGBR consistently produces plausible boundaries, outperforming prior blending techniques in boundary consistency, gradient stability, and interior preservation. The code is available at https://github.com/Son-SDT/IGBR.

</details>


### [82] [DynStream: Online Streaming 4D Gaussian Reconstruction of Dynamic Worlds from Unposed Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09720)
*Dingwei Xian,Xiaoyu Zhou,Yajiao Xiong,Yongtao Wang,Ming-Hsuan Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DynStream 是一种用于从长时间、无预设视频流中进行在线 4D 高斯重建的框架。它通过局部时间窗口内的连续重建，并逐步对齐和融合这些局部结果，实现全局一致的 4D 场景重建，支持无需逐场景优化的在线处理与高质量渲染。该方法在动态室内与室外场景中均实现了高保真度的实时重建与渲染，达到当前最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以同时实现连续处理与逼真渲染：前馈高斯方法仅适用于离线处理，而在线点云方法在保持密集几何结构和高保真渲染方面表现不佳。因此需要一种既能在线处理又能生成高质量视觉效果的新方法。

Method: DynStream 在连续视频流中采用局部时间窗口的重建策略，通过跨窗口几何一致性约束和时变场景内容建模，逐步对齐并融合局部重建结果，形成全局一致的动态 4D 场景表示，避免了每场景的优化过程。

Result: 实验表明，DynStream 能够在长视频流上实现高保真度的在线动态 4D 重建与渲染，在多种动态室内与室外场景中均优于现有方法，具备优异的实时性与视觉质量。

Conclusion: DynStream 成功解决了长期视频流中在线 4D 重建的挑战，实现了高效、连续且高保真的动态场景重建与渲染，为大规模动态场景建模提供了新范式。

Abstract: Online reconstruction of dynamic 4D scenes from long, unposed streaming videos requires both continuous processing and photorealistic rendering, which existing methods struggle to achieve simultaneously. Existing feed-forward Gaussian methods are restricted to offline processing, whereas online point-cloud approaches struggle to maintain dense geometry and high-fidelity rendering. We present DynStream, a framework for streaming 4D Gaussian reconstruction from long, unposed videos. Given a continuous video stream, DynStream reconstructs the scene within local temporal windows and incrementally aligns and fuses these local reconstructions into a globally consistent scene, enabling online 4D reconstruction without per-scene optimization. By jointly enforcing cross-window geometric consistency and modeling time-varying scene content, DynStream supports efficient reconstruction and photorealistic rendering over extended video streams. Experiments demonstrate that DynStream enables high-fidelity online dynamic reconstruction and rendering from long video streams, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse dynamic indoor and outdoor scenes.

</details>


### [83] [MeshCarve: Artisan Mesh Generation with Flow Matching in Compact Latent Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09723)
*Xiyu Wang,Ruocheng Wu,Yufei Wang,Zhihao Li,Lanqing Guo,Bihan Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MeshCarve提出一种在紧凑潜在空间中生成网格的新方法，通过分离顶点位置和边连接的生成过程，避免联合编码几何与拓扑带来的质量下降问题。采用分层稀疏Transformer架构（VertexVAE和EdgeVAE），以离散顶点为锚点，大幅缩短序列长度，并引入空间感知压缩与顶点链接编码，实现高质量、高效率的网格生成。该方法在Objaverse和Toys4K上优于现有自回归与流匹配方法，是首个全流程在空间压缩潜在空间中运行的工艺级网格生成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网格生成方法存在推理速度慢（自回归）或重建质量下降（流匹配中联合编码几何与拓扑时）的问题，尤其在潜在空间压缩下更明显。亟需一种高效且保持高质量的生成框架。

Method: 提出MeshCarve，结合VertexVAE与EdgeVAE，分别建模顶点占据与连接关系；采用分层稀疏Transformer结构，以离散顶点为锚点降低序列长度；引入顶点链接编码将任意拓扑转为固定长度连续嵌入；通过锚点生成器与流匹配机制，在极短的压缩潜在序列上完成生成。

Result: 在Objaverse和Toys4K数据集上性能超越当前最优自回归与流匹配方法；生成速度更快，重建质量更高；首次实现全流程在空间压缩潜在空间中运行，序列长度仅为先前最紧凑方法的极小部分。

Conclusion: MeshCarve是首个全流程在空间压缩潜在空间中运行的工艺级网格生成方法，通过分离顶点与连接建模、稀疏结构设计与创新编码策略，实现了高效、高质量的网格生成，为后续研究提供了新范式。

Abstract: Prior artisan mesh generation works largely predict face tokens autoregressively, which makes inference slow. Recent methods instead flow match continuous latents built by Variational AutoEncoders (VAEs), but reconstruction quality drops significantly when geometry and topology are jointly encoded, and further when the latent space is compressed. We present MeshCarve, a flow matching method that generates entirely in compact latent spaces, generating vertex positions and edge connections separately and sidestepping the difficulty of a joint compact latent. To shorten the token sequence, we propose a hierarchical sparse transformer backbone, instantiated as VertexVAE and EdgeVAE. Instead of encoding fields over the surface voxels, both VAEs anchor on discrete vertices in their latent spaces, which drastically reduces the token sequence length, and our spatial-aware compression shortens it further without costing reconstruction. VertexVAE directly encodes vertex occupancy. For connectivity, we propose vertex-link encoding, which turns arbitrary connectivity between vertices into fixed-length continuous per-vertex embeddings and recovers complex artistic topology faithfully. MeshCarve combines these VAEs with an anchor generator and flow matches on the shortened token sequences. It shows advantages over state-of-the-art autoregressive and flow matching methods on Objaverse and generalizes to Toys4K. To the best of our knowledge, it is among the first artisan mesh generation methods whose every generative stage runs in a spatially compressed latent, with a token sequence only a fraction of the most compressed previous autoregressive and flow matching works.

</details>


### [84] [Beyond Group Splits: Specimen-Level Cross-Validation and Visual Attribution for Remaining-Shelf-Life Regression in Climacteric Fruit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09726)
*Rovhona Mudau,Jean Frederic Isingizwe Nturambirwe,Clement Nthambazale Nyirenda*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究评估了在重复图像来自同一生物样本的情况下，评价协议对剩余货架寿命（RSL）估计性能的影响。使用牛油果成熟数据集，比较了观察级与样本无关的评估方式，发现样本无关的交叉验证（如5折交叉验证）比观察级随机划分给出更保守、更真实的性能估计。轻量级模型MobileNetV3-Small在保持与ResNet-18相当精度的同时，具有更高的推理速度。Grad-CAM分析显示不同模型的空间注意力分布存在差异。研究支持在纵向货架寿命预测中采用样本无关的评估和归因分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于图像的剩余 shelf life (RSL) 估计方法在评估时若未考虑同一生物样本的重复图像，可能产生过于乐观的性能报告，因此需要更严谨的评估协议以真实反映模型泛化能力。

Method: 使用哈斯牛油果成熟数据集（8,834张图像-剩余货架寿命对，来自426个果实），训练一个预训练的ImageNet视觉主干网络+轻量回归头；对比观察级随机划分与样本无关的5折交叉验证两种评估策略，并比较轻量级（MobileNetV3-Small）与较重模型（ResNet-18）的表现；通过Grad-CAM分析模型的空间注意力分布。

Result: 观察级评估下平均RMSE为2.37天（标准差0.03），而样本无关评估下平均RMSE为3.12天（标准差0.11），且两者的差异在统计上高度显著（p < 0.001）。MobileNetV3-Small在样本无关评估中表现接近ResNet-18但参数更少、吞吐量更高。Grad-CAM揭示了不同模型在关注区域上的差异。

Conclusion: 观察级评估会显著高估模型性能，建议在长期货架寿命预测任务中采用样本无关的评估方法；轻量级模型在准确性和效率之间取得良好平衡，适合实际部署；归因分析有助于理解模型决策依据。

Abstract: Estimating remaining shelf life (RSL) from images could provide affordable decision support for perishable produce, but evaluation protocols can substantially affect reported performance when repeated images are available from the same biological specimen. We use the Hass Avocado Ripening dataset, comprising 8,834 image-RSL pairs from 426 fruits across three storage regimes, to evaluate a frozen ImageNet-pretrained visual backbone with a lightweight regression head. Our contributions are threefold: we quantify the effect of observation-level versus specimen-disjoint evaluation, compare lightweight and heavier visual backbones under specimen-disjoint cross-validation, and examine their spatial attributions using Grad-CAM. Across ten observation-level random splits, the model achieves a mean RMSE of 2.37 days with a standard deviation of 0.03 days, whereas specimen-disjoint 5-fold cross-validation yields a mean RMSE of 3.12 days with a standard deviation of 0.11 days. The corresponding mean coefficient of determination is 0.553. A matched per-specimen comparison confirms higher error under specimen-disjoint evaluation, with a probability value below 0.001 across 426 specimens, showing that observation-level partitioning gives a substantially more optimistic estimate for this dataset and model configuration. Under specimen-disjoint evaluation, MobileNetV3-Small (0.93 million parameters) achieves accuracy comparable to ResNet-18 while providing substantially higher throughput, and Grad-CAM reveals differences in spatial attribution between the lightweight backbones. These results support specimen-disjoint evaluation and attribution analysis when assessing lightweight vision models for longitudinal shelf-life prediction.

</details>


### [85] [PARC-Loc: Text-to-Point-Cloud Localization with Partial Assignment and Relational Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09761)
*Shengkai Ma,Zhenyu Hou,Weihua Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PARC-Loc提出一种基于部分分配与关系一致性的粗到精定位框架，以解决城市级3D地图中因重复或相似物体导致的布局不一致混淆和边界证据不完整问题。通过联合建模提示对象兼容性和成对空间关系，支持未匹配元素并偏好符合查询布局的分配。在粗粒度阶段，候选评估结合神经相似性实现布局一致的子地图选择；在细粒度阶段，扩展上下文并融合邻近子地图中的相关实例，同时利用PARC生成的对象级匹配权重引导跨模态注意力。在KITTI360Pose和CityLoc数据集上实验表明，该方法显著优于传统基线，在KITTI360Pose上将5米内的Top-1定位召回率从0.50提升至0.67，相对提升34%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有粗到精方法在城市级3D地图中进行文本到点云定位时，受限于重复或相似城市物体导致的嵌入相似性过高，以及查询相关实例跨越子地图边界造成上下文信息不完整的问题，从而引发布局不一致混淆和边界证据缺失。

Method: 提出PARC-Loc框架，采用部分分配与关系一致性（PARC）机制，联合建模提示对象兼容性与成对空间关系，允许未匹配元素，优先选择与查询布局一致的分配方案。粗阶段通过候选评估增强神经相似性，实现布局一致的子地图选择；细阶段扩展上下文，引入邻近子地图中的相关实例，并利用对象级匹配权重指导跨模态注意力。

Result: 在KITTI360Pose和CityLoc数据集上，PARC-Loc显著优于现有粗到精基线方法。尤其在KITTI360Pose上，5米内Top-1定位召回率从0.50提升至0.67，相对提升34%。

Conclusion: PARC-Loc通过联合建模对象兼容性与空间关系，有效缓解了布局不一致混淆与边界证据不完整问题，实现了更鲁棒、准确的城市级文本到点云定位。

Abstract: Text-to-point-cloud localization estimates a position in a city-scale 3D map from descriptions of surrounding objects. Existing coarse-to-fine methods retrieve submaps using aggregate learned compatibility and then localize within a selected submap. However, repetitive or similar urban objects can inflate the embedding similarity between the query and multiple submaps, even when the instance layout within a submap violates the query description. Meanwhile, query-relevant instances often span submap boundaries, leaving the retrieved submap with incomplete contextual evidence. We term these failure modes layout-inconsistent aliasing and boundary evidence incompleteness, respectively. To address them, we propose PARC-Loc, a coarse-to-fine localization framework built on Partial Assignment with Relational Consistency (PARC). PARC jointly models hint-object compatibility and pairwise spatial relations, allowing unmatched elements while favoring assignments consistent with the queried layout. At the coarse stage, its candidate-level assessment complements neural similarity for layout-consistent submap selection. At the fine stage, the context is expanded with query-relevant instances from adjacent submaps, while PARC yields object-level matching weights that guide cross-modal attention. Extensive experiments on KITTI360Pose and CityLoc show that PARC-Loc outperforms conventional coarse-to-fine baselines. On KITTI360Pose, our method improves Top-1 localization recall at 5 m from 0.50 to 0.67, achieving a 34% relative gain over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [86] [SoccerNet-FoulRet: Retrieving Semantically Similar Soccer Foul Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09742)
*Jacobus Arthur,Ahmad Sait,Batool Hani,Merey Ramazanova,Jan Held,Marc Van Droogenbroeck,Bernard Ghanem,Anthony Cioppa,Silvio Giancola*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SoccerNet-FoulRet基准，用于语义犯规检索，旨在帮助裁判在判罚时参考历史相似案例。该任务不依赖视觉相似性或事件匹配，而是基于裁判的判罚解释进行相关性判断。研究使用SoccerNet-MVFoul数据集构建基准，评估零样本视频和视觉-语言嵌入模型以及微调基线的表现。结果显示，最强零样本模型在人类验证的先例中HitRate@10低于5%，而类别监督微调虽提升类别相关性，但在先例检索上的迁移效果有限。该工作公开了数据集以推动该问题的研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 裁判在专业足球比赛中对争议性犯规的判罚缺乏一致性，主要因为难以将当前犯规与过往类似案例进行比较。为解决这一问题，需建立一种能够根据裁判判罚逻辑而非视觉特征检索历史相似犯规的机制。

Method: 将犯规检索问题建模为语义检索任务，构建SoccerNet-FoulRet基准数据集；利用SoccerNet-MVFoul数据集生成693个经人工验证的查询及类别相关标签；评估零样本视频与视觉-语言嵌入模型，并训练任务特定微调基线模型进行对比。

Result: 最强零样本模型在人类验证的先例中达到低于5%的HitRate@10；类别监督微调虽提升了类别相关性，但对实际先例检索的提升有限，表明语义犯规检索仍具挑战性。

Conclusion: 语义犯规检索是足球裁判决策支持中的一个开放性难题，SoccerNet-FoulRet作为首个基准被发布，旨在推动该方向的研究发展。

Abstract: Refereeing decisions in professional soccer remain inconsistent because referees cannot easily compare a contentious foul against similar past cases. We cast this as a retrieval problem and introduce SoccerNet-FoulRet, the first benchmark for semantic foul retrieval. Given a query foul, the task is to retrieve past fouls judged to be relevant precedents, regardless of camera angle, teams, or appearance. This differs from prior video-to-video retrieval, which matches clips by visual similarity or a shared event. Here, relevance is defined by refereeing interpretation. We build the benchmark from the SoccerNet-MVFoul dataset and evaluate retrieval ability of zero-shot video and vision-language embedders together with a task-specific fine-tuned baseline on 693 human-verified queries and category-relevance labels. Semantic foul retrieval remains challenging. The strongest zero-shot model achieves under 5% HitRate@10 on human-verified precedents, while category-supervised fine-tuning improves category relevance but transfers only modestly to precedent retrieval. We release SoccerNet-FoulRet to establish semantic foul retrieval as an open problem: https://github.com/SoccerNet/sn-foulret.

</details>


### [87] [Flow-of-Thought: A Framework for Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09746)
*Mariia Baidachna,Nicolas Pugeault*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Flow-of-Thought（FoT）框架，通过生成视觉草图作为中间推理步骤，模拟人类的内心图像，提升模型在空间理解任务中的表现。利用SO(2)群轨道和累积最短路径训练坐标感知轨迹流场，并冻结学习到的动力学；通过前景加权重建能量比较不同生成假设，实现准确的“相同/不同”判断。在锁定测试中，FoT在Tetris任务上达到100.0%准确率，在彩色形状任务上达99.0%；在冻结迁移设置下，2D流场在BLINK多视角数据集上优于仅使用终点控制的方法（72.2% vs. 63.9%），表明连续视觉轨迹是空间推理中一种有效且可解释的表示方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大型语言模型（LLMs）和视觉变换器（ViTs）在需要空间理解的任务上表现不佳，而人类通过‘内心图像’进行空间推理。为弥补这一差距，需引入更贴近人类认知过程的中间推理机制。

Method: 设计并训练坐标感知的轨迹流场，基于SO(2)群轨道与累积最短路径，冻结其动态；采用前景加权重建能量评估不同生成假设，以支持决策。

Result: 在锁定测试中，FoT在Tetris任务上达到100.0%准确率，在彩色形状任务上达到99.0%；在冻结迁移设置下，2D流场在BLINK多视角数据集上表现优于仅用终点控制的方法（72.2% vs. 63.9%）。

Conclusion: 连续视觉轨迹作为中间推理表示，能有效提升模型在空间推理任务中的性能，尤其在分布外场景中表现出良好的泛化能力，且具备可解释性，为构建类人认知系统提供了新思路。

Abstract: Mental imagery, ``seeing with the mind's eye'' is an essential aspect of human cognition. Despite rapid progress Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) still underperform on tasks requiring spatial understanding. To address this, we introduce Flow-of-Thought (FoT), a framework that integrates the generation of visual sketches as intermediate reasoning steps, mimicking mental imagery in humans. We train coordinate-aware trajectory flow fields on $SO(2)$ group orbits and cumulative shortest paths, then freeze the learned dynamics; same vs. different decisions compare competing generative hypotheses using foreground-weighted reconstruction energy. On locked tests FoT reaches 100.0% accuracy on Tetris and 99.0% on colored shapes. Under frozen transfer, the orbit-trained 2D flow improves over its endpoint-only control on BLINK Multi-view (72.2% vs. 63.9% on 133 public validation pairs), supporting continuous visual traces as an effective and interpretable representation for spatial reasoning in some out-of-distribution settings.

</details>


### [88] [Diffusion-Generated Image Watermarking: A Two-Axis Taxonomy and Three Protocol-Bounded Case Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09755)
*Sung Ju Lee,Nam Ik Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于扩散生成图像水印的分类框架，基于插入机制和主要信号载体表示两个维度，构建了$z_T$-Fourier流水线以支持验证与识别。通过三个受协议约束的案例研究，分别探讨了频率保真度与检测、质量及裁剪行为的关系；种子相关与无关编辑下的持久性，并提出局部语义印记假设；以及单次操作的VAE隐空间调制在效率、再生鲁棒性及鲁棒性-质量权衡上的表现。此外，区分四类内容级攻击并提出评估协议与可测试假设，识别视频应用中的时间扩展方向。研究不追求通用排名，而是提供匹配、协议感知的水印系统比较框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在扩散生成图像中实现水印需平衡溯源信号、图像质量、鲁棒性和计算成本，现有方法缺乏系统性分类与评估标准，亟需建立统一框架以支持有效比较与优化。

Method: 采用双轴分类法（插入机制与信号载体表示），构建$z_T$-Fourier流水线，开展三类协议限定的案例研究，并提出攻击分类与评估协议，结合实证分析与理论推演。

Result: 提出了一个结构化框架，支持对扩散生成图像水印系统的协议感知比较；揭示了频率完整性、编辑持久性、隐空间调制等关键因素的作用机制；识别出四类内容级攻击及其应对策略，为视频水印提供时间扩展方向。

Conclusion: 本研究未给出通用最优水印方案，但建立了可复用的分析框架，推动水印系统在真实场景下的可比性、可验证性与可优化性发展。

Abstract: Watermarking diffusion-generated images requires balancing provenance signals with image quality, robustness, and computational cost. This work organizes methods along two axes: insertion mechanism and primary signal-bearing representation, and formalizes a representative $z_T$-Fourier pipeline for verification and identification. We then use the taxonomy to structure three protocol-bounded case studies. The first examines associations among frequency integrity, detection, quality, and cropping behavior. The second revisits persistence under seed-linked and seed-independent editing and formulates a scoped Semantic Imprinting Hypothesis without claiming a localized carrier or causal mechanism. The third studies single-shot VAE-latent phase modulation, including its efficiency, regeneration robustness, and robustness--quality operating points. Finally, we separate four content-level attack families from model/pipeline adaptation, propose corresponding evaluation protocols and testable conjectures for parameter-tuning threats, and identify additional temporal extensions for video. These analyses do not establish a universal ranking; instead, they provide a framework for matched, protocol-aware comparisons of watermarking systems for diffusion-generated images.

</details>


### [89] [Relational Abstractions for Spatial Reasoning with Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09780)
*Ana Ezquerro,Ozan Özdenizci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的空间推理新框架，通过无监督对象发现和对象关系抽象，增强扩散模型对结构化逻辑规则的理解能力，使其在满足空间推理约束的条件图像生成中表现更优。同时构建了一个大规模生成式空间推理基准，涵盖四种受人类可解谜题启发的数据集。实验表明，该方法显著提升了扩散模型在复杂推理任务中的表现，并具备良好的分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前扩散模型在图像生成方面表现优异，但在满足结构化空间推理约束方面存在局限，无法有效学习隐含逻辑规则，导致生成结果难以符合特定推理需求。因此需要一种能够理解并遵循逻辑结构的生成框架。

Method: 提出一种结合无监督对象发现与对象关系抽象的新框架，利用对象中心表示提取的关联知识作为结构化先验，指导扩散模型在训练和推理过程中更好地满足空间推理约束。

Result: 所提方法显著提升了扩散模型在多种复杂空间推理任务上的表现，尤其在处理未见分布数据时展现出更强的鲁棒性和泛化能力；在新构建的大规模基准测试中，模型性能优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过引入关系抽象与对象中心表示，扩散模型得以有效整合结构化逻辑知识，实现更准确、更可靠的条件图像生成，为解决具有隐含逻辑结构的生成任务提供了新范式。

Abstract: Diffusion models excel at image synthesis, but they remain limited in their ability to reliably satisfy structured spatial reasoning constraints. In conditional data distribution modeling tasks with implicit logical structure, such as puzzles defined by visible clues paired with consistent solutions, state-of-the-art generative models tend to approximate pixel-space distributions without learning the underlying logical rules required for inference. To address this limitation, we present a novel framework for spatial reasoning with diffusion models that leverages unsupervised object discovery and abstractions of object relations. We show that the relational knowledge derived from object-centric representations enriches diffusion models with structural primitives, allowing them to effectively guide the generative representation space during both training and inference, and enabling conditional image generation that satisfies reasoning constraints. Additionally, we introduce a large-scale generative spatial reasoning benchmark with four datasets inspired by human-solvable puzzles. Our results show that relational abstractions significantly improve reasoning capabilities of diffusion models on a variety of complex reasoning tasks, while enabling robust generalization in out-of-distribution settings.

</details>


### [90] [CIRSeg: Coarse-to-Fine Intensity-Robust Liver Segmentation with Source-Free Continual Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09784)
*Ruoshi Xu,Mingqi Gao,Shengda Luo,Jingkun Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CIRSeg 是一种基于 nnU-Netv2 的粗到精、对强度变化鲁棒的肝脏分割框架，通过 3D CutMix 和随机强度迁移（Nyul 增强或直方图匹配）提升对异构 MRI 强度的鲁棒性。其级联结构将低分辨率解剖定位与全分辨率边界细化分离，并在推理阶段采用无源测试时自适应和概率先验正则化以增强对分布外输入的鲁棒性。最后通过最大连通域过滤去除孤立假阳性区域。在 CARE 2026 测试集上，CIRSeg 在域内和未见域上的 Dice 分数分别为 97.13% 和 97.93%，HD95 值分别为 20.18 mm 和 11.30 mm，表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有肝脏分割方法受限于标注数据少、扫描仪或厂商相关的强度差异，易导致过拟合和泛化能力差；同时难以兼顾全局定位与精确边界分割，且预测中常出现远离主肝体的孤立假阳性区域。

Method: 提出 CIRSeg 框架，结合 3D CutMix 与随机强度转移（Nyul 增强或直方图匹配）增强强度鲁棒性；采用级联结构分离低分辨率定位与高分辨率边界细化；引入无源测试时自适应与概率先验正则化提升泛化能力；最后使用最大连通域过滤去除孤立假阳性区域。

Result: 在 CARE 2026 测试集上，CIRSeg 在域内和未见域上的 Dice 分数分别为 97.13% 和 97.93%，HD95 值分别为 20.18 mm 和 11.30 mm，表现出对不同采集域的一致高精度分割性能。

Conclusion: CIRSeg 有效解决了对比增强 MRI 中肝脏分割面临的强度变化、泛化能力差及边界不精确等问题，实现了在域内与未见域下的稳定高精度分割，具备临床应用潜力。

Abstract: Reliable liver segmentation in contrast-enhanced MRI is essential for quantitative hepatic assessment, treatment planning, and longitudinal disease monitoring. However, limited annotated data and scanner- or vendor-dependent intensity variations can cause overfitting and poor generalization to unseen acquisition domains. Moreover, simultaneously achieving robust global localization and precise boundary delineation remains challenging, while predictions may contain isolated false-positive regions outside the main liver component. To address these challenges, we propose CIRSeg, a coarse-to-fine, intensity-robust liver segmentation framework based on nnU-Netv2. CIRSeg combines 3D CutMix with stochastic intensity transfer using either Nyul augmentation or histogram matching to improve robustness to heterogeneous MRI intensities. Its cascaded architecture decouples low-resolution anatomical localization from full-resolution boundary refinement.
