In contrast, we introduce HuLiGen, a generative model that generates human LiDAR point clouds from a parametric body model, using a point transformer trained with a flow-matching objective. We show that our generated point clouds are closer to the real capture distribution. Using HuLiGen to generate synthetic data, we propose a synthetic-only pretraining scheme for LiDAR-based HPE that achieves state-of-the-art performance, with even larger gains in low-annotation and low-data regimes, where MPJPE is reduced by up to 50%. Code, models and generated samples are available at https://github.com/valeoai/HuLiGen.

</details>


### [124] [VolCo: Volumetric Contact for High-Fidelity Human Grasp Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10197)
*Zhuo Chen,Yihua Cheng,Aleš Leonardis,Hyung Jin Chang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Volumetric Contact (VolCo)表示法，通过3D体素网格扩展表面点以精确建模手-物体接触，结合局部和全局特征的层次结构，利用3D变分自编码器和先验引导扩散模型实现更真实的抓握效果，显著减少穿透并提升稳定性，在基准数据集上达到先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有接触表示方法局限于物体表面，依赖手工规则恢复接触细节，导致严重穿透和不合理的结果，难以充分利用运动捕捉数据中的丰富细节。

Method: 引入Volumetric Contact (VolCo)，将表面点扩展为3D体素网格，构建包含局部接触细节与全局手部几何的层次结构；使用3D变分自编码器建模局部手部配置，结合对象符号距离场（SDF）；设计先验引导扩散模型学习从体素网格聚合的压缩潜在特征分布。

Result: 在两个基准数据集上评估，相比现有方法显著降低穿透程度，提升抓握稳定性和真实性，能够生成紧密且合理的抓握姿态。

Conclusion: VolCo通过体素化接触表示和层次化建模，有效提升了手-物体交互建模的精度与合理性，为真实抓握生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: Accurate contact modeling is fundamental to understanding hand-object interaction, yet existing contact representations are typically restricted to object surfaces and rely on hand-crafted rules to recover contact details, leading to severe penetrations and implausible results. To better exploit the rich detail in motion-capture data, we introduce Volumetric Contact (VolCo), a representation that expands surface points to a set of 3D volumetric grids. VolCo encodes 3D contact that allows precise hand part recovery, and is organized in an inherent hierarchy: local contact details within each volume and global hand geometry across all volumes. Our framework, VolCoDiff, employs two modules to capture local and global features following this hierarchy. For local contact details, we use a 3D variational autoencoder to model the possible hand configurations conditioned on the local object signed distance field (SDF). For global hand geometry, we design a prior-guided diffusion model that learns the distribution of compressed latent features aggregated from the volumetric grids. We evaluate our method on two benchmark datasets and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in penetration and stability, indicating the capability to generate tight grasps with much less severe penetrations. Our code is available at https://github.com/chzh9311/volco.

</details>


### [125] [Masked Feature Encoding for Large-Scale Whole Slide Image Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10225)
*Haoyu He,Basile Tessier-Cloutier,Yang Wang,Mahdi S. Hosseini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MFE-MIL提出一种基于特征空间掩码的多实例学习框架，通过联合训练轻量级MLP适配器、基于窗口的掩码重建分支和MIL分类头，有效抑制组织切片内的染色、扫描仪及局部纹理差异带来的噪声，提升分类性能。在多个病理数据集上优于现有方法，尤其在生存分析任务中表现稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决全切片图像分析中因染色、扫描仪和局部纹理差异导致的切片内方差掩盖判别信号的问题，提升多实例学习框架的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Method: 提出MFE-MIL框架，包含一个轻量级MLP适配器、基于窗口的掩码重建分支和MIL分类头；利用分类任务引导适配器抑制切片内变异，同时以掩码重建作为无坐标依赖的正则化辅助；推理时仅保留适配器与分类头。

Result: 在CAMELYON16/17、PANDA、TCGA-BRCA等多个数据集上，MFE-MIL在准确率、F1分数和AUC方面均优于多数基线方法，尤其在三组数据集上超越2DMamba；在五个TCGA生存队列中，所有聚合器配置下平均一致性指数均有提升。

Conclusion: MFE-MIL通过特征空间掩码机制有效缓解切片内异质性影响，显著提升病理图像分析的性能与稳定性，具有广泛适用性与实际应用价值。

Abstract: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis in computational pathology follows a multiple instance learning (MIL) pipeline where patch embeddings are extracted independently and aggregated for slide-level prediction, but within-slide variance from staining, scanner, and local texture can overwhelm the discriminative signal. We propose Masked Feature Encoding for Multiple Instance Learning (MFE-MIL), a feature-space masking framework that trains a lightweight MLP adapter jointly with a window-based masked reconstruction branch and a MIL classification head. The two objectives are complementary. Classification guides the adapter to suppress within-slide patch variance, while window-based masked reconstruction provides an auxiliary regularizer for the adapted features without using patch coordinates, coordinate graphs, or segmentation preprocessing. The raster patch-extraction order is used only as a weak implicit prior. At inference, the decoder is removed, leaving only the adapter and MIL head. Across CAMELYON16/17, PANDA, and TCGA-BRCA with four diverse encoders, MFE-MIL improves ACC/F1 for nearly all tested aggregator-encoder settings and AUC in most, outperforms coordinate-based spatial methods (CAMIL), and achieves higher AUC than 2DMamba on three of four datasets (UNI). On five TCGA survival cohorts it improves the average concordance index for every aggregator tested, its most consistent gain. Code is available at https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/MFE-MIL.

</details>


### [126] [Geometry-Supervised Visual Representation Learning for Multi-Phenotype Lesion Interpretation in Medical VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10238)
*Hao Wang,Qiwei Zeng,Shuchang Ye,Jinghao Lin,Yuezhe Yang,Yige Peng,Jinman Kim,Lei Bi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PureVision框架，通过几何监督和解剖引导的证据聚合，提升医学视觉语言模型对多表型病灶的解析能力，显著改善病灶定位与表型表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型在解释需要联合评估多个病理表型的病灶时表现不佳，主要因为其视觉表示无法保留解剖层次结构和表型子类之间的关系，且缺乏足够的解剖与表型表示来捕捉诊断关键证据。

Method: 提出PureVision框架，包含两个模块：PureEyes（几何监督表示学习）通过理想空间分布提供解剖层次与表型关系的几何约束；PureNeurons（解剖引导的证据聚合）利用位置信息在潜在空间中选择性聚合病灶相关的解剖与表型证据。

Result: 在LIDC-IDRI、CBIS-DDSM和3DReasonKnee数据集上的实验表明，PureVision显著提升了视觉问答和放射科报告生成中的病灶定位与表型刻画能力。

Conclusion: PureVision通过引入几何监督与解剖引导机制，有效解决了医学视觉语言模型在多表型病灶理解中的关键瓶颈，为临床图像解读提供了更准确、可解释的解决方案。

Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for clinical image interpretation. However, these models still struggle to interpret multi-phenotype lesions whose diagnosis requires the joint assessment of multiple pathological phenotypes. Existing vision-language alignment methods produce visual representations that fail to preserve anatomical hierarchies and relationships among phenotypic subclasses. This stems from their reliance on semantic supervision, which lacks geometric constraints to preserve these relationships in the visual embedding space. Moreover, the sparsity of lesion-related anatomical and phenotypic representations makes it difficult for medical VLMs to capture important diagnostic evidence. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{PureVision}, a geometry-supervised visual representation learning framework for multi-phenotype lesion interpretation in medical VLMs. It combines a geometry-supervised representation learning module, \textbf{PureEyes}, and an anatomy-guided evidence aggregation module, \textbf{PureNeurons}. PureEyes provides geometric supervision through ideal spatial distributions that encode anatomical hierarchies and phenotypic subclass relationships. PureNeurons projects visual representations into the learned latent space, using their positions to selectively aggregate lesion-specific anatomical and phenotypic evidence. Experiments on \textit{LIDC-IDRI}, \textit{CBIS-DDSM}, and \textit{3DReasonKnee} demonstrate that PureVision improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization in visual question answering and radiology report generation. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/purevision-06C2.

</details>


### [127] [LoomSC: Scalable Deep Subspace Clustering with Projector Factorization and Exact Spectral Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10266)
*Nairouz Mrabah,Youssef Melki,Mohamed Bouguessa,Riadh Ksantini,Shakeeb Murtaza,Tehseen Zia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoomSC提出了一种基于潜在正交优化的子空间聚类框架，通过投影因子分解和精确谱降维解决密集自表达矩阵和全相似度谱聚类带来的可扩展性问题。该方法联合学习潜在特征与投影自表示，利用交替Procrustes和最小二乘更新保持样本因子正交性，并隐式处理系数矩阵。构建非负二次亲和力以保留投影支持，通过精确特征映射将归一化谱问题转化为仅依赖于因子宽度的特征值问题，避免显式构造完整亲和矩阵或样本拉普拉斯矩阵。理论分析量化了投影近似，明确了子空间保持与子空间内连通性的条件。在固定维度和迭代预算下，整个流程具有线性时间与内存复杂度。在五个图像聚类基准测试中，LoomSC在15个数据集-指标组合中均排名第一或第二，平均准确率比最高基线高出6.66个百分点；合成实验可扩展至50万样本，精度保持在99.8%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有子空间聚类方法受限于密集自表达矩阵和全相似度谱聚类导致的可扩展性瓶颈，难以处理大规模数据。

Method: 提出LoomSC框架，采用投影因子分解和精确谱降维，通过交替Procrustes与最小二乘更新联合学习潜在特征与投影自表示，构造非负二次亲和力，实现特征映射下的低维特征值问题求解。

Result: 在五大数据集上性能全面领先，平均准确率超越最强基线6.66个百分点；合成数据可扩展至50万样本且精度保持99.8%以上。

Conclusion: LoomSC实现了高效、可扩展的子空间聚类，在大规模数据下仍能保持高精度，为解决传统方法的计算瓶颈提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Dense self-expression matrices and full-affinity spectral clustering limit the scalability of subspace clustering. We introduce the Latent Orthogonal Optimization Model for Subspace Clustering (LoomSC), a framework that addresses both bottlenecks through projector factorization and exact spectral reduction. Motivated by the spectral structure of least-squares regression, LoomSC jointly learns latent features and a projector self-representation through two thin factors. Alternating Procrustes and least-squares updates preserve the sample factor's orthogonality while keeping the coefficient matrix implicit. We construct a nonnegative quadratic affinity that preserves the projector's support. An exact feature map then reduces its normalized spectral problem to an eigenproblem whose dimension depends only on the factor width. Neither the full affinity nor the sample Laplacian needs to be formed. Our analysis quantifies the projector approximation and identifies conditions for subspace preservation and within-subspace connectivity. For fixed dimensions and iteration budgets, the complete pipeline has linear time and memory complexity in the number of samples. Across five image-clustering benchmarks, LoomSC ranks first or second in all 15 dataset-metric comparisons against 9 state-of-the-art baselines. Its mean accuracy exceeds the highest baseline mean by 6.66 percentage points. Synthetic experiments scale to 500,000 samples while maintaining at least 99.8% accuracy.

</details>


### [128] [Video Prediction Policy 2: Predict Better, Act Better](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10270)
*Yanjiang Guo,Haodong Yan,Zhide Zhong,Zhongru Zhang,Qingyuan Yang,Qingzhou Lu,Xiaoyu Chen,Yen-Jen Wang,Shuying Deng,Chenghan Yang,Puzhen Yuan,Chenxin Liu,Tun Ban,Xiang Zhu,Yichen Liu,Kun Feng,Haoang Li,Jianyu Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VPP2 是一种新型的世界动作模型（WAM），通过大规模多样化操作视频数据集的持续预训练和事件级视频预训练，提升了视频预测与动作生成的零样本泛化能力。其采用单步视觉规划器与混合变换器（MoT）架构的动作模块，显著优于现有方法，在多个基准测试中表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）在开放环境中的运动预测常出错，导致错误动作；主要原因是基础视频模型未针对操作任务优化，且简单引入动作组件会损害模型泛化能力。

Method: 1. 构建大规模、多样化的操作视频数据集，对基础视频模型进行持续预训练，并进行事件级视频预训练以增强泛化性；2. 将视频模型后训练并压缩为固定预测时长的单步视觉规划器；3. 采用混合变换器（MoT）架构引入动作模块，学习隐式逆动力学模型。

Result: 1. VPP2-14B 在开放任务的视频预测指令遵循成功率上比 Cosmos3-64B 高 11.0 个百分点；2. 在真实世界零样本 ALOHA 操控任务中，成功率达 18.5 个百分点领先最强基线；3. 经过特定基准微调后，VPP2 在 LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-OOD 和 RoboDojo 基准上均达到最高成功率。

Conclusion: VPP2 通过优化视频模型预训练策略与创新的动作模块设计，实现了强大的零样本泛化能力，在视频预测与动作生成方面均显著超越现有方法，是当前最先进的通用机器人策略之一。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as an important class of generalist robot policies, aiming to transfer video prediction priors to action learning. However, we find that existing WAMs frequently produce incorrect motion predictions in open-ended environment, leading to erroneous actions. We attribute this limitation to two factors: (1) base video models are not optimized for manipulation, and (2) naively incorporating action components into video models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities. We introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that enables strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. First, we curate a large-scale, diverse dataset of manipulation videos to continue pretraining the base video foundation model. We annotate video clips with detailed captions and perform \textit{event-level} video pretraining to promote generalization across open-ended manipulation tasks. Second, we post-train and distill the video model into a single-step visual planner with fixed prediction horizon. Finally, we introduce action module via a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture to learn implicit inverse dynamics model. Experiments demonstrate three key results: (1) VPP2-14B outperforms Cosmos3-64B by 11.0\% points in video prediction instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks; (2) VPP2 surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.5\% points in success rate on real-world zero-shot ALOHA manipulation tasks; and (3) following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on the challenging LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-OOD, and RoboDojo benchmarks.

</details>


### [129] [$Δ$Representation: Geometry Supervised Representation Learning of Phenotypes via Counterfactual Reasoning for Medical VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10286)
*Hao Wang,Qiwei Zeng,Jinghao Lin,Shuchang Ye,Yuezhe Yang,Yige Peng,Haoyuan Che,Jinman Kim,Lei Bi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出$Δ$Representation框架，通过反事实推理学习病灶特异性表征，利用几何监督的基线解剖结构模块（BaseAnatomy）和增量式表征学习模块（$Δ$Phenotype），提升医学视觉语言模型在病灶定位与表型识别中的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通过语义引导对齐来增强病理表型表征，但无法建模病灶引起的相对于正常解剖结构的特定变化，导致表型表征不精准。

Method: $Δ$Representation框架包含BaseAnatomy模块（基于空间关系进行几何监督）和$Δ$Phenotype模块（计算病灶与对应正常结构之间的表征增量，并使相同表型的增量在表示空间中聚类）。

Result: 在ReXGroundingCT和LIDC-IDRI数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效提升了病灶定位与表型表征的准确率。

Conclusion: $Δ$Representation通过反事实推理机制，更精确地建模病灶相关的表型变化，显著增强了医学视觉语言模型对病理表型的理解能力。

Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for radiological image interpretation. Medical VLMs encode radiological images into visual representations that capture both anatomical and phenotypic information for diagnosis. Existing approaches improve pathological phenotype representations through semantic-guided representation alignment. However, pathological phenotypes arise as lesion-specific visual changes superimposed on underlying normal anatomy. Such semantic alignment approaches fail to model the phenotype-specific increment relative to the corresponding normal anatomical representation. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{$Δ$Representation}, a visual phenotype representation learning framework based on counterfactual reasoning for medical VLMs. It comprises \textbf{BaseAnatomy}, a geometry-supervised representation learning module, and \textbf{$Δ$Phenotype}, a counterfactual incremental representation learning module. BaseAnatomy provides fine-grained geometric supervision through spatial relationships across and within anatomical structures. $Δ$Phenotype computes the representation increment between lesion representations and their corresponding normal anatomical representations, and supervises increments associated with the same phenotype to cluster in the representation space. Experiments on \textit{ReXGroundingCT} and \textit{LIDC-IDRI} demonstrate that $Δ$Representation effectively structures pathological phenotype representations and improves lesion grounding and phenotype characterization accuracy in medical VLMs. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/deltarep-CF6D.

</details>


### [130] [TouchScale: 500 Hours of Human Vision and Touch for Visual-Tactile Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10288)
*Dayou Li,Hao Wang,Qianqian Yang,Zihao Zhu,Haoquan Fang,Ziyao Zeng,Yan Han,Zihan Wang,Yan Wang,Baoru Huang,Dilin Wang,Kenji Shimada,Yiyue Luo,Manling Li,Teresa Lv,Mustafa Mukadam,Rakesh Ranjan,Ruohan Zhang,Qi He,Changliu Liu,Xu Chen,Marco Pavone,Bangya Liu,Jiachen Li,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Zhiwen Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了TouchScale，一个包含500小时接触丰富的日常人类交互数据的大型统一可穿戴传感器数据集。该数据集同步记录了第一人称RGB-D视频、手腕RGB视频和全手双臂密集触觉信号，涵盖约2000个预定义任务。相比以往触觉数据，使用完整TouchScale训练可使未见过的触觉传感器上的零样本接触交并比（IoU）从0.134提升至0.383；在视觉-触觉预训练中，其在三个基准测试上实现了最高的动作识别准确率。用于机器人策略的视觉-触觉中段训练时，平均真实世界成功率从22.5%提升至57.5%。随着数据量增加，零样本触觉预测与机器人成功率持续上升，表明一致传感条件下大规模人类视觉-触觉数据对感知与机器人操作均有显著益处。数据集将公开发布，以支持未来可扩展的视觉-触觉学习研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-触觉数据集虽然提供了物理交互中的触觉监督，但其同步触觉数据量远小于人类视频，且常混合不同传感器或标注流程，难以分离数据规模的影响。因此需要一个统一、大规模、高一致性的人类视觉-触觉数据集来推动可扩展学习研究。

Method: 构建并收集一个统一可穿戴系统采集的500小时人类交互数据，包含第一人称RGB-D视频、手腕视频与全手双臂密集触觉信号，所有数据时间对齐，并提供2000个预定义任务描述。通过在多个下游任务中评估数据规模影响，验证其有效性。

Result: 使用完整TouchScale可使零样本触觉预测的接触IoU从0.134提升至0.383；视觉-触觉预训练在三个人工智能基准上达到最高动作识别准确率；机器人策略在四类接触密集操作中平均成功率从22.5%提高到57.5%。数据量越大，性能越优，表现出良好的可扩展性。

Conclusion: 在固定传感器与采集协议的前提下，大规模、一致的视觉-触觉人类交互数据能显著提升感知与机器人操作性能，证明了数据规模与一致性对可扩展视觉-触觉学习的关键作用。数据集将公开发布，以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Large-scale egocentric human interaction data is becoming an important source of physical supervision for embodied learning, yet video alone leaves the contact and pressure that characterize physical interaction unrecorded. Recent visual-tactile datasets provide this missing supervision, but their synchronized tactile data remain far smaller in volume than human video. Moreover, the largest resources often merge recordings from different sensors or annotation procedures, which makes the effect of data scale difficult to isolate. We therefore introduce TouchScale, a 500-hour dataset of contact-rich human interaction recorded with a single unified wearable setup. Its approximately 2K predefined task descriptions span everyday activities and structured manipulation, and each recording temporally aligns egocentric RGB-D video with wrist RGB video and dense full-hand bimanual tactile measurements. Compared with prior tactile data, training on the full TouchScale raises zero-shot contact IoU on data from an unseen tactile sensor from 0.134 to 0.383. Pretraining a visual encoder on TouchScale also yields the highest action recognition accuracy on three benchmarks among the compared visual-tactile datasets. Used for visual-tactile mid-training of a robot policy, TouchScale improves the average real-world success rate across four contact-rich manipulation tasks from 22.5% to 57.5%. With the sensor and collection protocol held fixed, both zero-shot tactile prediction and robot success show an overall upward trend as more TouchScale data is used. These results suggest that human visual-tactile data collected at scale with consistent sensing benefits both perception and robot manipulation. We will publicly release TouchScale, including all synchronized visual-tactile recordings and reconstructed object models, to support future research on scalable visual-tactile learning.

</details>


### [131] [On the Necessity of Attention-FFN Split in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10303)
*Junhyeok Kim,Jinyeong Kim,Jae Wan Park,Seong Jae Hwang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的AttenFeed模块，将注意力与前馈网络功能融合，构建了uViT模型，以系统检验视觉Transformer中注意力与前馈网络交替结构的必要性。实验表明，该二元结构在小模型规模下会因参数分配僵化而限制性能，揭示了传统ViT架构的启发式设计局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究视觉Transformer中注意力与前馈网络交替结构是否为必要设计，分析其带来的归纳偏置对模型性能的影响。

Method: 提出AttenFeed模块，整合注意力与前馈网络功能；基于此构建统一的uViT模型，替代传统ViT的交替结构，并进行多数据集、多规模对比实验。

Result: 在较小模型规模下，传统注意力-前馈网络交替结构存在性能瓶颈，而uViT通过灵活参数分配表现出更优性能，验证了原结构的局限性。

Conclusion: 注意力与前馈网络的严格分离并非必要，其僵化结构可能限制模型表现，引入统一模块可提供新视角理解ViT架构设计。

Abstract: The standard Transformer architecture relies on a rigid pattern that alternates Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) layers. Despite its widespread adoption, the inductive bias imposed by this strict separation has not been systematically examined. In this work, we investigate the necessity of the Attention-FFN dichotomy in Vision Transformers (ViTs). To facilitate this analysis, we introduce the AttenFeed module, a unified component that integrates the functional properties of both Attention and FFN. Based on this module, we devise the unified Vision Transformer (uViT), which replaces the conventional alternating Attention-FFN structure with a sequence of AttenFeed modules. We then use uViT as a control group that relaxes the Attention-FFN dichotomy of the standard ViT and systematically compare the two models across multiple datasets and model scales. Our experiments reveal that the Attention-FFN dichotomy can hinder performance at smaller model scales due to the rigid parameter allocation of ViTs. The AttenFeed module and uViT serve as new analytical tools for understanding the Attention-FFN structure and offer theoretical insights into the heuristically designed architecture of conventional ViTs.

</details>


### [132] [One-Shot Adaptive Segmentation For Scientific Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10306)
*Tejaswi V. Panchagnula,Allison M. Davis,Fengqing Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需训练、仅需单张标注参考图像的科学图像分割框架，利用DINOv3特征与自适应背景特征正交化抑制伪影相关特征方向，通过余弦相似度定位候选区域并结合SAM进行分割。在红细胞显微镜、结构光照明显微池沸腾和胸部X光片上验证，相比最强基线，显微镜和池沸腾数据集的平均IoU分别提升5.91%和78.62%，胸部影像表现相当，证明了单次参考条件可有效适配通用视觉模型至专业科学分割任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学图像分割方法依赖大量标注和特定任务训练，难以跨成像模态和实验条件迁移。需要一种无需训练、快速适应新任务的通用方法。

Method: 使用DINOv3提取图像特征，结合背景自适应特征正交化抑制伪影相关特征方向，通过余弦相似度定位候选区域，并调用SAM进行最终分割。

Result: 在红细胞显微镜和池沸腾数据集上，平均IoU分别提升5.91%和78.62%；在胸部X光片上性能与现有方法相当。

Conclusion: 单次参考图像条件能够有效将通用视觉模型适配到特定科学图像分割任务中，具备良好的泛化能力与实用性。

Abstract: Scientific image segmentation methods rely on extensive annotation and task-specific training, limiting adaptation across imaging modalities and experimental conditions. We present a training-free, one-shot framework that specializes vision foundation models using a single annotated reference image. The framework combines DINOv3 representations with background-adaptive feature orthogonalization to suppress artifact-related feature directions, after which cosine similarity localizes candidate regions for SAM segmentation. We evaluate the framework on red-blood-cell microscopy, structured-illumination pool boiling, and chest radiography. Relative to the strongest baseline, the proposed method improves mean IoU by 5.91% and 78.62% on the microscopy and pool-boiling datasets, respectively, while achieving comparable performance on chest radiographs. These results demonstrate that one-shot reference conditioning can adapt general-purpose vision models to specialized scientific segmentation tasks.

</details>


### [133] [From Digital Human Interactions to Physics-Based Humanoid Skills: Physics-Grounded Post-Training of Interaction Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10322)
*Kerui Chen,Jianrong Zhang,Kai Lv,Hehe Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DIGHT框架，通过将数字人类交互生成器与人形机器人跟踪策略协同优化，提升交互动作的物理合理性与执行可靠性。利用模拟中多候选交互的物理反馈构建偏好信号，分别优化可执行性与交互保真度，并采用去耦合的扩散直接偏好优化（DPO）对生成器进行对齐，从而提高生成动作与实际执行之间的兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖物理追踪策略将参考动作转化为可执行轨迹，但受限于追踪能力，难以覆盖广泛的动作类型，且即使成功追踪也未必保证物理合理或真实交互效果。因此需要一种能同时优化生成与执行一致性的新方法。

Method: DIGHT框架包括两阶段：1）在模拟中运行多个文本条件下的交互候选动作，基于物理表现（如追踪误差、摩擦、漂移）和接触力反馈（接触发生、位置、持续时间、力大小）构建多维度偏好；2）使用物理解耦的扩散直接偏好优化（DPO）对预训练生成器进行对齐，保留各准则监督信息，再用对齐后的生成器为跟踪器提供参考动作进行微调，增强生成与执行的兼容性。

Result: 实验表明，DIGHT显著提升了生成动作的物理合理性，增强了人形机器人在模拟中交互的可靠性和真实性，支持更复杂、多样化的交互场景。

Conclusion: DIGHT通过协同优化生成与跟踪，实现了更真实、可靠的物理交互，为复杂人形机器人交互生成提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Recent methods have made promising progress in generating interactions between two humanoids, largely relying on physics-based tracking policies to convert digital reference motions into executable trajectories. However, limited tracking capabilities restrict the range of reference motions that can be successfully executed, reducing data utilization. Moreover, even successful tracking does not guarantee physically plausible responses or faithful realization of the intended interactions. In this paper, we introduce DIGHT, a co-adaptive framework that couples a Digital human Interaction Generator with a Humanoid Tracking policy. Our DIGHT first executes multiple text-conditioned interaction candidates in simulation using a fixed tracker. It then constructs physics-grounded preferences from the resulting rollouts, covering both general executability and interaction fidelity. Rather than collapsing these signals into a single scalar reward for candidate ranking, we align the pretrained generator using physics-decoupled diffusion direct preference optimization (DPO), preserving criterion-specific supervision without differentiating through the simulator. To improve executability, preference pairs are derived from tracking error, friction, and floating. Additionally, to improve interaction fidelity, we propose to incorporate force feedback from simulator as a measure of contact fidelity and construct preferences over contact occurrence, location, duration, and force magnitude. The aligned generator then supplies reference motions for fine-tuning the tracker, improving compatibility between generation and physical execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only improves the physical plausibility of generated motions but also enables more reliable and faithful humanoid interactions in simulation.

</details>


### [134] [Performance at What Cost? A Sustainability-Aware Performance Index for Cell and Nucleus Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10324)
*Eiram Mahera Sheikh,Alaa Tharwat,Wolfram Schenck*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可持续性感知性能指数（SAPI），用于综合评估细胞和细胞核实例分割模型的分割性能、能耗和模型规模。通过在六个CellBinDB数据集上对19个预训练模型进行零样本推理，并对16个可微调模型进行少样本适应，研究发现更大的模型并不一定带来成比例的性能提升，且不同模型在资源消耗与性能增益之间存在显著差异。该研究为生物医学图像分析中的模型选择提供了更全面的评估框架，支持更节能、计算成本更低的模型选型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大型预训练和基础模型虽具备强大的零样本能力，但其高能耗、高内存需求和高碳排放等问题日益突出，亟需评估这些额外开销是否带来实质性的分割性能提升。

Method: 引入可持续性感知性能指数（SAPI），结合分割性能、能源消耗和模型大小构建可配置评估指标；使用软件监控工具估算GPU、CPU和内存的能耗；在多个数据集上测试零样本推理与少样本微调策略下的模型表现。

Result: 大模型并未持续带来性能优势；少样本微调对部分模型有帮助，但收益与资源消耗因架构、数据集和策略而异；基于SAPI的排名与仅基于性能的排名存在差异，表明应综合考虑可持续性因素。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了一个更全面的模型比较框架，有助于在生物医学图像分析中做出更可持续、计算成本更低的模型选择。

Abstract: Pretrained models for cell and nuclear instance segmentation differ substantially in architecture, pretraining data and objectives, parameter count, inference strategy, adaptation requirements, postprocessing pipeline, and computational demand. Large pretrained and foundation models are increasingly adopted because of their strong zero-shot capabilities, but their use also imposes greater energy consumption, memory requirements, computational demands, adaptation costs, and operational carbon emissions. Whether these additional demands are justified by meaningful gains in segmentation performance remains unclear. We address this question by introducing the Sustainability-Aware Performance Index (SAPI), a configurable metric that combines segmentation performance, energy consumption, and model size. We benchmark 19 pretrained and foundation models across six CellBinDB datasets under zero-shot inference and evaluate 16 fine-tunable models using few-shot adaptation with both frozen encoder and full-model fine-tuning. We estimate energy consumption for GPU, CPU, and RAM using software-based monitoring tools. Our results show that larger and more computationally demanding models do not consistently achieve proportionate improvements in segmentation quality. While few-shot adaptation benefits several models, the gains and resource costs vary considerably across architectures, datasets, and adaptation strategies, causing SAPI-based rankings to differ from rankings based on performance alone. This study provides a practical framework for comparing segmentation models more comprehensively and supports more computationally accessible and environmentally responsible model selection in biomedical image analysis.

</details>


### [135] [How Private is Private? A Comparative Study for Face De-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10334)
*Hui Wei,Hao Yu,Hui Kuurila-Zhang,Guoying Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出UtilFace基准和HiFD评估指标，统一面部去标识化（FDeID）的评价标准，解决现有方法在数据和度量上的不一致问题。利用高多样性、均衡的基准数据集与分层度量框架，实现对身份抑制与多层级效用保留的综合评估，并通过实验揭示不同方法间的权衡与缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面部去标识化方法的评估体系存在度量不一致、数据集异质性以及标注覆盖不全等问题，导致不同方法间难以进行有效比较。为提升评估的系统性和可复现性，亟需一个统一且全面的评价框架。

Method: 引入UtilFace基准数据集，通过身份感知清洗、分辨率增强和分层筛选整合四个大规模人脸数据集；提出HiFD评估指标，基于预训练模型输出，构建包含身份抑制、多层次效用保留（宏观、微观、不可察觉线索）和图像质量的分层评估体系，采用加权调和平均生成可解释的综合得分。

Result: 实验表明，新协议能有效揭示传统评估下被忽略的方法优劣与失败模式，验证了该框架在跨方法比较中的优越性；所提出的基准与工具包已公开，推动隐私保护的人脸分析研究向系统化、可复现方向发展。

Conclusion: 建立统一的评估协议是推动面部去标识化技术发展的关键。本工作通过构建高质量基准与设计一致性度量框架，实现了对身份隐私与视觉效用之间平衡的精准量化，为未来研究提供了可靠基础。

Abstract: Face de-identification (FDeID) has emerged as a critical privacy-preserving technology, yet its evaluation remains fundamentally fragmented. Existing protocols rely on inconsistent metrics, heterogeneous datasets, and partial annotation coverage, so methods targeting different utility dimensions, such as landmark versus expression preservation, are reported on different benchmarks under different metrics, rendering cross-method comparison infeasible. We revisit FDeID evaluation from both the data and metric perspectives. On the data side, we introduce UtilFace, a curated, demographically balanced benchmark with high identity diversity, assembled from four large-scale face datasets through identity-aware cleaning, resolution enhancement, and stratified filtering. On the metric side, we propose HiFD, a Hierarchical Face De-identification metric that unifies identity suppression, multi-level utility preservation, and image quality under a single consistency-based paradigm: every component is computed from pretrained estimators' outputs on the original face and its de-identified counterpart, directly quantifying how much identity is suppressed and how much downstream-perceivable utility survives. HiFD organizes facial signals into a three-level utility hierarchy spanning macro cues (L1), micro cues (L2), and imperceptible cues (L3), and aggregates the five resulting components into a single interpretable score via weighted harmonic mean, with configurable application-specific profiles. Using this unified protocol, we conduct a comprehensive comparative study spanning adversarial, GAN-based, and diffusion-based methods, surfacing trade-offs and failure modes that remain invisible under existing protocols. We release the benchmark and evaluation toolkit to foster systematic and reproducible research in privacy-preserving human face analysis.

</details>


### [136] [When to Unpair: Regulating Pairing Dependence in Medical Visual In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10335)
*Cheng Wan,Chenjun Li,Qingyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了视觉上下文学习（ICL）在医疗影像中的应用，发现现有模型严重依赖支持图像与标签的配对关系。通过测试时打乱标签配对的方法，揭示了所有评估模型均存在不同程度的配对依赖问题。进一步分析显示，即使使用真实未修改的支持样本，模型仍表现出与支持样本相关的虚假区域和病灶大小偏差，并对标签错配敏感。为此，作者提出一种后期解配对课程（LUC），先进行匹配训练，再引入随机解配对，显著缩小了配对差距，同时保持或提升了匹配支持下的性能，且在新任务和跨数据集场景中表现良好。实验表明，该方法有效缓解了模型的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉上下文学习模型在医疗影像任务中依赖于支持图像与标签的精确配对，但这种依赖可能导致模型在实际应用中出现偏差和错误，尤其在标签错配或数据分布变化时表现不佳。因此需要研究并解决这一配对依赖问题。

Method: 提出一种晚期解配对课程（LUC），在训练初期使用匹配的图像-标签对，随后引入随机解配对策略，即在每个训练批次中将支持标签随机重新分配给其他支持图像，以减少模型对特定配对的依赖。此外，还对比了不同训练顺序的影响，包括反向课程（早期解配对）的效果。

Result: LUC方法显著减小了配对差距，在多个骨干网络上几乎消除了配对差异，同时保持或提升了匹配支持下的性能；在BraTS全肿瘤分割任务中，匹配支持的Dice分数从0.733提升至0.857，配对差距由-0.184缩小至-0.008。简短微调结合随机解配对也能有效降低差距。而反向课程则无法消除差距，说明训练顺序对配对依赖有重要影响。

Conclusion: 模型的配对依赖不仅取决于训练中解配对的数量，更受训练顺序的影响。采用后期解配对课程（LUC）可有效缓解这一问题，提高模型鲁棒性和泛化能力，为视觉上下文学习在医疗影像中的可靠应用提供支持。

Abstract: Visual in-context learning (ICL), well suited to label-scarce medical imaging, uses support image-label pairs to demonstrate input-output mappings, while the labels collectively indicate the requested task. We diagnose dependence on individual pairings with a test-time derangement that reassigns every support label to another support image while preserving the query, support images, and label multiset. The resulting pairing gap, defined as shuffled-minus-matched performance, shows that all four released models depend on the pairing, to widely varying degrees. Further analysis of a paired-trained model reveals support-associated spurious regions and lesion-size biases even with real, unaltered supports, alongside sensitivity to mis-registered support labels. To regulate this dependence, we introduce a late unpairing curriculum (LUC), which starts with matched training and then applies random unpairing, replacing each support label with that of another support in the same episode. LUC nearly closes the pairing gap on two backbones while maintaining or improving matched-support performance across all evaluated task types, with gains extending to held-out tasks and cross-dataset episodes. It also mitigates these failure modes. On BraTS whole-tumor segmentation, matched-support DSC rises from 0.733 to 0.857 while the gap shrinks from -0.184 to -0.008. In a released model, brief fine-tuning with random unpairing reduces the gap. A reversed curriculum that places the same number of unpairing epochs at the start of training leaves a large gap. This shows that pairing dependence is shaped by the order of training and not only by the amount of unpaired training.

</details>


### [137] [Position Forcing: Self-Conditioning 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10342)
*Ziheng Ouyang,Zeqiang Lai,Jiarui Chen,Jiangshan Wang,Yuhao Wan,Jingbo Gong,Xiangyu Yue,Hengshuang Zhao,Qibin Hou,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Position Forcing框架，通过在去噪过程中恢复并逐步细化潜在标记的位置编码，为单阶段3D生成模型提供细粒度的空间引导，显著提升生成质量，无需额外的位置生成阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单阶段3D生成模型使用无序的VecSet表示，缺乏显式的位置引导，导致去噪过程中需隐式推断位置，限制生成质量。

Method: 提出Position Forcing，通过从当前干净的潜在估计中恢复标记位置，按去噪阶段逐步细化分辨率，并将量化的位置编码反馈至扩散Transformer中，实现渐进式的空间引导。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在单阶段3D生成中表现优异，超越多个多阶段方法，显著提升生成质量。

Conclusion: Position Forcing有效利用了VecSet中隐含的空间对应关系，通过自条件化的位置反馈，在不增加复杂性的前提下实现了高质量的3D形状生成。

Abstract: Recent single-stage 3D generative models commonly adopt VecSet representations, encoding 3D shapes as unordered sets of latent tokens. However, compared with two-stage methods that provide explicit positional guidance, these models must implicitly infer token positions throughout denoising, limiting their generation quality. We observe that, despite the absence of explicit positional conditioning, VecSet tokens retain recoverable spatial correspondences. Building on this observation, we propose Position Forcing, a position-based self-conditioning framework. During denoising, Position Forcing recovers token positions from the current clean latent estimate, quantizes them at progressively finer resolutions according to the denoising stage, and feeds the resulting positional encodings back into the diffusion Transformer. This progressively refined positional feedback provides spatial guidance at a granularity appropriate to each denoising stage, guiding shape generation along a coarse-to-fine trajectory and substantially improving generation quality without a separate position generation stage. Experiments demonstrate that Position Forcing achieves strong performance among single-stage 3D generative methods and outperforms several competitive multi-stage approaches.

</details>


### [138] [Real-Time Joint Audio-Video Generation by Parallel Adapter Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10343)
*Jingyu Li,Xiaoxiao Xiang,Yiwen Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种并行方法，通过在音频-视频骨干网络上同时引入因果适配器和少步采样适配器，实现低延迟、实时的音视频生成。两个适配器分别负责流式处理与快速采样，其权重更新方向近正交，无需显式约束即可无干扰组合，推理时直接相加，无需联合训练。该方法在保持双向教师模型画质的同时，达到约26帧/秒的实时生成速度，并支持30秒连续生成，性能优于传统链式方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统流式视频生成依赖链式管道，依次进行双向到因果、再到少步采样的转换，各阶段训练可能相互抵消先前能力，导致性能损失。为解决此问题，需探索更高效、无干扰的并行能力集成方式。

Method: 采用模型合并思想，在冻结的音频-视频骨干网络基础上，独立训练因果适配器（实现流式生成）和现成的少步采样适配器（实现快速采样），利用两者权重更新方向近正交的特性，直接在推理时将两适配器叠加使用，实现无需联合训练的并行组合。

Result: 所提方法在多项指标上优于或持平于链式基线模型，实现了真实世界中约26帧/秒的实时生成速度（480×832分辨率，无量化），并可稳定持续生成长达30秒的高质量音视频内容。

Conclusion: 通过并行添加因果与少步采样适配器，可在不牺牲画质的前提下实现高效的实时、交互式音视频生成，且无需复杂联合训练，是一种可行且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Deploying a joint audio-video diffusion transformer for real-time, interactive generation normally requires two essential modifications: block-autoregressive attention, so frames can be emitted before the whole clip is finished, and few-step sampling, so each block is cheap. Conventionally, the streaming video literature obtains both capabilities from a chained pipeline. It first distills a bidirectional teacher into a causal student, then into a few-step one, or proceeds in reverse order. Each stage of such a chain fine-tunes the weights the previous one produced, so a later objective can undo an earlier capability. Following the idea of model merging, we show that on a packed audio-video backbone the two capabilities can be acquired in parallel. A causal adapter is trained against the frozen backbone, and an off-the-shelf few-step adapter provides the few-step capability. As the two edit different functional axes, we predict, and then verify, that their weight-update directions are near-orthogonal, without any explicit orthogonality constraint during training. Orthogonal updates should combine without interfering, so parallel composition is a direct sum. The two adapters are simply added at inference, with no joint training, yielding few-step, streaming audio-video whose image quality tracks the bidirectional teacher. Compared to the chained baselines, the composed model matches or beats them on most metrics, making parallel composition a practical approach. The resulting streaming system generates joint audio-video in real time, $\approx$26 fps at $480\times832$ without quantization, and sustains 30 s of continuous generation with stable image quality.

</details>


### [139] [Explicit Geometric Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10390)
*Xingtai Gui,Yucheng Zhou,Dongqian Guo,Jiahao Gong,Feiyang Tan,Jianbing Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoCoTDrive提出了一种显式的几何思维链框架，通过在规划导向下将几何信息融入视觉-语言-动作模型中，解决了2D语义理解与3D驾驶动作之间的不匹配问题。该方法先在2D空间定位关键决策区域，再从中采样几何基础模型的局部3D特征，并将其嵌入自回归上下文以生成轨迹。为监督此过程，提出了面向规划的区域级接地任务，并构建了PlanningGrounding数据集。实验表明，GeoCoTDrive在多个端到端自动驾驶基准上显著提升了安全关键的规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在自动驾驶中存在根本性不匹配：驾驶动作需要精确的3D几何线索，而视觉-语言理解主要在2D语义空间中进行，导致决策缺乏几何精度。

Method: 提出GeoCoTDrive框架，采用‘先2D思考，后3D驱动’的范式。首先在2D图像中定位决策关键区域，然后在这些区域内采样几何基础模型的局部3D特征，将这些特征融入自回归序列以支持轨迹生成。同时引入规划相关接地任务，并构建PlanningGrounding数据集用于训练和评估。

Result: 在多个端到端自动驾驶基准测试中，GeoCoTDrive显著提升了安全关键的规划性能，验证了显式几何思维链在基于VLA的规划中的有效性。

Conclusion: GeoCoTDrive通过显式地整合几何信息到视觉-语言-动作模型中，有效缓解了2D语义理解与3D驾驶动作之间的不匹配问题，显著提升自动驾驶系统的安全性与规划能力。

Abstract: Vision-language-action~(VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, existing VLA models still suffer from a fundamental mismatch: driving actions require precise 3D geometric cues, while visual-language understanding and reasoning are largely conducted in a 2D semantic space. In this paper, we propose GeoCoTDrive, an explicit geometric chain-of-thought framework that grounds geometry in a planning-oriented manner. GeoCoTDrive follows a think with 2D first, drive with dedicated 3D priors paradigm. It first grounds 2D regions corresponding to decision-critical cues, and then retrieves localized 3D priors by sampling features from a geometric foundation model within the grounded regions. These localized geometric features are interleaved into the autoregressive context to support the trajectory generation. To supervise this process, we introduce planning-relevant grounding, a new region-level grounding task that focuses on local spatial cues directly affecting ego planning decisions, and construct the PlanningGrounding dataset to endow VLAs with planning-oriented grounding capability. Experiments across multiple end-to-end autonomous driving benchmarks show that GeoCoTDrive consistently improves safety-critical planning performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of the explicit geometric chain-of-thought process for VLA-based planning.

</details>


### [140] [MOTIP2: Spatial Priors for End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10391)
*Benoît Roussel,Damien Bouet,Liming Chen,Pierre Perrault*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出三种空间先验（数据、损失、表示阶段）以改进端到端多目标跟踪器，解决其产生空间上不合理的身份分配错误问题。通过在MOTIP2框架中集成这些先验，无需额外数据训练，即在DanceTrack、SportsMOT和PersonPath22等基准上取得新SOTA性能，且模型具备不同速度-精度权衡的系列版本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有端到端多目标跟踪器虽在复杂关联任务上接近传统检测-跟踪方法，但仍会出现空间上不合理的行为（如将远距离物体赋予同一身份），而标注数据稀缺限制了通过学习规避此类错误。因此需显式编码空间先验以提升合理性。

Method: 提出三种空间先验：1）空间ID切换（基于轨迹排列偏向空间重叠对象）；2）空间ID损失（按框间距离加权惩罚，远距离误匹配代价更高）；3）空间锚点（为每个跟踪标记加入帧内位置信息作为注意力显式线索）。在基于DEIM检测变压器的MOTIP2框架中实现并验证。

Result: MOTIP2-L在DanceTrack上达到73.4 HOTA，SportsMOT上76.0 HOTA，PersonPath22上71.1 IDF1；轻量版MOTIP2-S速度超原版3倍，且精度相当；超大版MOTIP2-X在DanceTrack上达74.8 HOTA，均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过显式引入空间先验，MOTIP2实现了高精度、实时性与空间合理性兼顾的端到端多目标跟踪，且无需后处理关联，是当前最优方案之一。

Abstract: End-to-end multi-object trackers have narrowed the gap with classical tracking-by-detection on association-difficult benchmarks. Yet they still make spatially implausible errors no classical tracker would, such as assigning one identity to objects on opposite sides of the frame. A model could learn to avoid them, but tracking annotations are scarce, so we encode spatial priors explicitly instead, while keeping inference fully end-to-end with no post-hoc association.
  We propose three spatial priors, at the data, loss, and representation stages. Spatial ID Switches bias trajectory permutations toward spatially overlapping objects, reducing the mismatch between training and inference confusions. Spatial ID Loss scales each identity's penalty by its box distance, so a distant switch costs more than a nearby one. Spatial Anchor gives each track token its frame position, an explicit spatial cue for attention.
  We instantiate the three priors in MOTIP2, a tracker adapted from MOTIP and built on the real-time DEIM detection transformer. Trained without extra data, its main model, MOTIP2-L, sets a new state of the art: 73.4 HOTA on DanceTrack, 76.0 on SportsMOT, and 71.1 IDF1 on PersonPath22. MOTIP2 is a family of models spanning the speed-accuracy trade-off: a lighter model, MOTIP2-S, matches the original MOTIP at over 3x the speed, and MOTIP2-X reaches 74.8 HOTA on DanceTrack.

</details>


### [141] [Gaussian Density Splatting Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10396)
*Miao Shang,Yabin Wang,Xiaopeng Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GDSNet提出一种新的人群计数方法，通过连续2D高斯原型表示人群，避免了传统网格密度图对空间分辨率的依赖。该方法利用基于控制点的拟合机制和可微高斯点阵框架，实现端到端训练，并在四个基准数据集上显著优于现有技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统人群计数方法依赖于网格化的密度图，对空间分辨率敏感，难以准确捕捉密集人群分布。本文旨在提出一种更灵活、精确且可微分的密度表示方式，以提升计数精度和泛化能力。

Method: 引入基于控制点的参数拟合机制，通过局部特征池化回归每个高斯原型的参数；采用可微高斯点阵框架，将每个原型参数化为几何参数与标量密度质量，实现基于渲染密度图的空间匹配训练。

Result: 在四个标准基准数据集上的实验表明，GDSNet在各项指标上均优于当前最先进的方法，表现出更强的计数精度和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: GDSNet通过连续高斯原型建模人群分布，结合可微渲染与局部控制点结构，实现了高效、精准的人群计数，为复杂场景下的密度估计提供了新范式。

Abstract: This paper proposes a novel crowd counting approach, the Gaussian Density Splatting Network (GDSNet). Unlike methods that rely on conventional, grid-based density maps and are sensitive to spatial resolution, GDSNet represents a crowd as a superposition of continuous 2D Gaussian primitives. Our approach is built upon two key contributions. First, we introduce a control-point-based fitting mechanism to structure the prediction of the Gaussian parameters. We design a method to allocate a set of control points that define local regions, from which features are pooled to regress each primitive's parameters. Second, we adapt a differentiable Gaussian Splatting framework to the counting task by parameterizing each primitive with geometric parameters and a scalar density mass. This formulation allows the network to be trained end-to-end via spatial matching of differentiably rendered density maps, naturally providing both local density supervision and global count optimization. Extensive evaluations on four standard benchmarks show GDSNet consistently outperforms the state of the art.

</details>


### [142] [Self-correction Optimization for Interleaved Multimodal Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10400)
*Xin You,Zhiwei Ning,Zukai Chen,Minghui Zhang,Xuanke Shi,Hanxiao Zhang,Jingsong Liu,Jie Yang,Quan Wang,Yun Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需训练的自校正优化（SCO）方法，用于实现一致的图文交错生成。该方法通过新事件和状态保持约束，在不依赖额外训练数据的情况下，有效提升时间连贯性和视觉主体一致性，适用于视频生成及物理过程建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型在生成交错图文内容时面临时间一致性、视觉主体保持和物理合理性不足的问题，且多数解决方案依赖昂贵的额外训练。因此需要一种高效、无需训练的改进方法。

Method: 提出自校正优化（SCO），利用无分类器引导更新作为参考，施加新事件和状态保持双重约束，进行最小化自校正，以增强生成序列的一致性。

Result: 在多个挑战性基准测试中，SCO显著提升了生成内容的时间连贯性和视觉主体保真度；还能扩展至视频生成，改善机器人操作和长周期手工制作等物理过程的建模效果。

Conclusion: SCO是一种高效、无需训练的多模态生成优化方法，能够有效解决图文交错生成中的时间与视觉一致性问题，并具备良好的可扩展性。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding and generation. However, generating interleaved image--text content remains challenging, as it requires tightly integrated multimodal understanding and generation capabilities. Although existing MLLMs provide promising solutions, most rely on additional training with augmented data, which is computationally expensive and remains limited in preserving visual subjects, temporal consistency, and physical plausibility. In this work, we propose self-correction optimization (SCO), an effective training-free method for consistent interleaved generation. SCO treats the classifier-free guidance update as a reference and performs minimal self-correction under two complementary constraints, including new-event and state-preserving constraints. Specifically, the new-event constraint promotes temporal consistency across image--text sequences, while the state-preserving constraint maintains the coherence of visual subjects throughout subsequent generation steps. Experiments on challenging interleaved multimodal generation benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements in temporal coherence and visual-subject preservation. Furthermore, SCO can be extended to video generation and improves the modeling of physically grounded processes, including robot manipulation and long-horizon handcrafting.

</details>


### [143] [Rubix: Global Correspondence-Free Point Set Alignment through Assignment Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10408)
*Subhransu S. Bhattacharjee,Dylan Campbell,Rahul Shome*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Rubix提出了一种全局求解无对应点匹配与旋转问题的新方法，通过构造排列多边形（permutation polygon）来精确找到最优匹配和旋转，在精确算术下可在O(n^5)时间内完成。该方法在二维平面中可全局求解等权重问题，并扩展至三维旋转、部分匹配及给定平移的情形。在MPEG-7形状数据上平均仅需12毫秒，比传统旋转网格方法快50倍，显著提升3D扫描对齐、形状检索和噪声晶体分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法如交替最小化易陷入局部最优，缺乏对无对应点匹配与旋转问题的全局求解能力，尤其在复杂场景下性能受限。因此需要一种能保证全局最优且高效的方法来解决此类几何匹配问题。

Method: 基于中心化点集的排列多边形构造，利用复相关 $ z_\sigma = \sum_i \bar x_i y_{\sigma(i)} $ 表示每个匹配对应的几何关系；通过凸包分析支持顶点以确定最优匹配；结合分支定界法处理三维旋转与部分匹配问题。

Result: 证明了排列多边形最多有 $ n(n-1) $ 个顶点，解决了Rote关于旋转-分配问题的开放难题；在真实数据上实现亚毫秒级速度，优于交替最小化方法，在多种任务中取得更优结果。

Conclusion: Rubix实现了无对应点匹配与旋转问题的全局优化，具有理论完备性和实际高效性，为几何对齐任务提供了强有力的新工具。

Abstract: Procrustes-Wasserstein alignment jointly estimates a matching and rotation without supplied correspondences, but alternating minimization can stop at suboptimal solutions. Rubix solves the equally weighted planar problem globally under squared Euclidean loss. Each matching $σ$ of two centered $n$-point sets defines a complex correlation $z_σ=\sum_i\bar x_i y_{σ(i)}$. Their convex hull is the permutation polygon: supporting vertices give optimal matchings at fixed rotations, and the farthest vertex gives the global alignment. We prove the sharp bound of $n(n-1)$ vertices for $n\ge2$, answering Rote's rotation-assignment open problem. In exact arithmetic, assignment queries recover the polygon in $\mathcal O(n^5)$ operations. Assignment-based bounds extend the approach to three-dimensional rotations and partial matching at a supplied translation through branch-and-bound. On timed MPEG-7 shape pairs, Rubix attains every numerical reference value in 12 ms on average, 50 times faster than a rotation grid at the same accuracy. Its distances improve gravity-aligned matching of real 3D scans, shape retrieval and noisy crystal classification over alternating minimization.

</details>


### [144] [GraphRectify: Graph-Based Transfer of Adversarial Example Detectors Across Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10423)
*Arash Vashagh,Roozbeh Razavi-Far*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GraphRectify 是一种基于图的框架，用于在不同分类器主干之间迁移对抗性图像检测器。它通过学习中间特征的结构化表示，并将新主干的特征适配到原模型上训练的检测器，从而实现检测器复用。在多个数据集、主干架构和对抗攻击（包括针对检测器的自适应攻击）上评估，GraphRectify 在整体 ROC-AUC 上优于从头训练检测器或其它迁移方法，尤其在跨主干家族且数据充足时表现更优；而在数据极少时，从头训练仍具竞争力。结果表明，对抗检测知识可有效跨异构架构迁移，无需每次更换主干都重新学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗性示例检测器通常与特定分类器主干绑定，难以在模型替换或升级后复用；不同网络的内部表示不兼容，导致直接迁移困难。

Method: 提出 GraphRectify 框架，利用图结构建模中间特征的结构化表示，并通过特征适配机制将新主干的表示映射到原检测器所学空间，实现跨主干迁移。

Result: 在多数据集、多架构、多攻击场景下，GraphRectify 的平均 ROC-AUC 高于从头训练和其它迁移方法；在跨主干家族和数据充足时优势显著；数据受限时从头训练仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: 对抗性检测知识可有效跨异构分类器架构迁移，避免重复训练，提升检测器复用效率。

Abstract: Adversarial example detectors are often tied to the classifier backbone they were trained on, limiting reuse when the protected model is replaced or upgraded. Directly transferring such detectors across backbones is challenging because different networks generally produce incompatible internal representations. We propose GraphRectify, a graph-based framework for transferring adversarial image detectors across classifier backbones. GraphRectify learns a structured representation of intermediate classifier features and adapts representations from a new backbone to the detector learned on the original model, enabling detector reuse. We evaluate GraphRectify across multiple datasets, backbone architectures, and adversarial attacks, including detector-aware adaptive attacks that jointly target the classifier and detector. Across the complete evaluation matrix, GraphRectify achieves higher aggregate ROC-AUC than training a detector from scratch on the new backbone and the evaluated transfer ablations. The gains are particularly strong for transfers between different backbone families and when sufficient data are available. In contrast, training from scratch remains competitive in the most data-limited settings. These results show that adversarial detection knowledge can transfer effectively across heterogeneous classifier architectures rather than being relearned whenever the protected backbone changes.

</details>


### [145] [SGF+: Decoupling Gradient Flows for Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10429)
*Zihan Su,Junhao Zhuang,Yaowei Li,Siwen Lu,Haoran Li,Lingen Li,Haoyu Wu,Weiyang Jin,Songchun Zhang,Haoyang Huang,Chun Yuan,Zeyue Xue,Nan Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SGF+ introduces separate parameters for context writing and denoising in autoregressive video generation, improving visual quality and long-horizon consistency without additional data or training. It enables up to 24-hour continuous generation from just 5s rollouts.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing autoregressive video generation methods suffer from negative gradient alignment between denoising and context writing due to shared parameters, limiting visual quality and temporal consistency.

Method: SGF+ assigns distinct parameters to denoising and context writing while maintaining interaction via causal attention; both are jointly optimized using the original generation objective with supervision based on future prediction contributions.

Result: SGF+ achieves better visual quality and long-horizon consistency compared to baselines, supports continuous generation up to 24 hours without fine-tuning, and works effectively with only 5s training rollouts.

Conclusion: Role-specific parameterization is a powerful design principle for high-quality autoregressive video generation and enables native long-horizon extrapolation.

Abstract: Autoregressive video generation requires denoising the current frames while writing their key-value representations as context for future predictions. However, these two roles typically share parameters, and we find that their gradients exhibit distinct patterns and systematic negative alignment, hindering the joint optimization of visual quality and temporal consistency. We introduce Self Gradient Forcing Plus (SGF+), which assigns separate parameters to context writing and denoising while preserving their interaction through causal attention. Both roles are jointly optimized using the original generation objective without auxiliary losses, with context writing supervised through its contribution to future predictions. This simple change improves visual quality and long-horizon consistency over the evaluated baselines in both framewise and chunkwise generation, without additional video training data or a longer training horizon. Trained on only 5s rollouts, SGF+ supports continuous generation for up to 24 hours without long-video fine-tuning. These results highlight role-specific parameterization as an effective design principle for high-quality autoregressive video generation and native long-horizon extrapolation.

</details>


### [146] [Detecting Adversarial Images through Response Profiles of Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10436)
*Arash Vashagh,Roozbeh Razavi-Far*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）对通用语义提示响应模式的对抗样本检测方法，通过分析图像在多个语义提示下的响应统计特征、提示间关系、与干净数据分布的偏差以及弱图像变换下的稳定性，构建紧凑的响应特征表示，并由轻量级分类器进行判别。该方法在多种攻击类型和模型架构上表现优异，具备良好的泛化能力，且在推理成本可控的前提下优于现有嵌入几何基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击可误导冻结的视觉语言模型，但其置信度和图文相似性仍看似合理，难以被传统方法识别。因此需要一种能够捕捉图像在广泛语义提示下响应模式异常的检测机制，以提供额外的鲁棒性保障。

Method: 利用多组通用语义提示对输入图像进行响应分析，提取类别级统计、提示间关系、与干净参考分布的偏离度及弱变换下的稳定性等特征，形成紧凑的响应特征向量，再由轻量级分类器判断是否为对抗样本，整个过程中保持VLM冻结不变。

Result: 所提方法在多种公开数据集、不同CLIP类视觉主干网络及各类攻击（梯度、优化、自动化、空间攻击）下均表现出强区分能力；在未见过的攻击上仍保持良好性能；响应特征表示优于现有嵌入几何方法；特征组间信息互补，对提示配置变化具有鲁棒性；推理开销小，对检测器感知型自适应攻击仍有一定防御效果。

Conclusion: 图像在多个语义提示下的响应模式可作为冻结式视觉语言模型中对抗样本检测的有力补充信号，具有实用价值与泛化潜力。

Abstract: Adversarial perturbations can alter the predictions of frozen vision-language models (VLMs) while leaving their confidence and image--text similarity patterns seemingly plausible. We investigate whether we can identify adversarial inputs based on the broader way an image interacts with a collection of general semantic prompts. Our detector summarizes these responses using category-level statistics, relationships among prompts, deviations from clean reference distributions, and stability under weak image transformations, producing a compact response profile that is classified by a lightweight model while the VLM remains fixed. We evaluate the approach on multiple public image datasets, several CLIP-style visual backbones, and a range of gradient-based, optimization-based, automated, and spatial attacks. The detector achieves strong discrimination in attack-specific settings and retains substantial performance when evaluated on attacks not seen during training. Under a controlled detector-specific protocol, the response-profile representation outperforms the evaluated embedding-geometry baselines. Additional analyses show that the feature groups provide complementary information and that the method remains effective under variations in the prompt configuration. We also examine inference cost and performance against detector-aware adaptive attacks. Overall, the results indicate that response patterns across semantic prompts provide a useful complementary signal for adversarial image detection in frozen VLMs.

</details>


### [147] [ECHO: Embodied Camera Observations of Human Object Carrying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10438)
*Xuefei Sun,Lorin Achey,Kali Hamilton,Alberto Speranzon,Gregory Grebe,Yonatan Bisk,Christoffer Heckman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一项名为“情境化物体放置”的新基准任务，旨在评估智能体在复杂环境中推理物体应放置位置的能力。为此，作者构建了ECHO数据集——一个大规模合成数据集，包含室内场景的密集RGB-D扫描、人类携带物体的运动轨迹、自然语言描述以及物体目标位置的标注。该数据集首次融合了重建场景、人类活动、自然语言和上下文放置信息，涵盖3805个标注片段，涉及198种不同物体。实验表明，仅依赖单一模态（如视觉或动作）不足以准确预测物体的合理目的地，强调需联合考虑场景结构、人类行为与上下文知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据集缺乏对物体在真实生活环境中合理放置位置的标注，无法有效支持智能体对情境化物体放置的推理能力评估。静态场景数据缺少人类活动，而交互数据又缺乏完整可导航的场景重建和明确的目标位置标注。因此，亟需一个能同时体现环境布局、人类行为习惯和上下文语义的新基准。

Method: 提出“情境化物体放置”作为新任务，并构建ECHO数据集；通过合成方式生成带有完整RGB-D扫描、6-DoF轨迹、动作描述与上下文语句的多模态数据；使用输入掩码探测和端到端模型进行评估，分析各模态贡献。

Result: 实验结果显示，任何单一输入模态（如图像、轨迹或文本）均无法充分完成任务，必须联合利用场景结构、人类动作和上下文知识才能实现高精度预测。这证明了多模态协同推理的重要性。

Conclusion: ECHO数据集为研究情境化物体放置提供了首个综合性基准，揭示了多模态信息融合在理解人类日常行为与环境互动中的关键作用，推动了具身智能体在现实世界中更自然地协助人类的能力发展。

Abstract: Embodied and assistive agents must do more than recognize objects: they must reason about where an object belongs given the layout of an environment and the habits of the people who live in it. Progress on this problem has been limited, in part because no dedicated benchmark or dataset exists to define and evaluate it. Existing RGB-D scan datasets reconstruct static rooms without human activity, while human-object-interaction datasets capture motion without a navigable, fully reconstructed scene or a ground-truth notion of an object's natural destination. We introduce contextual object placement as a benchmark task: predicting an object's destination during an observed object-carrying episode. To support this task, we present Embodied Camera observations of Human Object carrying (ECHO), a large-scale synthetic dataset that pairs dense RGB-D scans of indoor scenes with recordings of an embodied human carrying everyday objects to context-appropriate destinations. ECHO is the first publicly available dataset to combine reconstructed scenes, human activity, natural language, and contextual-placement annotations. It comprises 3,805 human-annotated episodes across 159 floors of 115 HM3D scenes, involving 198 distinct objects. Each floor includes a complete RGB-D scan with human-annotated room labels and a surface list. Each episode provides synchronized RGB-D encounter clips; 6-DoF camera, human, and object trajectories; start and destination surfaces; an action caption; and a human-written context: a single sentence describing the inhabitant's routine that implies the destination without naming it. We evaluate contextual object placement using input-masked probes and an end-to-end baseline. Results show that no single input modality is sufficient, highlighting the need to jointly reason over scene structure, human activity, and contextual knowledge.

</details>


### [148] [MORCA: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Cache Reuse in Video Diffusion Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10457)
*Yuxiang Xiong,Ruiyan Wang,Wenqiang Wang,Teng Hu,Songhang Shen,Bohao Feng,Hongqian Deng,Ran Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MORCA 是一种基于离线到在线强化学习训练的缓存调度框架，旨在解决扩散变换器（DiTs）在视频生成中因迭代去噪过程导致的高推理延迟问题。传统动态缓存方法依赖于每一步的误差估计（步骤误差），但该误差与最终生成视频的质量损失（终端误差）并不直接对应。本文提出利用潜在信息来捕捉两者关系，从而更准确地指导缓存决策。此外，现有基于阈值的方法难以实现精确的速度提升控制，无法满足用户指定的加速目标。MORCA 通过学习潜在感知的重用/重新计算决策，在不同加速比下均实现了优于现有方法的生成保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的动态缓存方法主要依赖于每一步的误差估计（步骤误差）来指导缓存决策，但步骤误差并不能准确反映最终生成视频的质量损失（终端误差）。此外，基于阈值的方法缺乏对加速目标的精确控制能力，难以满足实际应用中用户对特定加速比的需求。因此，亟需一种能够基于终端质量损失进行决策、并支持可配置加速目标的新方法。

Method: 提出 MORCA 框架，采用离线预训练结合在线强化学习的方式，构建一个潜变量感知的缓存调度策略。该方法通过学习潜在空间中的信息，建立步骤误差与终端误差之间的映射关系，进而做出更优的缓存重用或重新计算决策。同时，系统支持用户指定加速目标，实现灵活且精准的速度控制。

Result: 在多个视频生成模型和不同加速比下的实验表明，MORCA 在保持相同计算预算的前提下，显著提升了生成视频的保真度，优于当前最先进的缓存方法。其在速度-质量权衡上表现更优，具备更强的实际应用潜力。

Conclusion: MORCA 通过引入潜变量感知的强化学习缓存调度机制，有效解决了传统方法中步骤误差与终端误差不一致以及加速控制不精确的问题，实现了高质量、可定制化的视频生成加速，为高效扩散模型部署提供了新思路。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve remarkable performance in video synthesis, but their iterative denoising process suffers from high inference latency. To address this, caching has emerged as an effective acceleration strategy by capitalizing on inter-step redundancy during denoising. Existing dynamic caching methods typically estimate the error that cache reuse would introduce at each denoising step (step error) to guide cache decisions, whereas our concern is how much quality loss cache reuse would cause in the final generated video (terminal error). We show that step error does not directly correspond to terminal error and that latent information helps capture their relationship, thereby informing cache decisions. Moreover, existing threshold-based methods cannot provide precise speedup control, making it difficult to meet practical requirements for user-specified acceleration targets. To address these limitations, we introduce MORCA, a cache scheduling framework trained through offline-to-online reinforcement learning to make latent-aware reuse/recompute decisions under user-specified acceleration targets. Extensive experiments on different video generation models across multiple target acceleration ratios demonstrate that MORCA achieves better generation fidelity than state-of-the-art caching methods under comparable computational budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/x10ngyx/MORCA.

</details>


### [149] [Label-free cell counting and viability prediction with brightfield imaging and deep learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10473)
*Amir Reza Vazifeh,Christian Zeigler,Sornanathan Meyyappan,Richard Jeske,Jason W. Fleischer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出了一种名为ViabiLens的AI辅助软件，用于无标记（label-free）细胞活力分析。通过结合亮场成像与深度学习模型，该方法能够在不使用染料的情况下准确区分活细胞和死细胞，克服了传统染色法在实时监测、细胞干扰和光漂白方面的局限性。实验表明，ViabiLens在未染色样本上的平均绝对误差仅为2.68%，表现出优异性能，并公开了一个基准数据集以推动后续研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统细胞活力检测依赖于膜不可渗透染料的染色，存在化学干扰、判读模糊、光漂白及无法实时或原位检测等问题，亟需一种非侵入性、高精度且可实时应用的替代方法。

Method: 采用亮场显微成像获取未染色和染色细胞图像，利用卷积神经网络（CNN）训练分类模型，结合细胞检测算法定位单个细胞，并通过UMAP可视化工具实现交互式分析。模型在染色样本上训练后可泛化至未染色样本，实现无标记预测。

Result: ViabiLens在CHO细胞系多种活力条件下对未染色样本的预测表现优异，平均绝对误差仅为2.68%，显著优于传统方法；同时发布了公开基准数据集，支持未来研究。

Conclusion: 本研究证明了基于亮场图像的无标记细胞活力分析具有可行性与高精度，提出的ViabiLens系统为生物制药与药物开发中的实时、无损细胞监测提供了强大工具。

Abstract: Cell viability assessment is a core requirement in cell culture systems, with critical applications in biopharmaceutical manufacturing and drug development. Conventionally, it is measured by adding membrane-impermeable dyes to a sample (a process called staining), which allows compromised cell membranes to be distinguished from intact ones. However, staining has several limitations: (a) chemical agents can perturb normal cellular processes of the cells being measured, (b) it is often ambiguous to assign viability to individual cells whose membrane integrity is only partially compromised. (c) photobleaching can undermine measurement accuracy over time when using fluorescent stains, and (d) staining cannot be performed in situ or in real time. Here, we show that (1) stained cells captured under brightfield imaging contain sufficient information to distinguish live and dead cells, and (2) cells captured under unstained brightfield imaging exhibit similar image features to their stained counterparts, enabling models trained on stained cells to generalize to unstained ones. We then report the development and validation of ViabiLens, an AI-assisted software for label-free cell viability analysis. The ViabiLens combines a cell detection model for localizing individual cells with a convolutional neural network (CNN) classifier for live/dead prediction, paired with an interactive UMAP-based viewer for visualizing and exploring individual cells across the sample. Evaluated on Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cells spanning a wide range of viability conditions, ViabiLens achieves a mean absolute error of 2.68\% on unstained samples against fluorescence-based reference measurements. We also release a benchmark dataset for label-free cell viability analysis to facilitate future research, available at https://amirrezavazifeh.github.io/ViabiLens-Project-Page/.

</details>


### [150] [Insights from Autoresearch for Solar Panel Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10491)
*Justinas Lekavicius,Kursat Komurcu,Valentas Gruzauskas,Linas Petkevicius*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出AutoResearch协议，利用语言模型在1小时内GPU预算内优化训练程序，仅保留验证IoU提升的修改。在固定DeepLabV3-ResNet50模型下，对真实图像上的光伏板分割任务进行实验，Gemma 4 12B和Qwen3-8B均提升基线性能，但优化结果无法跨硬件迁移。其中，仅使用真实图像训练的Qwen3-8B配置达到0.836的测试IoU，优于参考的GAN增强方案（0.833）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索自动化机器学习在遥感图像分割中的应用，通过语言模型自主优化训练流程，在有限计算资源下提升模型性能，并研究其可迁移性与数据增强策略的影响。

Method: 采用AutoResearch协议，让编码语言模型在1小时GPU预算内修改训练程序，仅保留验证交并比（IoU）提升的变更；固定DeepLabV3-ResNet50模型，基于真实图像数据集进行光伏板分割任务，对比不同语言模型（Gemma 4 12B、Qwen3-8B）在不同训练策略下的表现。

Result: Gemma 4 12B和Qwen3-8B均在1小时内提升基线性能，但优化后的配置不具备跨硬件迁移能力；仅使用真实图像训练的Qwen3-8B配置取得0.836的测试IoU，优于使用GAN增强数据的参考方案（0.833）。

Conclusion: AutoResearch协议可在有限资源下有效提升模型性能，但当前优化结果缺乏跨硬件泛化能力；使用真实图像训练的模型在特定场景下表现更优，表明数据真实性对模型性能有显著影响。

Abstract: This paper investigates AutoResearch, a protocol in which a coding language model edits a training program under a one-hour GPU budget and retains a change only if validation IoU improves. The protocol is applied to photovoltaic panel segmentation on a frozen real-image split, with DeepLabV3--ResNet-50 held fixed. Three campaigns of 24 experiments, using Gemma~4 12B, Qwen3-8B all improve their one-hour baselines, but retained modifications do not transfer across hardware. The Qwen3-8B configuration, trained on real images only, reaches a test IoU of 0.836 versus 0.833 for the reference GAN-augmented schedule. Research repository https://github.com/VU-AIML/automl4eo-autoresearch-segmentation.

</details>


### [151] [QuadTok: Quadtree Visual Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10497)
*Yucheng Mao,Zeyuan Chen,Xiaojun Shan,Xiang Zhang,Divyansh Srivastava,Bingnan Li,Zhuowen Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: QuadTok提出一种基于四叉树的视觉分词框架，通过动态分配表示容量提升效率，在ImageNet和COCO数据集上分别减少10%和9%的令牌数量，同时保持高重建保真度。其树状结构天然支持自回归图像生成，并实现零样本空间控制生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统2D网格或1D序列分词方法在灵活性与空间绑定之间存在权衡，难以高效表示图像中复杂与简单区域的差异。需要一种既能保留空间结构又具序列灵活性的分词方式。

Method: 采用层次化四叉树结构对图像进行分词，根据视觉复杂度动态调整分辨率；利用树形拓扑引导自回归生成，实现高效且可控的图像生成。

Result: 在ImageNet上相比固定256令牌网格节省约10%令牌，在COCO上节省9%；生成模型在ImageNet 256×256上达到2.08 gFID；支持零样本空间控制生成。

Conclusion: QuadTok通过四叉树结构实现了高效的视觉分词与高质量的自回归图像生成，兼具压缩效率、生成质量与空间控制能力，为图像生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: We introduce QuadTok, a novel framework for visual tokenization and autoregressive image generation. Compared to traditional approaches using 2D grids or 1D token sequences, we propose a hierarchical quadtree structure, bridging the gap between 2D spatial binding and 1D sequence-level flexibility. The QuadTok tokenizer dynamically allocates representational capacity to visually intricate areas while leaving homogeneous regions at a coarse resolution. Compared with a fixed 256-token grid, our ImageNet-trained tokenizer saves approximately 10% of tokens on ImageNet and 9% when transferred zero-shot to the COCO dataset, while maintaining comparable reconstruction fidelity. Furthermore, the natural causality introduced by the tree structure seamlessly enables autoregressive image generation. Conditioned on a quadtree topology supplied before generation, our 947M GPT-style generative model achieves a 2.08 gFID on the ImageNet $256 \times 256$ benchmark. Additionally, leveraging the strong spatial correlation preserved by the quadtree structure, the QuadTok generator enables zero-shot spatially controlled image generation capabilities. Code: https://github.com/myc634/QuadTok.

</details>


### [152] [Video-Conditioned Generative Joint 2D-3D Hand Motion Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10512)
*Chen Xu,Yunqi Li,Binbin Huang,Brent Yi,Shenghua Gao,Yi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JoHan是一种统一的生成框架，直接从视频序列中恢复3D手部运动，无需依赖逐帧姿态预测。通过联合生成对齐的2D和3D局部手部姿态序列，学习其时间动态和跨表示对应关系，利用2D图像中的空间与时间线索引导3D运动重建，并通过学习到的运动先验提升时间一致性。该方法还通过2D-3D对应关系恢复手相对于相机的全局位置与方向，在多个挑战性基准上实现了更高的精度和速度，显著改善了手部运动动态，生成更平滑的运动轨迹，同时保持高帧级姿态准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从视频中恢复精确的3D手部运动面临遮挡和视觉信息不完整的问题，导致逐帧姿态估计不可靠且时间上不一致。现有方法依赖中间逐帧预测，难以保证时间一致性。因此需要一种无需依赖逐帧预测、能直接从视频中生成连贯3D手部运动的统一框架。

Method: 提出JoHan框架，从零训练，联合生成对齐的2D和3D局部手部姿态序列；利用2D图像中的空间与时间线索指导3D运动重建；通过学习运动先验增强时间一致性；利用2D-3D对应关系恢复手的全局位置与朝向。

Result: 在多个挑战性基准上，相比以往方法，显著提升了局部手部姿态和相机空间重建的准确性和速度；生成的手部运动更加平滑，动态表现更优，同时保持高帧级姿态精度。

Conclusion: JoHan成功实现从视频端到端生成高质量、时间一致的3D手部运动，有效克服了遮挡和不完整观测带来的挑战，为真实场景下的手部动作建模提供了高效可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: Recovering faithful 3D hand motion from video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions and incomplete visual observations, which make frame-wise pose estimates unreliable and temporally inconsistent. To address this problem, we propose JoHan, a unified generative framework that recovers hand motion directly from video sequences without relying on intermediate per-frame pose predictions. Trained from scratch, our model jointly generates aligned 2D and 3D local hand pose sequences by learning their temporal dynamics and cross-representation correspondence. The generated 2D trajectories exploit direct spatial and temporal cues from the 2D images to guide the following generative 3D motion reconstruction, while the learned motion prior promotes temporal consistency. Their learned 2D-3D correspondence further enables recovery of the hand's global position and orientation relative to the camera. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate significantly improved accuracy and speed in local hand-pose and camera-space reconstruction. Notably, our method captures much better hand-motion dynamics, producing significantly smoother motion than previous methods while maintaining high per-frame pose accuracy.

</details>


### [153] [GRACE: Generation-aware latent compression for efficient video generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10524)
*Jiyoung Kim,Paul Hyunbin Cho,Jisu Nam,Donghoon Lee,Hyunsung Go,Yeonkyeong Lee,Hansaem Kim,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GRACE提出一种两阶段框架，通过保留预训练编码器的冻结基础潜在表示并学习残差潜在表示，实现视频自编码器的生成感知压缩，同时保持与预训练DiT的兼容性。该方法优化压缩潜空间以匹配生成需求，并通过轻量级微调和非对称去噪适配DiT，显著降低令牌数量（8倍）和延迟（11.1倍），在VBench上保持与原始模型相当的生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高压缩视频自编码器在训练中面临重建质量下降的问题，且压缩后的潜在表示与预训练DiT不兼容，导致需重新训练或高成本适应。同时，仅优化重建会偏离DiT所学的潜在分布，影响生成效果。因此需要一种既能高效压缩又保持生成兼容性的方法。

Method: GRACE采用两阶段策略：第一阶段冻结原自编码器的基础潜在表示，学习因强压缩丢失信息的残差潜在表示，并通过在冻结DiT特征空间中对齐压缩潜表示，使自编码器优化目标服务于生成；第二阶段通过轻量级微调和非对称去噪（先去噪基础再处理残差）适配预训练DiT。

Result: GRACE将Wan2.1-I2V-14B的令牌数减少8倍，延迟降低11.1倍（在480x832x81分辨率下），同时在VBench评测中生成质量与原始预训练流水线持平。

Conclusion: GRACE成功实现了高效视频生成中的生成感知潜空间压缩，在显著提升推理效率的同时保持了高质量生成能力，为视频扩散模型的实用化提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Highly compressed video autoencoders offer an effective way to accelerate video diffusion models, as the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) operates on far fewer tokens. However, such autoencoders are challenging to train, since a higher compression ratio degrades reconstruction quality and recovering it requires more channels, which is known to slow the convergence of the DiT. The compressed latent also differs from the one the DiT was trained on, so the pretrained DiT must be either retrained from scratch or adapted at considerable cost. Compressing the autoencoder the DiT was trained with appears to preserve compatibility, yet optimizing it for reconstruction alone still shifts the latent away from the distribution the DiT has learned. To address this, we propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE), a two-stage framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while keeping it compatible with the pretrained DiT. Specifically, we keep a frozen base latent from the pretrained encoder and learn a residual latent for the information lost under stronger compression, while aligning the compressed latent with the pretrained latent in the feature space of the frozen DiT so that the autoencoder is optimized for generation. We then adapt the DiT with lightweight fine-tuning and asymmetric denoising, where the base is denoised ahead of the residual. GRACE reduces the token count of Wan2.1-I2V-14B by 8x and its latency by 11.1x at 480x832x81, while matching the generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on VBench.

</details>


### [154] [Never Look Back: Understanding Persistence in 3D Object Memory from Egocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10538)
*Shravan Chaudhari,William Paul,Suchi Saria,Rama Chellappa,Homanga Bharadhwaj*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出Ledger，一种基于第一人称视频的持久3D物体记忆系统，能够追踪物体位置、历史和上下文描述，即使物体已离开视野或未被触碰也能保留信息。通过聚类观察数据并减少定位噪声，系统可有效回答空间问题，并在多个基准测试中显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能够在日常活动中记住物品的位置和状态，即使未来才需要使用。本研究旨在让具身助手具备类似的能力，从第一人称视频中构建持久、可靠的物体记忆，以支持后续的空间推理与任务执行。

Method: Ledger系统结合物体位置、历史轨迹和上下文描述，通过聚类物体在不同场景中的观测数据，仅在多次证据支持下记录移动行为，从而减少定位误差；同时用简短描述保存关键细节，如内容或支撑表面。所有信息被结构化存储，用于高效问答而不依赖原始视频。

Result: Ledger将HD-EPIC准确率从29.7%提升至42.6%，UCS-Bench准确率从33.8%提升至38.5%，在Ego4D上的物体定位中达到0.99米的中位误差。分析表明时间持续性、上下文描述和检索机制各有互补作用。跨场景实验揭示了构建与检索中的失败模式，单场景构建可部分恢复多场景下的性能损失。

Conclusion: Ledger展示了从第一人称视频中构建持久且鲁棒的3D物体记忆的可行性，为具身智能体实现长期空间认知提供了有效方法，但仍需改进跨场景一致性与动态变化建模能力。

Abstract: As we move through the world and carry out everyday tasks, we encounter objects that may become relevant only later. We are capable of recalling where we left something or what was inside a container, even without knowing we would need it later. Here, we study how an embodied assistant can build a similar memory from egocentric videos, by observing a person's day-to-day activities. We present Ledger, a persistent 3D object memory that combines object locations, their histories, and contextual descriptions. It associates observations across the recording and retains objects after they leave the view, including those the person never touches. It clusters each object's observations by resting locations and records a move only after repeated evidence, reducing the effect of localization noise. Short descriptions preserve details such as an object's contents or supporting surface. It saves these records to later answer spatial questions without having to access the original images or video. Our memory raises HD-EPIC accuracy from 29.7% to 42.6%, UCS-Bench accuracy from 33.8% to 38.5% and localizes Ego4D objects with a 0.99 m median error on returned predictions. Our analyses identify complementary roles for temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and retrieval. Our study on 100 stitched streams of multiple scenes each further exposes failures in both retrieval and construction. Per-scene construction partially recovers the performance lost across scene changes compared to that of single scene streams.

</details>


### [155] [Tetris3D: 3D Scene Generation With Objects That Fit Together](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10539)
*Jaeyeong Kim,Jinhyuk Jang,Jongmin Lee,Kyehong Park,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Tetris3D 是一种用于单图像 3D 场景重建的生成框架，通过显式地将每个物体的生成条件依赖于周围物体的几何结构和物理关系，实现物体间精细的空间兼容性。同时引入 ComOb 数据集，包含 120 万场景，涵盖多样物体类别间的物理交互，提供物体网格和成对物理关系标注。实验表明，Tetris3D 在合成与真实场景中均能恢复连贯的物体形状与姿态，即使在相互遮挡区域也能保持高生成质量与物理稳定性，达到当前最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常独立生成物体或隐式耦合，缺乏对相邻物体之间精细空间兼容性的有效引导，难以保证物体在物理和几何上的合理性。

Method: 显式地将每个物体的生成条件基于周围物体的几何信息及其物理关系，以指导其形状与姿态在场景中保持几何与物理上的合理性；构建 ComOb 数据集，利用物理模拟生成大规模带物理交互标注的 3D 场景数据。

Result: Tetris3D 能够在物体相互遮挡的情况下仍恢复出连贯的形状与姿态，在生成质量与物理稳定性方面均优于现有方法，达到当前最佳性能。

Conclusion: Tetris3D 通过显式建模物体间的几何与物理关系，显著提升了单图像 3D 场景重建中物体之间的空间一致性与物理合理性，为复杂场景的高质量重建提供了新范式。

Abstract: We propose Tetris3D, a generative framework for single-image 3D scene reconstruction that recovers objects which are physically and geometrically coherent as a scene. Existing methods often generate objects independently or couple them implicitly, providing limited guidance for ensuring fine-grained spatial compatibility between neighboring objects that interact with one another. To address this, we explicitly condition the generation of each object on the geometry of surrounding objects and their physical relationships, guiding its shape and pose to remain geometrically and physically plausible within the scene. Moreover, we introduce ComOb, a physics simulation-based dataset of 1.2M scenes featuring physical interactions across diverse object categories, with per-object meshes and pairwise physical relation annotations. Comprehensive experiments on synthetic and realworld scenes show that Tetris3D recovers coherent object shapes and poses even when interacting regions are occluded, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both generation quality and physical stability.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [156] [Tokka-Bench: Evaluating Tokenizers Across 100 Natural and 20 Programming Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08794)
*Ben Gubler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Tokka-Bench 是一个开源框架，用于在100种自然语言（30多种书写系统）和20种编程语言上，基于五个互补指标（每字节的标记数、唯一标记覆盖率、子词繁殖率、单词分割率和词汇组成）对分词器进行标准化评估。通过语言感知的分段方法，该框架比较了七种BPE分词器（GPT-2、GPT-4、gpt-oss、Llama 3.1、Gemma 3、Qwen3 和 Kimi K2），发现词汇分配策略比词汇量大小更重要，且近期分词器在编程语言效率上已趋同，尽管自然语言表现各异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型依赖的子词分词器质量在不同语言间差异显著，但缺乏统一的多指标评估框架，限制了跨语言分词器的公平比较与优化。

Method: 提出 Tokka-Bench 框架，采用语言感知的分段策略，针对不同书写系统调整分词逻辑，并在100种自然语言和20种编程语言上，使用五项互补指标进行系统性评估。

Result: 发现词汇分配策略对分词性能影响大于词汇规模；近期分词器在编程语言处理效率上趋于一致，但在自然语言表现上仍存在显著差异。

Conclusion: Tokka-Bench 提供了一个全面、可复现的多语言分词器评估基准，有助于推动高效、公平的分词技术发展，其数据与交互式仪表板已公开可用。

Abstract: Large language models rely on subword tokenizers whose quality varies across languages, yet no standardized multi-metric framework exists for broad comparative evaluation. We introduce Tokka-Bench, an open-source framework that evaluates tokenizers on five complementary metrics -- bytes per token, unique token coverage, subword fertility, word-split rate, and vocabulary composition -- across 100 natural languages (30+ scripts) and 20 programming languages, using language-aware segmentation adapted to each writing system. Comparing seven BPE tokenizers (GPT-2, GPT-4, gpt-oss, Llama 3.1, Gemma 3, Qwen3, and Kimi K2) within individual languages, we find that vocabulary allocation strategy matters more than raw vocabulary size, and that programming-language efficiency has converged among recent tokenizers despite divergent natural-language profiles. The framework, data, and interactive dashboard are publicly available.

</details>


### [157] [Child ASR Adaptation with Adult Retention: An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08827)
*Houssam Eddine-Othman Lachemat,Shammur Absar Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了在保持成年语音识别性能的同时，如何有效适应儿童语音的自动语音识别（ASR）系统。通过对比全微调、LoRA和后处理权重空间融合方法，在编码器-解码器、编码器-CTC及AudioLLM-based ASR系统上进行实验，覆盖阿拉伯语和英语的母语与非母语儿童语音数据。结果表明，儿童语音适应至关重要，尤其对非母语儿童语音；但直接适应常导致成人语音性能下降。双语适应比单语言更稳定，权重空间融合显著改善适应与保留之间的权衡，尤其在编码器-CTC、Whisper和AudioLLM模型中表现突出。其中LERP更利于保留成人性能，TIES则能实现更强的儿童语音增益。而在编码器-解码器模型中，直接双语微调仍是最优的原始WER表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动语音识别（ASR）系统在儿童和非母语者语音上表现不佳，而将成人ASR模型直接适应儿童语音时，常导致成人语音识别能力退化。因此需要一种既能有效提升儿童语音识别性能，又能保留原有成人语音识别能力的方法。

Method: 比较全微调、LoRA（低秩适配）和后处理权重空间融合（如LERP、TIES）三种方法，在编码器-解码器、编码器-CTC和AudioLLM-based ASR系统上进行儿童语音适应，并评估其在成人语音上的保留能力。实验涵盖阿拉伯语和英语的母语与非母语儿童语音数据，以及成人基准数据集（MGB-2、LibriSpeech test-clean）。

Result: 儿童语音适应是必要的，尤其是对非母语阿拉伯语和英语儿童语音。直接适应通常会降低成人语音识别性能。双语适应比单语言适应更稳定。权重空间融合方法显著改善适应与保留之间的权衡，尤其在编码器-CTC、Whisper和AudioLLM模型中效果明显。其中，LERP更有利于保留成人语音性能，而TIES能实现更强的儿童语音识别增益。在编码器-解码器模型中，直接双语微调在原始WER上表现最佳。

Conclusion: 有效的儿童语音适应需兼顾性能提升与成人语音保留。权重空间融合策略在多数模型架构中优于传统微调，尤其适合多语言场景。未来应进一步探索高效且稳定的跨语言、跨年龄语音适应机制。

Abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems often underperform for children and non-native speakers, while adapting adult ASR models to child speech can cause adult-speech forgetting. We study child ASR adaptation with adult retention across Arabic and English. We compare full fine-tuning, LoRA, and post-hoc weight-space merging across encoder--decoder, encoder--CTC, and AudioLLM-based ASR systems. Experiments use Arabic native and non-native child speech, English MyST child speech, and adult benchmarks from MGB-2 and LibriSpeech test-clean. We evaluate recognition quality with WER and quantify the adaptation--retention trade-off using Retention Index, Child Adaptation Gain, and Adaptation Recovery. Results show that child adaptation is necessary, especially for non-native Arabic and English child speech, but direct adaptation often reduces adult ASR performance. Bilingual adaptation is more stable than language-specific adaptation.
