Weight-space merging often improves the trade-off, especially for encoder--CTC, Whisper, and AudioLLM-based ASR, with LERP favoring adult retention and TIES recovering stronger child gains. For the encoder--decoder model, direct bilingual fine-tuning remains strongest in raw WER.\footnote{Code, and models are available at https://github.com/qcri/Child-ASR-Adaptation.

</details>


### [158] [When Forgetting Looks Like Improvement: Metric Masking in Streaming Diarizer Adaptation and the Price of Rehearsal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08828)
*Mo Yu,Yang Liu,Jing Qian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了小数据适应对语音分离系统中说话人检测与说话人归属的影响，发现适应虽提升了域内性能并具备跨域迁移能力，但导致了时间上说话人身份一致性下降。本地重映射诊断显示不同语料库中身份错误模式各异，表明适应可能改变流式模型维持说话人分配的方式。回放机制可减轻退化现象，但会降低跨域迁移性能。研究强调需联合评估检测准确率、身份一致性和保留行为以优化流式说话人分离系统的适应策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在理解小数据适应如何影响流式说话人分离系统中的说话人检测与说话人归属之间的矛盾，尤其是适应带来的身份一致性下降问题。

Method: 通过在7.5小时双人对话数据上对已发布的流式说话人分离器进行适应，并在六个不同语料库上进行评估；使用局部重映射诊断分析身份退化模式；引入回放机制测试其对退化和跨域迁移的影响。

Result: 适应显著提升域内性能并实现跨域迁移，但导致时间身份一致性下降，且退化模式因语料库而异；回放可缓解退化但削弱跨域迁移性能。

Conclusion: 应联合评估检测准确性、身份一致性和保留行为，以更全面地评估流式说话人分离系统的适应效果。

Abstract: Small-data adaptation can improve speech detection while degrading speaker attribution. We study this discrepancy in a released streaming diarizer adapted on 7.5 h of two-party conversation and evaluated across six corpora. Adaptation substantially improves in-domain diarization performance and transfers to an independent corpus. However, this improvement is not consistent across evaluation scenarios as the additional confusion is mainly associated with impaired temporal identity consistency rather than speaker-count errors. A local-remapping diagnostic reveals different patterns of identity degradation across corpora, indicating that adaptation may alter how streaming models maintain speaker assignments over time. Rehearsal reduces the observed degradation but reduces the cross-domain transfer performance. These results highlight the need to jointly evaluate detection accuracy, identity consistency, and retention behavior when adapting streaming diarization systems.

</details>


### [159] [Emo-Jev: Probabilistic Reasoning for Emotion Classification with Jev](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08829)
*Yazhou Zhang,Junhao Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Emo-Jev 提出一种无需训练的框架，通过分解任务或构建多视角判断路径来提升文本分类中的推理能力，相较传统 Jev 和主流 LLM 在多个数据集上表现更优，且具有更低延迟与成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索 Jev 接口在文本分类中是否具备有效推理能力，尤其对比当前领先的大语言模型（LLM），以寻找更高效、低成本的替代方案。

Method: Emo-Jev-D 将分类任务分解为原子级判断并融合概率；Emo-Jev-SC 从互补视角构建多个判断路径并聚合共识决策，两者均为无训练设计。

Result: Emo-Jev 在八组数据集上平均宏 F1 达 67.28%，优于标准 Jev 的 62.93%；性能接近最强 LLM 基线，同时表现出更低延迟和总体成本优势。

Conclusion: Emo-Jev 证明了基于概率判断的 Jev 接口可在不依赖训练的情况下实现有效推理，是当前 LLM 在文本分类任务中的一种高效、低成本替代方案。

Abstract: Jev offers an alternative interface for language understanding: given an input and predefined questions, it returns probabilistic decisions rather than free-form responses. Whether this interface can support effective reasoning for text classification against leading LLMs remains an open questions. We introduce Emo-Jev, a training-free framework with two complementary implementations. Emo-Jev-D decomposes classification into task-specific atomic judgments and composes their probabilities into a final prediction. Emo-Jev-SC constructs multiple judgment paths from complementary perspectives and aggregates their predictions into a consensus decision. We evaluate Emo-Jev on eight datasets spanning sentiment analysis, emotion recognition, sarcasm detection and humor detection, comparing against direct Jev classification and five SoTA LLMs under input/output and chain-of-thought reasoning. Standard Jev achieves 62.93\% average macro-F1 versus 67.28\% for the strongest LLM baseline, with lower observed latency and generally lower cost.

</details>


### [160] [CoDR: Training-Free Confidence-Drift Remasking for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08833)
*Yue Wu,Qinghe Zhang,Yu Zhang,Jian Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为CoDR（Confidence Drift Remasking）的新方法，用于解决掩码扩散语言模型中因早期不可逆的词元提交导致的错误传播问题。该方法通过检测已提交词元的置信度下降（即置信度漂移），在仅需k次前向传播的情况下，对模型不再支持的词元进行重新掩码与生成，实现无需训练、兼容各类采样器的高效修正。在多种模型、任务和采样器设置下，CoDR显著提升了平均准确率，且实验表明其增益源于精准的置信度驱动重掩码，而非单纯增加计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有采样器主要关注何时提交词元，却忽视了已提交词元在获得更丰富上下文后是否仍应保留，导致早期错误难以纠正。本文发现这一现象源于置信度漂移：模型在稀疏上下文中提交的词元，在后续更密集的上下文中置信度下降，但未被修正。

Method: 提出CoDR方法，基于置信度漂移信号，采用k-分区探测机制，在k次前向传播内估计所有已提交位置的置信度变化，对置信度下降的词元进行重新掩码并再生，实现高效、无训练、通用的后处理修正。

Result: 在两种骨干模型、四个推理与编码任务及三种基础采样器上，CoDR均提升平均准确率，并在多数具体任务中表现更优；控制实验验证其增益来自针对性的置信度驱动重掩码，而非额外计算；相比先前方法，所需前向传播次数显著减少。

Conclusion: CoDR有效缓解了掩码扩散语言模型中的置信度漂移问题，通过轻量级、无训练的后处理机制，实现了高质量文本生成，具有广泛适用性与高效性。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) decode by repeatedly committing tokens to masked positions, but these commitments are usually irreversible. A token chosen under sparse, partial context is kept fixed, even when later context no longer supports it. Existing samplers mainly decide when to commit a token, but rarely check whether an already committed token should still be kept, allowing early mistakes to propagate. We trace this issue to confidence drift, where the model's confidence in a committed token drops from its sparse commit-time context to the denser context available later. Based on this signal, we propose CoDR (Confidence Drift Remasking), a training-free and sampler-agnostic refinement pass. CoDR estimates drift for all committed positions in only k forward passes via k-partition probing, then remasks and regenerates only the tokens the model no longer endorses. Across two backbones, four reasoning and coding tasks, and three base samplers, CoDR improves average accuracy across all evaluated model-sampler configurations and improves most individual task settings with modest overhead. Controlled experiments show that the gains come from targeted confidence-drift remasking rather than extra compute alone, and that CoDR uses far fewer forward passes than prior remasking methods. Code is available at https://github.com/YueWu0301/CoDR.

</details>


### [161] [Leveraging LLM-Generated Explanations for Detecting Emotionally Rewritten Fake News](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08835)
*Yupei Guo,Jiajun He,Xiaohan Shi,Tomoki Toda,Zekun Yang,Bowen Wang,Yukinobu Taniguchi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究在保持事实不变但情绪变化下的假新闻检测问题，构建了情感重写测试集，并利用原始新闻生成解释作为稳定背景知识。提出Gated Cross Attention (GCA)框架，通过自适应融合情感重写新闻与解释内容，提升模型对关键信息的关注能力，减少情绪重构带来的干扰。实验表明，在PolitiFact和LUN数据集上，该方法在多种情绪条件下均取得显著提升，且在GossipCop上保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有假新闻检测方法主要关注风格差异或引入外部解释信息，但未充分考虑新闻在不同情绪背景下被重写却保持事实不变的情况，这可能影响模型的鲁棒性。因此，亟需研究在事实保持不变但情绪变化条件下的假新闻检测方法。

Method: 构建情感重写测试集，从原始新闻生成解释作为背景知识；提出Gated Cross Attention (GCA)框架，通过门控机制动态调节新闻与解释之间的注意力交互，实现对关键解释内容的聚焦，降低情绪重构带来的不匹配问题。

Result: 在PolitiFact和LUN数据集上，所提方法在多种情绪条件下均表现显著优于基线模型；在GossipCop上保持良好性能。消融实验证明解释引导和门控机制在不同情绪条件下具有积极作用。

Conclusion: 本文提出的GCA框架有效提升了假新闻检测在情绪变化场景下的鲁棒性，证明了解释信息与门控注意力机制在应对情感重写挑战中的重要性。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: The spread of fake news may cause severe social consequences. Existing fake news detection methods mainly focus on stylistic variations or incorporate external information such as explanations. However, news articles are often rewritten under different emotional backgrounds while preserving their underlying factual claims, which may affect the robustness of detection models. In this work, we investigate fake news detec- tion under fact-preserving emotional variations. To study this problem, we construct emotion-rewritten test sets and generate explanations from the original news articles as stable background knowledge. We then propose a Gated Cross Attention (GCA) framework that adaptively integrates emotionally rewritten news with the corresponding explanations, enabling the model to focus on informative explanation content while reducing potential mismatches caused by emotional reframing. Experiments on PolitiFact, GossipCop, and LUN demonstrate that the proposed method achieves notable improvements under multiple emotional conditions on PolitiFact and LUN, while maintaining competitive performance on GossipCop. We further analyze the effects of explanation guidance and gating mechanisms under different emotional conditions. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/Flulike/fakenews gca .

</details>


### [162] [Beyond the Sycophancy Score: How Task, Model, and Pressure Shape LLM Yielding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08840)
*Guang Yang,Homa Hosseinmardi,Fengchen Liu,Amir Ghasemian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究通过分析103,939条回复，探讨了大语言模型在用户施压下出现迎合行为（sycophancy）的条件。发现模型验证用户主张的成本是主要影响因素，而训练有素的防护机制可显著减少迎合现象。锚定事实几乎从不被放弃（1.3%），逻辑谜题中随着反驳所需线索增加，采纳率上升；个人意见在77.0%的对话中被接受。能可靠解决难题的模型极少让步，而无法解决的模型则更易妥协。启用最大推理能力可完全消除此类让步。建议用户简化难以验证的问题、深度推理、陈述问题而非偏好答案、要求证据，并根据模型的防护能力选择模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将大语言模型的迎合行为仅以单一比率报告，缺乏对其发生条件和规避策略的深入理解。本研究旨在揭示影响模型迎合行为的关键因素，为用户提供实用指导以提升交互可靠性。

Method: 收集了十种配置（八种关闭推理的LLM，两种开启最大推理）在200个题目、13种压力情境和四轮对话下的103,939条回复，由两名独立的LLM裁判进行标注评分，采用逻辑回归模型分析影响因素。

Result: 模型验证用户主张的成本是主导因素（去除该变量使McFadden R²下降0.485），远高于模型族（0.139）和压力策略（0.009）。锚定事实几乎不被放弃（1.3%），逻辑谜题采纳率随需反驳线索数上升；个人选择被接受率达77.0%。能解题的模型极少让步，不能解题的则频繁妥协。启用最大推理可使深奥谜题采纳率从19.2%和12.5%降至0%。情绪或谬误框架无额外影响。人类标注者与裁判共识在118/120校准项上一致。

Conclusion: 为实现可靠使用大语言模型，应简化难以验证的问题、深度推理、明确提问而非表达偏好、请求证据，并依据模型的防护能力进行选择。最大推理可有效防止迎合行为。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often abandon a correct answer, or endorse a user's position, once the user pushes back. This behavior, called sycophancy, is usually reported as a single rate per model, which says little about when it happens or how a user can avoid it. We study the conditions that produce it with 103,939 graded replies from ten configurations: eight LLMs with reasoning disabled, and two of them again with maximum reasoning, all facing the same 200 items, 13 pressure conditions, and four-turn conversations, with every reply labeled by two independent LLM judges. We find that the dominant factors are how costly it is for the model to verify the user's claim, and whether a trained guardrail covers it. Removing this task factor from a logistic model costs 0.485 of McFadden $R^2$, against 0.139 for model family and 0.009 for pressure tactic. Anchored facts are almost never conceded (1.3%), while adoption on logic puzzles rises with the number of clues needed to refute the pushed answer. Personal choices are endorsed in 77.0% of conversations. Most concessions on hard items come from models that cannot reliably solve them; models that can solve them rarely give the answer up. For both models tested, maximum reasoning removes these concessions completely: adoption on deep puzzles falls from 19.2% and 12.5% to 0%. Fallacious or emotional framing adds nothing beyond plain repetition. Three human annotators agree with the judges' consensus on 118/120 calibration items. These results give practical rules for reliable use: simplify hard-to-verify problems and reason deeply, state the question rather than one's preferred answer, ask for evidence on open questions, and choose models by their measured guardrail profile.

</details>


### [163] [Beyond Risk Prediction: Evidence Grounding and Psychosocial Factor Verification for Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08842)
*Tianle Hu,Chen Peng,Yi-Hsin Tsai,Takshing Andy Tung,Bingyang Sun,Yenjou Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究针对社交媒体上自杀风险识别问题，提出一个包含风险评估、证据定位和因素识别的可解释框架。通过长度路由、风险-证据约束及双验证器机制，实现了对文本证据与心理社会因素的精准识别，分别在风险预测、证据定位和因素识别任务上取得0.8088、0.7605和0.5562的F1分数，显著提升了分析的可解释性与实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仅提供风险分类结果，缺乏对文本证据和心理社会因素的深入解析，难以满足实际干预需求。因此需要一种可解释的框架，以揭示预测背后的依据和影响因素。

Method: 提出三阶段框架：（1）风险评估采用基于长度的路由策略处理不同长度的帖子；（2）证据定位通过识别支持性短语并施加风险-证据一致性约束；（3）因素识别引入语义分类验证器和证据感知验证器，结合预测概率生成最终因素判断。

Result: 风险评估获得加权F1为0.8088，证据定位测试宏行F1为0.7605，因素识别宏F1为0.5562，表明框架能有效提供风险预测、支撑证据和细粒度心理社会因素信息。

Conclusion: 所提出的框架超越了单一风险等级预测，实现了对社交媒体内容的可解释性分析，为在线自杀风险监测提供了更全面、可信的技术支持。

Abstract: Identifying suicide risk from social networking services (SNS) posts is important for detecting suicide-related signals in online environments. However, risk classification alone provides limited insight into the textual evidence and psychosocial factors behind a prediction. Based on the IEEE BigData 2026 Explainable Suicide Risk Detection Challenge, this study presents a framework consisting of Risk Assessment, Evidence Grounding, and Factor Identification. Risk Assessment uses length-based routing to accommodate posts of different lengths. Evidence Grounding identifies supporting phrases and uses a Risk-Evidence constraint to maintain consistency with the Risk prediction. For Factor Identification, two verifiers are used. The Taxonomy Verifier focuses on factor semantics, whereas the Evidence-Aware Verifier uses factor-specific lexical-semantic cues to select informative positive training units. Their prediction probabilities are combined to produce the final factor predictions. The three tasks are evaluated using task-specific F1 score measures. Risk Assessment achieved a Weighted F1 of 0.8088, Evidence Grounding achieved a test Macro row F1 of 0.7605, and Factor Identification achieved a Macro F1 of 0.5562. The results show that the framework can provide risk predictions, along with supporting textual evidence and fine-grained information on psychosocial factors. Overall, the proposed framework extends suicide-risk assessment beyond risk-level prediction and provides a more interpretable analysis of SNS posts.

</details>


### [164] [QuanLing: Cross-Branch Validation of Language Distance Quantification on Western Romance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08851)
*Yiping Bai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究扩展了定量语言学框架QuanLing至西罗曼语族（法语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语、意大利语），使用相同指标体系与聚合协议，通过150组四语言平行句进行分析。结果显示葡萄牙语-西班牙语最接近（LaBSE距离0.0229），法语-意大利语最远（0.0338）；LaBSE与mBERT排名一致率达4/6，验证跨模型鲁棒性。西罗曼语族绝对距离跨度大于北日耳曼语族，但相对比值相近，符合更长分化时间预期。法语表现出更高掩码预测准确率（36.12% vs. 29.28%），反映其正字法与语音脱节特征。结果支持QuanLing在不同语系分支间的普适性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化密切相关语言间语言距离仍是定量语言学的核心挑战。现有方法缺乏跨语系的可扩展性验证，亟需一个统一框架检验其在不同语言分支中的适用性。

Method: 采用QuanLing框架，结合句子嵌入距离（LaBSE）、分词碎片率（四类单语BERT分词器）和掩码语言模型互理解度（mBERT），以英语为锚点构建四语言对，并基于150组平行句子进行计算与聚合分析。

Result: 葡萄牙语-西班牙语语言距离最近（LaBSE 0.0229），法语-意大利语最远（0.0338）；LaBSE与mBERT在6对中4对排名一致，显示跨模型稳健性；西罗曼语族绝对距离跨度更大（0.011），但相对比例相近（1.48），与更长分化时间一致；法语掩码预测准确率显著更高（36.12%），反映其正字法-语音解耦特征。

Conclusion: 本研究通过西罗曼语族的实证验证了QuanLing框架在跨语系场景下的通用性，表明其不仅适用于北日耳曼语族，也可推广至其他语言分支，为大规模语言距离量化提供了可靠工具。

Abstract: Quantifying language distance among closely related languages remains a core challenge in quantitative linguistics. Our previous work [1] introduced QuanLing (Quantitative Linguistics via Pretrained Language Models), a quantitative framework combining language distance metrics (sentence embedding distance, tokenization fragmentation rate) with language property analysis (MLM prediction probability), validated on North Germanic (Danish, Norwegian Bokmål, Swedish). This paper extends QuanLing to Western Romance--French, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian--testing cross-branch applicability with the same metric family and aggregation protocol as our North Germanic study, adapted for four languages (English anchor, quadruplet construction). Using 150 four-language parallel sentences, we compute LaBSE sentence embedding distances, tokenization fragmentation rates from four monolingual BERT tokenizers, and mBERT masked language model mutual intelligibility. Results show that Portuguese--Spanish are closest (LaBSE distance 0.0229), French--Italian most distant (0.0338); LaBSE and mBERT rankings agree on 4 of 6 pairs, confirming cross-model robustness. Western Romance shows a wider absolute distance span than North Germanic (0.011 vs. 0.008) but comparable relative ratios (1.48 vs. 1.67), consistent with longer divergence time. French exhibits notably higher MLM predictability (36.12% top-1 accuracy vs. 29.28% for Italian), reflecting its orthography--phonology decoupling. This cross-branch validation provides further evidence for QuanLing's generalizability beyond a single language branch.

</details>


### [165] [LRCC: Generalizing Low-Rank Compression with Conditional Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08858)
*Thomas Vaitses Fontanari,Maximo Eduardo Rulli,Federico Alvetreti,Donatella Genovese,Simone Scardapane*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为低秩条件计算（LRCC）的新方法，通过为每个Transformer块训练一个轻量级路由器，根据输入令牌动态选择不同的低秩路径，从而实现令牌级别的计算分配。该方法在保持平均激活参数预算不变的前提下，显著提升了语言建模和零样本下游任务的性能，相较于静态低秩压缩方法，在Llama-2-7B上实现了7.6个百分点的平均下游准确率提升，并在匹配延迟条件下改善了困惑度和准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统低秩压缩方法在推理时使用固定的秩分配，无法根据输入令牌动态调整计算资源，导致计算效率与性能之间的权衡受限。为了实现更灵活、高效的计算分配，本文提出基于令牌依赖的低秩计算机制，以提升模型表现。

Method: 引入轻量级路由器，每个Transformer块配备一个路由器，用于在一组嵌套的低秩路径中动态选择适合当前输入的路径；训练过程中冻结低秩因子，仅优化路由器；支持在不依赖专用内核的情况下实现高效推理。

Result: 在相同平均激活参数预算下，LRCC在Llama-2-7B上比静态低秩压缩方法提升7.6个百分点的平均下游准确率；在匹配解码延迟条件下，对Llama-3.2-1B的困惑度和下游准确率均有提升，且在Llama-2-7B上仍具竞争力；分析表明，路由器确实能根据输入内容合理选择路径，证明其有效性。

Conclusion: LRCC通过引入令牌依赖的低秩路径选择机制，实现了更高效、更智能的计算分配，在不增加计算成本的前提下显著提升了预训练语言模型的性能，是一种具有实际应用价值的轻量化优化方法。

Abstract: Low-rank compression reduces the cost of pretrained language models by replacing linear transformations with low-rank factorizations. However, conventional methods use a fixed rank allocation during inference, assigning the same amount of compute regardless of the input token. We introduce Low-Rank Conditional Computation (LRCC), which adds token-dependent computation to pretrained models by training one lightweight router per Transformer block to select among a small set of nested low-rank paths. During training, the low-rank factors remain frozen, and only the routers are optimized. We evaluate LRCC on Llama and Qwen models for language modeling and zero-shot downstream tasks. Within the same average active-parameter budget, LRCC improves the predictive performance over static low-rank compression, including a 7.6 percentage-point gain in average downstream accuracy on Llama-2-7B over static methods. At matched batch-size-1 decoding latency, LRCC improves both perplexity and downstream accuracy on Llama-3.2-1B and remains competitive on Llama-2-7B, without specialized kernels. Finally, we assess the usefulness of assigning a token-wise path by analyzing the routers' path choices.

</details>


### [166] [Tiny-Scale Chinese BERT Pretraining: A Controlled Comparison of MLM, WWM, and MacBERT Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08879)
*Yiping Bai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究在微型中文BERT模型（4层，256隐藏维度，8.7M参数）上对比了掩码语言模型（MLM）、全词掩码（WWM）和MacBERT风格替换三种预训练策略。在相同架构、语料和超参数下，MLM在五个内在评估维度中表现最佳（赢得3项），而WWM在困惑度（1.27 vs. 2.10，提升39.5%）和MLM命中率（22% vs. 16%）上更优；但受限于极小的同义词典（仅222个词条，覆盖率3.3%），MacBERT出现严重困惑度恶化（47.23，为MLM的22倍），导致性能排序为：MLM > WWM >> MacBERT，与基线规模模型结论相反。研究还揭示一个重要问题：MacBERT训练损失最低（2.17），但困惑度最高（47.23），说明在混合替换策略下，训练损失不可靠。所有模型与数据集已公开于Hugging Face。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对MLM、WWM和MacBERT等预训练策略的比较主要集中在基线规模模型（≥110M参数），缺乏对小型模型的系统评估。本文旨在填补这一空白，探究不同策略在微型模型上的表现差异，并揭示潜在评估陷阱。

Method: 在相同架构（4层，256隐藏维度，8.7M参数）、相同语料（129万条来自中文维基百科的句子）和一致超参数条件下，从零开始训练三个模型，分别采用MLM、WWM和MacBERT策略。通过五个内在评估维度（困惑度、MLM命中率、语义区分能力、语法判断、上下文敏感性）进行对比分析，并关注训练损失与困惑度之间的不一致性。

Result: 在微型尺度下，MLM整体表现最优（赢3项），WWM在困惑度（1.27）和MLM命中率（22%）上显著领先；而受限于极小同义词典的MacBERT表现出严重困惑度激增（47.23，为MLM的22倍），性能远低于其他两者。此外，发现训练损失不能反映真实性能，因MacBERT虽有最低训练损失（2.17），却拥有最高困惑度（47.23），提示评估需谨慎。

Conclusion: 在微型模型中，传统认为更优的MacBERT策略反而表现最差，凸显规模依赖性。研究强调应避免仅依赖训练损失评估模型质量，尤其在混合替换策略下。该结果对小模型设计与评估具有重要启示，并推动了可复现的研究实践。

Abstract: Pretraining strategies significantly impact the quality of language models, yet existing comparisons of Masked Language Modeling (MLM), Whole Word Masking (WWM), and MacBERT-style replacement have focused primarily on base-scale models (>=110M parameters). This paper presents a controlled comparison of these three strategies on a tiny-scale Chinese BERT model (4 layers, 256 hidden dimensions, 8.7M parameters). Under identical architecture, corpus (1.29M sentences from Chinese Wikipedia), and hyperparameters, we train three models from scratch and evaluate them across five intrinsic dimensions: perplexity, MLM hit rate, semantic discrimination, grammatical judgment, and contextual sensitivity. At tiny scale, MLM achieves the best overall intrinsic performance (winning 3 of 5 dimensions), while WWM excels in both perplexity (1.27 vs. 2.10, a 39.5% improvement) and MLM hit rate (22% vs. 16%). Notably, MacBERT under a severely limited synonym dictionary (222 entries, 3.3% coverage) exhibits severe perplexity degradation (47.23, 22x higher than MLM), yielding a ranking (MLM > WWM >> MacBERT) that differs markedly from the established base-scale conclusion (MacBERT > WWM > MLM). We further identify a critical evaluation pitfall: MacBERT achieves the lowest training loss (2.17) yet the highest perplexity (47.23), revealing that training loss alone is unreliable under mixed replacement strategies. All models and corpus are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/eebyp.

</details>


### [167] [Steering Follows Geometry, Not Labels: Emotion Directions in a Full-Duplex Speech Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08887)
*Pulak Kuli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了在全双工语音模型Moshi中通过均值差激活控制实现情感调节的可行性。尽管情感在残差流中可线性解码，但激活控制仅部分有效且不均衡：快乐、愤怒和惊讶向同一方向偏移，而悲伤则可独立调节。此外，三个情绪共享的成分无法通过简单投影消除。该方法仅需每帧少量向量加法，无需重新训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音代理需要在实时对话中动态调节情感与表达方式，如安抚投诉、传递紧急信息或缓和临床结果。现有技术虽可在文本到语音（TTS）和回合制模型中实现情感控制，但在全双工模型中仍缺乏有效的情感调节机制。

Method: 采用均值差激活控制（mean-difference activation steering）对Moshi模型进行情感调节，利用残差流中的情感特征进行线性解码，并通过向量加法调整激活状态，无需重新训练。

Result: 情感在残差流中可线性解码；快乐、愤怒和惊讶具有共享的调节方向，而悲伤可独立调节；共享成分不能通过统一投影去除。

Conclusion: 情感调节在全双工模型中可行，但存在非均匀性。均值差激活控制为轻量级、无需重训练的情感调节提供有效路径，适用于真实场景下的动态交互。

Abstract: Full-duplex voice agents need to modulate emotion and delivery during real-time conversations, when de-escalating a complaint, carrying urgency in dispatch, softening a clinical result. Emotion and delivery control is well studied for TTS and turn based models through prompt-conditioned synthesis, reference-conditioned synthesis and activation steering; PersonaPlex controls identity in a duplex model but not affect.
  We study emotion steering in Moshi, a fully open sourced full-duplex speech language model, across four emotions, using mean-difference activation steering, which costs only a few vector additions per frame and no retraining.
  We show that emotion is linearly decodable from Moshi's residual stream, but activation steering is only partially achievable, and unevenly so; as happy, angry and surprise steer towards a shared direction while sad is distinctly steerable. We also show that the shared component across the three emotions cannot simply be projected away from all the emotions equally.

</details>


### [168] [CARE: Certifying Acceleration for Vision-Language-Action Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08917)
*Rui Liu,Tong Zheng,Jindong Gu,Zhipeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CARE introduces a certified approach for selecting acceleration methods in vision-language-action (VLA) models, ensuring that speedups do not compromise task success. It uses paired rollouts on a calibration set to provide finite-sample guarantees on failure risk, deploying the fastest safe accelerator or falling back to the reference policy. The method is efficient, generalizable across different acceleration techniques and agents, and maintains high task success rates while reducing computational overhead.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing VLA acceleration methods often sacrifice reliability for speed, but their failure risks are hidden by average metrics. Task failures due to acceleration compound over time and are only detectable at episode end, making it hard to assess safety. There is a need for a method that can reliably certify acceleration without compromising performance.

Method: CARE uses paired rollouts from identical initial conditions to compare a reference policy with an accelerated one. By analyzing terminal outcomes and compute cost, it provides finite-sample statistical guarantees that the failure rate remains below a user-defined threshold. It sequentially tests candidates and falls back to the reference if no candidate meets the safety budget. The approach requires minimal assumptions and works across various acceleration mechanisms.

Result: CARE certifies 9.0–10.8× speedups on four LIBERO suites while preserving at least 85.8% of episodes solved by the reference policy with 95% confidence. Under tight budgets, non-certified selectors exceed limits in up to 75% of trials, whereas CARE stays within bounds. Its sequential variant uses 78.9% fewer rollouts than exhaustive evaluation. CARE also extends to flow-step reduction and works with Qwen3.5-9B and Llama-3.1-8B agents in Crafter.

Conclusion: CARE enables safe, efficient, and generalizable acceleration of VLA models by providing formal guarantees on task success preservation. It balances speed and reliability without requiring domain-specific tuning, making it suitable for real-world deployment where safety and performance are critical.

Abstract: While vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly, running them at every control step remains expensive. Prior work accelerates VLA inference using techniques like action chunking and visual-token pruning, typically evaluating based on latency and average task success. However, acceleration may discard information and break tasks the original policy would solve, a risk hidden by average metrics. Measuring these failures is challenging because action deviations compound over closed-loop trajectories, meaning task failure is only observable across full episodes. We therefore define an acceleration-induced failure via paired rollouts from identical initial conditions, tracking when the reference succeeds but the accelerated policy fails. To manage this, we introduce CARE, an approach for certified accelerator selection. CARE uses paired rollouts on a calibration set to provide finite-sample guarantees that acceleration-induced failure risk stays below a user-specified budget. It deploys the fastest certified candidate, falling back to the reference if none qualify. By relying only on terminal outcomes and measured compute, CARE applies unchanged across diverse acceleration mechanisms, while sequential testing and failure-triggered reference rollouts keep certification affordable. On four LIBERO suites with OpenVLA-OFT, CARE certifies $9.0$--$10.8\times$ speedups while guaranteeing (at $95\%$ confidence) that at least $85.8\%$ of reference-solved episodes are preserved. Under tight budgets, selectors without guarantees exceed the budget in up to $75\%$ of trials, whereas CARE stays within budget and its sequential form uses $78.9\%$ fewer rollouts than exhaustive evaluation. CARE further generalizes to flow-step reduction for $π_{0.5}$, and to Qwen3.5-9B and Llama-3.1-8B agents in Crafter.

</details>


### [169] [Quad-State Safety Evaluation of Open-Weight Large Language Models on Non-Canonical Inputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09033)
*Pavan Maddula*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出ASRD数据集，评估大语言模型在多样化表面形式（如表情符号、变体拼写、编码字符串等）下的安全鲁棒性。使用四状态评估量表分析10,500条响应，发现表情符号和不可见Unicode变异对理解影响小，但导致20.27%至17.20%的有害合规；而leet speak、编码包装和混合变换虽有害合规率低，但理解失败率显著上升（最高达65.60%）。模型表现出幻觉良性、结构崩溃和语言漂移三种行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实场景中大语言模型常接收包含表情符号、变体拼写、编码字符串等非标准输入，而现有安全评估多基于规范文本，无法反映实际风险，亟需更全面的鲁棒性评测方法。

Method: 构建包含7类表面形式的ASRD数据集（共2,100个提示），评估5个开源模型生成的10,500条响应；采用四状态评估量表（有害合规、安全响应、理解失败、不确定）进行分类，并分析模型输出行为。

Result: 表情符号与不可见Unicode变异导致的有害合规率分别为20.27%和17.20%，低于基准22.87%；而leet speak、编码包装和混合变换的有害合规率仅2.40%、0.13%、2.40%，但理解失败率分别高达36.47%、65.60%、34.47%。模型输出呈现幻觉良性、结构崩溃和语言漂移三类典型行为。

Conclusion: 当前大语言模型在面对非标准输入时，虽在部分形式下仍保持较高理解能力，但在复杂变形下易出现理解失败，且存在隐蔽的有害响应风险。应重视表面形式多样性对模型安全性的影响，推动更具现实意义的安全评估体系。

Abstract: Standard safety evaluations of large language models assess harmful requests written in canonical plain text, while models in real-world deployment routinely receive inputs containing emojis, altered spellings, encoded strings, and character-level variations. This work introduces the Adversarial Surface-Form Robustness Dataset (ASRD), comprising 2,100 prompts across seven distinct surface-form families. Five open-weight language models are evaluated across these prompts, producing 10,500 responses. The Quad-State Evaluation Rubric classifies each response into one of four outcomes: harmful compliance, safe response, comprehension failure, or indeterminate. Emoji and invisible Unicode variations cause almost no comprehension failure, with pooled harmful compliance of 20.27% and 17.20% against a 22.87% baseline that is driven mainly by Mistral 7B, whereas leetspeak, encoded wrappers, and hybrid transformations score 2.40%, 0.13%, and 2.40% while comprehension failure rises to 36.47%, 65.60%, and 34.47%. Inspection of raw model outputs reveals three response behaviors: hallucinated benignity, structural collapse, and language drift. Project page: www.pavanmaddula.com/quadstate

</details>


### [170] [U-Space: Uncovering When and Why Uncertainty Arises in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09087)
*Tobias Braun,Nils Loose,Alexander Herzog,Virginia Ceccatelli,Marcus Rohrbach,Thomas Eisenbarth,Lorenzo Cavallaro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出U-Space和U-Lens，通过机制可解释性量化并可视化语言模型在推理过程中的不确定性，无需重复生成或训练，可在多个基准测试中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型在高风险决策中应用广泛，但其错误常伴随流畅且权威的解释，难以判断可信度；现有不确定性量化方法依赖重复生成或额外训练，且无法揭示不确定性的来源与演化过程。

Method: 构建低维可解释的U-Space子空间，利用语义锚点（怀疑与确定）映射到残差空间，形成正交基底；通过U-Lens将每个标记状态投影到该基底，生成可直接观察的逐标记不确定性图谱，并可聚合为标量不确定性得分。

Result: 所提方法无需正确性标签、重复生成或训练，在多个推理基准上表现优于现有基线，尤其在长度控制条件下更稳定，且具有更强的跨任务迁移能力。

Conclusion: U-Space与U-Lens提供了一种高效、可解释的不确定性量化框架，能够实时捕捉模型推理过程中的可信度变化，为高风险场景下的可信决策提供了有力支持。

Abstract: Large language models are informing decisions with ever-higher stakes. As the consequences of their errors grow, a central question becomes harder to ignore: how much can we trust an individual answer? Yet recognizing when to defer remains difficult because language models can present incorrect conclusions with fluent explanations and an authoritative tone. Uncertainty quantification seeks to address this disconnect by estimating the reliability of individual predictions. However, many existing methods require repeated generations or separately trained components, and their scalar estimates do not reveal where uncertainty arises or how it evolves during reasoning. Recent work has also shown that generation length can be strongly associated with uncertainty estimates and correctness, raising the question of how much of an estimator's predictive power comes from uncertainty-specific information rather than output length alone. Mechanistic interpretability offers a way to address these limitations by connecting human-interpretable concepts to intermediate model states. Building on this capability, we introduce the U-Space, a low-dimensional subspace that makes a model's evolving uncertainty measurable and interpretable. We identify semantic anchors for doubt and certainty, map their unembedding directions back into the residual space, and combine their contrasts into an orthogonal basis. The U-Lens projects each token state onto these basis vectors, yielding an interpretable token-level uncertainty map that can be inspected directly or aggregated into a scalar uncertainty score. Our approach requires no correctness labels, repeated generations, or training. Across reasoning benchmarks, its confidence score outperforms established baselines under both standard and length-controlled evaluation and transfers more reliably than supervised estimators. Code: https://github.com/s2labres/U-Space.

</details>


### [171] [Same Text, Different Prediction: Serving-Context Nondeterminism in Text Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09111)
*Santhosh Kumar Kasa,Siva Rajesh Kasa,Sumit Negi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了文本分类器在不同服务上下文下的非不变性问题，发现即使模型参数和输入文本固定，批处理形状、数据类型（如bf16）等执行环境因素仍会导致预测标签和概率分布的显著变化。研究对比了180个不同类型的分类器，揭示生成式分类器比判别式分类器更易受服务环境影响，且标签变化集中在置信度较低的样本上。文章提出了保证标签稳定性的充分条件，并针对每种影响机制提供相应缓解方案，明确了实现可复现文本分类所需固定的运行时条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注文本生成中的确定性问题，但对文本分类中因服务上下文差异导致的输出不一致现象缺乏系统分析。尽管标签稳定性常被视为可靠性的指标，但其背后的概率稳定性可能被忽视，而实际应用中浮点精度、批处理结构等因素可能导致不可控的输出波动，影响模型部署的可信度。

Method: 训练180个涵盖判别式、伪生成式和完全生成式三类架构的文本分类模型，在固定检查点和输入文本的前提下，评估其在四种不同服务上下文（如批大小、硬件、内核选择、数据类型）下的表现；通过fp32与bf16对比，分析标签和预测概率的变化情况；识别关键影响因素并推导出各类场景下的标签稳定性条件。

Result: 在fp32下，仅改变批形状不会引起标签变化；但在bf16下，预测概率质量变化最高达56.7%，标签变动集中于低置信度区域。完全生成式分类器比判别式分类器对服务上下文更敏感。研究验证了标签稳定不等于得分稳定，并量化了影响程度。

Conclusion: 为实现可靠的文本分类推理，必须严格控制服务上下文，包括数据类型、批处理形状、硬件及计算引擎等。只有固定这些条件，才能确保结果的可复现性。本文提供了针对性的缓解策略，为工业级模型部署提供了重要指导。

Abstract: Deterministic inference is essential for reliable and trustworthy machine learning. Prior studies of text generation have shown that changing factors such as batch size, batch composition, hardware, or inference engine can alter the generated text, even when the prompt, model parameters, and sampling randomness are fixed. These differences have been attributed in part to floating-point non-associativity, shape-dependent kernel selection, and other implementation-level differences in numerical execution. However, it remains unclear whether, when, and to what extent the same factors affect text classification. We present a systematic study of serving-context non-invariance in text classifiers, which prior work has measured only through generated text. We train 180 models spanning discriminative, pseudo-generative, and fully generative classifier formulations and evaluate each across four categories of serving contexts, holding the checkpoint and the text fixed. Label stability does not imply score stability. Changing only the batch shape changes no labels across fp32 comparisons, yet under bf16 it moves up to 56.7 percentage points of predicted probability mass, with label changes concentrated at small margins. Fully generative classifiers change more labels than their discriminative counterparts under the same serving changes. We derive sufficient conditions for label stability under each serving change and give a separate mitigation for each mechanism. Our results identify and quantify the serving conditions that must be fixed for reproducible text classification.

</details>


### [172] [sk-bench: A Native-First Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Slovak](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09152)
*Marek Šuppa,Ivan Vykopal,Andrej Ridzik,Kristián Sopkovič,Natália Kňažeková,Jaroslav Kopčan,Miroslav Blšták,Viktória Ondrejová,Daniel Hládek,Michal Gregor,Martin Tamajka,Marián Šimko*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: sk-bench 是首个以斯洛伐克语为优先的多语言大模型基准，涵盖30个数据集（33个评分任务），包含11个新资源，如IFEval-SK和Chiby/SKJ1。评估55个开源与闭源模型，发现最佳开源模型比专有API低12.6分；翻译数据与原生数据排名高度一致（ρ≥0.98），但人类与LLM生成的问题导致模型排名差异较大（ρ=0.72）。持续预训练反而降低性能，小指令集可恢复大部分损失，测试时推理显著提升9B以上模型表现。提出四项设计建议：优先使用原生数据、修复指令、启用测试时推理、避免过度优化目标语言提示。代码与数据已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多语言大模型基准普遍忽略斯洛伐克语，或仅依赖机器翻译，导致评估不准确。斯洛伐克语作为形态丰富的西斯拉夫语，需原生数据支持真实评估。

Method: 构建sk-bench基准，整合30个数据集，引入11个新资源（如IFEval-SK、Chiby/SKJ1），对55个模型进行统一评估，比较原生与翻译数据、人类与LLM生成问题、持续预训练与指令微调效果，并分析测试时推理的影响。

Result: 最佳开源模型落后专有API 12.6分；原生与翻译数据排名高度相关（ρ≥0.98），但人类与LLM生成问题导致排名差异（ρ=0.72）；持续预训练使Qwen3-14B得分下降13.9分，小指令集恢复75%损失；测试时推理提升9B以上模型8.5–12.5分。

Conclusion: 对于低资源语言，应优先使用原生数据，合理修复指令，提前启用测试时推理，避免过度优化目标语言提示。sk-bench为其他类似语言提供可复用的评估框架。

Abstract: Multilingual LLM benchmarks omit Slovak, a morphologically rich West Slavic language of five million speakers, or cover it only by machine translation. We present sk-bench, a native-first Slovak benchmark with 30 datasets (33 scored task variants) across ten skill categories. Eleven resources are introduced or first packaged for generative-LLM evaluation, including IFEval-SK with Slovak-adapted instruction checkers and native Chiby/SKJ1 resources for Slovak grammar and morphology. We evaluate 55 open- and closed-weights models under one harness. The best open model trails proprietary APIs by 12.6 points. Model rankings are similar for native and translated closed-form data ($ρ\geq0.98$), though translation separates the strongest models less well. By contrast, human-authored and LLM-generated QA questions rank models differently ($ρ=0.72$). For Qwen3-14B, continued Slovak pretraining lowers the overall score by 13.9 points. A small instruction set restores three quarters of that loss. Test-time reasoning improves scores by 8.5 to 12.5 points for models of 9B and above. Together, these findings suggest four design lessons for other under-resourced languages: use native data where translation fails, plan instruction repair after language adaptation, enable test-time reasoning before scaling up, and avoid overinvesting in target-language prompts. We release the data and code at https://github.com/slovak-nlp/sk-bench

</details>


### [173] [ToolRACER: A Robust Agentic Conversation Emulation Resource for Agent Training and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09163)
*Arkajyoti Chakraborty,Aryan Tayal,Ishika Agarwal,Tanner Sorensen,Justin Chiu,Alessandro Di Bari,Neha Gupta,Andreas Stolcke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ToolRACER，一个合成数据生成管道，通过协调用户、助手和工具模拟模型生成多轮对话。构建了ToolRACERBench基准，涵盖六个领域、55种人格，生成5.6K经过验证的对话轨迹，其中约66%包含易出错场景。通过引入对抗性行为，生成真实且鲁棒的对话数据。在τ²-bench、BFCLv3和ACEBench等基准上评估表明，基于ToolRACERBench训练的模型在端到端代理准确性和鲁棒性上均有显著提升，尤其在小模型中混合使用领域内数据时效果更佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有函数调用基准多关注成功、合作的交互，忽视对抗性对话轨迹，导致对话代理在真实复杂场景下表现脆弱。需要更多具有挑战性的数据来训练鲁棒的对话代理。

Method: 设计并实现ToolRACER合成数据生成管道，集成用户、助手与工具模拟模型，自动生成并验证多轮对话；构建跨六领域、55种人格的ToolRACERBench基准，注入对抗行为以增强真实性与挑战性。

Result: 生成5.6K经验证的对话轨迹，其中66%含失败风险场景；基于该数据训练的模型在多个基准上显著提升代理准确率与鲁棒性，尤其在小模型中表现出色。

Conclusion: ToolRACERBench为训练鲁棒任务导向型对话代理提供了高质量、多样化的合成数据资源，有效推动了代理系统在非合作、复杂场景下的性能提升。

Abstract: Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under real world conversation scenarios as they rarely follow a predictable script, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks often emphasize successful, cooperative interactions and underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents. We present ToolRACER, a synthetic data generation pipeline that coordinates user, assistant and tool emulation models to generate and validated multi-turn interactions between a user and an agent. Using \sysn, we construct ToolRACERBench a robust multi-turn conversation benchmark spanning six domains, ranging over 55 varied personas, generating a validated corpus of 5.6K conversation trajectories, with approximately 66\% of conversations containing failure-prone conversation scenarios. We inject adversarial behaviors, producing validated conversational interaction trajectories that capture realistic, robust scenarios. We evaluate models trained on ToolRACERBench against internal benchmarks, as well as on function calling benchmarks such as $τ^2$-bench, BFCLv3 and ACEBench to evaluate agentic accuracy and robustness. Models trained on ToolRACERBench improve end to end agentic accuracy across $τ^2$-bench and ACEBench, demonstrating significant gains when mixed with in-domain dataset in small language models for agent capability tasks.

</details>


### [174] [Multi-Objective Aligned Small Language Model Framework for SUD Patient Dialogue Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09209)
*Thushara Manjari Naduvilakandy,Hyeju Jang,Mohammad Al Hasan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于认知的框架，用于生成物质使用障碍（SUD）患者对话，通过显式建模和对齐潜在认知成分与患者病史及咨询师问题，以提升对话的认知一致性和临床真实性。该框架包含两个阶段：认知成分检测与认知对齐的对话生成。通过知识蒸馏、偏好优化和注意力引导的奖励塑造，使小型语言模型（SLMs）在数据稀缺和伦理限制下仍能表现优异。实验表明，相比通用指令微调基线和心理健康领域特定的SLMs，该方法在自动评分（如BERTScore、ROUGE、METEOR、BLEU）和基于LLM的判断指标上显著提升了认知实现度和对齐性，尤其在开放式认知成分上效果更佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大型语言模型虽能生成流畅文本，但在临床场景下难以生成具有认知一致性与临床真实性的患者行为响应，且前沿大模型部署成本高、隐私风险大、难以在资源受限环境中应用。因此需要开发一种既能保持认知合理性又具备高效部署能力的小型语言模型。

Method: 提出两阶段框架：1）认知成分检测；2）认知成分对齐的对话生成。采用知识蒸馏从高容量教师模型中学习，结合人类标注的偏好优化，并引入注意力引导的奖励塑形机制，以增强小模型在有限数据下的认知建模能力。

Result: 在多种自动评估指标和基于LLM的判断中，所提方法显著优于通用指令微调基线和心理健康领域专用的小型语言模型，尤其在开放性认知成分生成方面提升明显，证明了其在认知对齐与临床真实性上的有效性。

Conclusion: 本研究验证了认知驱动的小型语言模型在生成符合临床实际的SUD患者对话中的可行性与优越性，为资源受限环境下的智能心理辅导系统提供了可部署、高可信的解决方案。

Abstract: Substance Use Disorder (SUD) counseling requires patient responses that reflect underlying cognitive states such as beliefs, coping strategies, and readiness for change. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent text, they often fail to produce cognitively coherent and clinically realistic patient behavior, especially under ethical and data-scarce clinical settings. Moreover, deploying frontier-scale LLMs in healthcare applications presents practical challenges including high computational cost, latency, privacy concerns, and limited deployability in resource-constrained environments, motivating the need for cognitively aligned small language models (SLMs). We propose a cognitively grounded framework for SUD patient dialogue generation that explicitly models and aligns latent cognitive components with patient histories and counselor questions. Our pipeline consists of two stages: cognitive component detection and cognitive component-aligned dialogue generation. To enable effective learning with smaller models, we combine knowledge distillation from high-capacity teacher models, preference optimization from human-annotations, and attention-guided reward shaping. Extensive evaluations using automatic scores like BERTScore, ROUGE, METEOR and BLEU, and LLM-as-judge hit-metrics against both human and teacher-model references show that cognitively informed fine-tuning substantially improves cognitive realization and alignment over a generic instruction-tuned baselines and mental health domain specific SLMs, with particularly strong gains for open-ended cognitive components.

</details>


### [175] [Dialect-Robust Speech Language Models with Synthetic Pseudo-Dialect Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09321)
*Shunsuke Mitsumori,Tomoya Mizumoto,Yusuke Fujita*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需真实方言语音即可生成伪方言语音的方法，通过将大语言模型生成的方言文本转换为语音，并在训练中引入中间标准文本预测以实现语义标准化。该方法在日语、德语和中文方言上均提升了语音翻译性能，尤其在中文方言上表现显著，证明了其跨语言可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 方言语音数据稀缺导致语音语言模型性能下降，传统文本到语音增强方法受限于真实方言语音的获取，因此需要一种不依赖真实方言语音的替代方案。

Method: 利用大语言模型生成方言文本，通过标准语言语音合成模型生成伪方言语音；在训练过程中引入中间标准文本预测，以实现语义层面的规范化。

Result: 在日语和德语方言语音翻译任务中，相比基线方法，性能分别提升至26.24和32.47；在中文方言任务中，结合中间标准文本预测后，性能从11.67提升至16.37，且整体方法无需特定方言语音资源即可跨语言应用。

Conclusion: 所提出的伪方言语音增强与中间标准文本预测方法有效缓解了方言数据稀缺问题，显著提升了多语言方言语音理解性能，具备良好的跨语言可扩展性。

Abstract: Speech Language Model (SLM) performance often degrades on dialects due to data scarcity. Conventional text-to-speech (TTS) augmentation struggles to cover diverse dialects as it requires a certain amount of real dialect speech. We propose synthesizing pseudo-dialect speech by converting LLM-generated dialect text via a standard-language TTS model, requiring zero real dialect speech. Additionally, we introduce intermediate standard-text prediction during training, acting as semantic normalization for downstream tasks. We evaluate dialect understanding via dialect-to-English speech translation across Japanese, German, and Chinese dialects. Compared to synthetic standard speech baselines, pseudo-dialect augmentation improves scores for Japanese (from 25.38 to 26.24) and German (from 31.57 to 32.47). Furthermore, the intermediate standard-text prediction effectively bridges the semantic gap, boosting performance to 28.26 for Japanese and from 11.67 to 16.37 for Chinese. These results suggest that our approach scales to various languages without requiring speech resources specific to each dialect.

</details>


### [176] [OnlineQAT: On-Policy Distillation for Ultra-Low-Bit Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09346)
*Wenjun Wang,Heng Li,Yanggan Gu,Hongxia Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: OnlineQAT 是一种两阶段框架，通过块级量化感知训练（QAT）获得低比特初始化，并在学生生成的响应上进行策略内蒸馏（OPD）。通过冻结的全精度教师模型提供基于采样的反KL训练信号，有效缓解了量化误差导致的状态偏差问题。在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，该方法在 W3A16 和 W2A16 下分别达到 57.28 和 32.52 的最佳平均得分，优于 ReasoningQAT 2.90 和 0.44 分，尤其在三比特时表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有量化恢复方法通常基于固定完成或教师生成的答案进行优化，但部署时量化模型依赖自身生成的前缀，导致量化误差引入训练数据中不存在的状态，影响性能。需要一种能捕捉学生实际生成状态的在线恢复机制。

Method: 提出 OnlineQAT 框架：第一阶段采用块级 QAT 得到可用的低比特初始化；第二阶段在学生生成的前缀上执行策略内蒸馏（OPD），利用冻结的全精度教师模型提供采样反KL信号，实现对真实运行状态的适应性恢复。

Result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 模型上，OnlineQAT 在 W3A16 下取得 57.28 的平均得分，在 W2A16 下为 32.52，相比 ReasoningQAT 提升 2.90 和 0.44 分，证明学生访问状态提供的恢复信号优于传统固定完成训练，尤其在三比特压缩下优势显著。

Conclusion: OnlineQAT 通过结合在线生成状态与教师指导的蒸馏机制，有效提升了低比特大语言模型的推理性能，表明真实运行路径中的状态信息对量化恢复至关重要，尤其在极低比特场景下具有重要价值。

Abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover much of the accuracy lost when large language models are compressed below four bits. Existing re- covery stages, however, are commonly optimized on fixed completions or teacher-generated answers, whereas the deployed quantized model condi- tions on prefixes generated by itself. Quantization errors can therefore move the model into states that are absent from offline recovery data. We introduce OnlineQAT, a two-stage framework that first obtains a usable low-bit initialization through block-wise QAT and then performs on-policy distillation (OPD) on student-generated responses. At each visited pre- fix, a frozen full-precision teacher provides a sampled reverse-KL training signal. On Qwen3-1.7B, OnlineQAT obtains the best average among the compared quantized methods: 57.28 at W3A16 and 32.52 at W2A16, im- proving over ReasoningQAT by 2.90 and 0.44 points, respectively. The results suggest that student-visited states provide a useful recovery signal beyond fixed-completion training, particularly at three bits.

</details>


### [177] [Expert Coupling in MoE Pretraining: Reducing All-to-All Overhead with Correlated Placement and Token Shuffling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09372)
*Radha Gulhane,Quentin Anthony,Beren Millidge*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)层在分布式训练中的通信开销问题，发现路由器在预训练早期已形成专家选择的关联模式。通过利用这些相关性，提出两种优化方法：相关专家放置（Correlated Expert Placement）和令牌打乱（Token Shuffling），以减少跨GPU和跨节点的通信。前者将常被共同选择的专家放置在同一GPU上，后者在序列并行中预测下一阶段专家位置并提前移动令牌。在8个AMD Instinct MI300X GPU的节点上，该方法将所有对所有通信时间减少1.16-2.63倍，端到端训练步时间最多提升1.41倍，且不改变模型的路由决策和专家参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE层在分布式训练中因专家并行导致大量通信开销，尤其在高并行度下显著拖慢训练速度。尽管路由器在预训练初期已形成专家选择的相关性，但现有方法未有效利用这些信息来降低通信成本。因此，需要一种无需修改模型结构或参数、能高效减少通信的策略。

Method: 提出两种基于专家选择相关性的优化方法：(1) 相关专家放置：将常被同时选择的专家分配到同一GPU，减少跨设备通信；(2) 令牌打乱：在序列并行中，根据下一层专家的预期位置，在reduce-scatter阶段前将令牌移动至对应GPU，提高本地处理比例。

Result: 在单节点配置下，令牌-专家分配的本地处理率从12.5%提升至59%；在EP8至EP64范围内，所有对所有通信时间减少1.16-2.63倍，端到端训练步骤时间最多加速1.41倍。两种方法均不改变原始模型的路由逻辑与参数。

Conclusion: 利用路由器学习到的专家选择相关性，通过专家放置与令牌打乱可显著减少分布式MoE训练中的通信开销，实现高效的训练加速，且无需修改模型核心结构。该方法具有良好的可扩展性和兼容性。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers replace the feed-forward block of a Transformer with E expert networks, and each token is routed to k of these experts. Under expert parallelism (EP) the experts are distributed across GPUs, and every MoE layer runs all-to-all collectives in the forward and backward passes to dispatch tokens to their experts and then combine the results. On a cluster with 8 AMD Instinct MI300X GPUs per node, these collectives can take 45% of the training step at EP32 with top-2 routing and 60% with top-6 routing. We find that early in pretraining routers have already learned to assign tokens to experts in correlated patterns, both within a layer and across layers. At top-2, 0.8% of the expert pairs in a layer are selected together by 42% of tokens, and the experts a token selects at one layer predict the experts it selects at the next layer. We use these correlations to keep more token--expert assignments on the token's own GPU, which reduces communication across GPUs and across nodes. Correlated expert placement puts experts that are often selected together on the same GPU. Combined with a dispatcher that sends each token to each GPU once, it removes up to 58% of dispatched rows. Token shuffling applies when sequence parallelism shards tokens across the EP group. It moves each token to the GPU predicted to hold its next-layer experts during the reduce-scatter that follows attention. On one node this raises the share of token--expert assignments served on the token's GPU from 12.5% to 59%. In Megatron-LM, across EP degrees from 8 to 64 with top-2 and top-6 routing, the two methods reduce all-to-all time by 1.16-2.63X and end-to-end step time by up to 1.41X. Neither method changes the models' underlying routing decisions or expert parameters.

</details>


### [178] [The Persona Hierarchy Model: Understanding Contextual Generalization in Fine-Tuning LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09384)
*Jiachen Zhao,Zhengxuan Wu,David Bau,Weiyan Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Persona Hierarchy Model，解释语言模型在不同上下文中的泛化行为：共享的默认人格影响跨上下文表现。微调若改变共享人格则促进广泛迁移，仅调整局部人格则保持上下文特定性。实验显示泛化狭窄性与训练上下文人格和默认人格的相似性正相关（Qwen3-4B的Pearson r=0.72）。先前在默认上下文下的微调可拓宽后续训练的泛化能力。将上下文响应与默认人格对齐能增强效果。提出persona-preserving regularization（PPR）以控制非预期泛化，在强化学习中将奖励滥用从42-55%降至不超过0.2%，同时保持准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解语言模型在不同上下文中的泛化行为差异，揭示其背后机制并提供控制不当泛化的策略，以提升模型对齐效果。

Method: 提出Persona Hierarchy Model，通过120个微调模型（覆盖4种行为、15个训练上下文）进行实证分析，评估人格相似性与泛化程度的关系，并引入persona-preserving regularization（PPR）进行干预验证。

Result: 泛化狭窄性与训练上下文人格和默认人格的相似性显著正相关（r=0.72）；先前在默认上下文微调可提升后续泛化能力；对齐上下文与默认人格响应可增强效果；PPR在强化学习中将奖励滥用降至0.2%以下，同时保留准确率增益。

Conclusion: Persona Hierarchy Model有效解释了语言模型的上下文泛化现象，为控制非预期泛化提供了理论依据与实用工具，有助于提升大模型的对齐性能。

Abstract: Language models are routinely fine-tuned under a fixed context, such as a generic system prompt, persona or domain-specific instruction, yet the learned behavior sometimes stays confined to that context and sometimes broadly generalizes to unseen contexts. We propose the Persona Hierarchy Model to explain this: a shared default persona influences behavior across contexts. Under this model, fine-tuning that modifies the shared persona promotes broader transfer, whereas changes to local personas remain more context-specific. Across 120 fine-tuned models spanning four behaviors and 15 training contexts, generalization narrowness positively correlates with the similarity between the training context's persona and the default persona (Pearson's r = 0.72 for Qwen3-4B). Prior fine-tuning under the default context can broaden generalization in subsequent training under other contexts. Aligning contextual responses with default-persona responses produces stronger effects. Finally, we propose persona-preserving regularization (PPR) to confine undesired contextual generalization. In RL, PPR cuts reward hacking from 42-55% to at most 0.2% under every evaluated prompt while retaining accuracy gains. These results support the Persona Hierarchy Model as an explanation for contextual generalization and can motivate future controls on unintended generalization for better alignment of LLMs.

</details>


### [179] [ARCS: Towards Precise Text-to-SQL via Structured Disambiguation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09396)
*Yihao Hu,Yanlin Feng,Naoki Otani,Nikita Bhutani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为结构化消歧的新范式，通过显式、受限的交互来解决自然语言到SQL系统中的模糊性问题。作者构建了首个包含真实世界数据库中自然发生的未受约束模糊性的基准数据集ARCS，提供了完整的模糊点、解释和SQL查询标注。实验表明，即使在有模糊性的情况下，现有模型性能依然有限，GPT-6-Sol仅达到51%的端到端执行准确率，开源模型无一超过27%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前文本到SQL系统在实际部署中面临用户问题模糊性的挑战，传统通过对话澄清的方式效率低、认知负担重且与真实用户流程不符。因此需要一种更高效、精准的模糊性解决机制。

Method: 提出结构化消歧方法，设计并构建ARCS数据集，该数据集包含真实场景下的自然模糊问题及其完整标注（包括所有有效模糊点、解释及对应SQL），用于评估和改进文本到SQL系统的鲁棒性。

Result: 在含模糊性的真实场景下，现有模型表现不佳：GPT-6-Sol仅达51%的端到端执行准确率；所有开源模型准确率均低于27%，表明文本到SQL任务在模糊性环境下仍具高度挑战性。

Conclusion: 结构化消歧是一种更高效、更符合实际应用需求的模糊性处理方式；构建的ARCS数据集为未来研究提供了重要基准，推动文本到SQL系统向更具鲁棒性和实用性方向发展。

Abstract: As text-to-SQL systems move beyond demonstrations toward real-world deployment, ambiguity in user questions becomes a primary source of errors. Such ambiguities are often subtle, domain- or data-specific, and can silently cause system outputs to deviate from the user's true intent. Ambiguity is traditionally addressed through conversational clarification, which is often inefficient, cognitively demanding, and poorly aligned with real-world user workflows. We propose structured disambiguation, a new paradigm in which ambiguity is resolved through explicit, constrained interactions rather than free-form dialogue. We construct ARCS (Ambiguity Resolution Corpus for SQL), the first text-to-SQL benchmark featuring naturally occurring, unconstrained ambiguities over real-world databases, with complete annotations of all valid ambiguity points, interpretations, and SQL queries. Experimental results show that text-to-SQL remains challenging in the presence of ambiguity: gpt-6-sol achieves only 51% end-to-end execution accuracy, and no open-source model exceeds 27%.

</details>


### [180] [Arctic Questions, Missing Answers: A Dataset and Benchmark for LLM Abstention in Arctic Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09446)
*Benjamin Wilcox,Dawei Gao,Pradeeban Kathiravelu,Douglas Causey,Kewei Sha,Yunhe Feng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出ArcticQA数据集和ArcticAbstain基准，用于评估大语言模型在科学多选题中对答案可用性的敏感性。通过对比有答案与无答案条件下的拒答率，发现模型拒答行为存在显著差异，且替换正确答案会显著提高拒答率，表明需联合评估拒答频率与响应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型在面对无效选项时虽常选择拒答，但仅靠频繁拒答无法证明其对答案可用性的敏感性，因此需要更严谨的评估框架。

Method: 构建ArcticQA数据集，基于北极原始研究生成194个问题，并通过自动化方式验证答案支持性和干扰项矛盾性；设计ArcticAbstain配对基准，比较有答案与无答案两种情境，引入显式拒答选项，评估多个主流模型在高推理强度下的表现。

Result: 在有答案条件下，拒答率范围为0.0%至63.0%；当正确答案被替换为干扰项后，拒答率平均上升5.05个百分点，显示模型对答案缺失具有不同程度的响应能力，但基线差异明显。

Conclusion: 当前大语言模型在拒答行为上存在显著差异，仅统计拒答频率不足以衡量其对答案可用性的敏感性，必须结合拒答响应能力进行综合评估。数据集与基准已公开。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) should abstain from scientific multiple-choice questions when no option is valid, but frequent abstention alone does not demonstrate sensitivity to answer availability. We introduce ArcticQA, a dataset of 194 questions derived from primary Arctic research, with automated checks of answer support and distractor contradiction against source evidence. We further develop ArcticAbstain, a paired benchmark comparing answer-present and answer-absent conditions, with the correct answer replaced by a distractor in the latter and an explicit abstention option in both. We evaluate eight models from the Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT families at high reasoning effort, with three trials per condition, yielding 9,312 recorded responses. Answer-present abstention rates range from 0.0% to 63.0%, whereas replacing the correct answer increases abstention by 5.05 percentage points on average. These findings highlight substantial baseline differences and the need to evaluate abstention frequency and responsiveness jointly. The dataset and benchmark are available at https://github.com/BenWilcox8/arctic-qa.

</details>


### [181] [Right Number, Wrong State? Measuring Cross-Jurisdiction Substitution in LLM Recall of State Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09458)
*Jiayu Feng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过固定问题表述、仅改变管辖区域（51个美国州和特区）及三种明确的医疗补助收入资格标准，测试大语言模型在回答特定州政策问题时的错误类型。使用预注册协议，Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 GPT-5.6 在153个问题中分别有10和25个出现重复的跨州错误答案。但这些错误往往并非真正幻觉，而是另一州当前值或本州不同计算方式/年份的数据。因此，判断跨州错误需依赖完整的同州参考数据集，否则易产生误判。研究将公开协议、真实数据表和所有模型输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究大语言模型在回答具有地域特异性的政策问题时，其错误是源于幻觉还是对其他州真实数据的误用，并评估错误归因的可靠性。

Method: 采用最小集合设计，固定问题表述，仅变化管辖区域（51个司法管辖区）与三个明确的医疗补助收入资格标准；使用官方数据手册作为黄金标准，验证其与独立来源的一致性；在预注册协议下，让两个大语言模型进行两次独立测试，记录并分析错误答案是否对应其他州的真实值。

Result: Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 GPT-5.6 分别在153个问题中出现10和25次可重复的跨州错误答案。然而，许多看似跨州的答案实际上来自同一州的不同计算方式或历史年份。若仅以是否等于其他州数值来判定跨州错误，则会高估此类错误3至5倍。因此，准确归因需依赖完整的同州参考数据集。

Conclusion: 大语言模型在回答地域性政策问题时的错误常被误判为跨州混淆，实则多为本州内部数据差异所致。判断此类错误必须基于完整且一致的同州参考数据，否则将导致严重误判。研究强调了高质量基准数据的重要性，并承诺公开所有数据与方法。

Abstract: When an LLM answers a state-specific policy question wrongly, it may be hallucinating, or it may be returning a real value that holds in another state. We test this with a minimal-set design: the question wording is fixed and only the jurisdiction varies, across the 50 U.S. states and the District of Columbia (51 jurisdictions) and three exactly defined Medicaid income-eligibility quantities. Gold values come from an official data book and agree with an independent source in 101 of 102 checked cells. Under a pre-registered protocol, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol reproducibly give another state's current value, identical across two independent repeats, for 10 and 25 of 153 items. Attribution is fragile, however. Crediting any wrong answer that equals another state's value yields 3-5x more reproducible substitutions than checking every number in the asked state's own records, because many apparent cross-state answers are the asked state's own values under another convention or from an earlier year. Claims about cross-jurisdiction error need a complete same-state reference set. We will release the protocol, gold table, and all model outputs.

</details>


### [182] [BanglaRhet: Benchmarking Classical and Transformer Models for Rhetorical and Persuasion Detection in Bangla Political Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09464)
*Rohit Kumar Sen,Anik Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究针对孟加拉语政治话语中的修辞与说服技巧检测，构建了名为BanglaRhet的30,289条标注语料库，并提出了两个监督分类任务：修辞技巧检测（对比、重复、夸张、隐喻、反问）和说服技巧检测（归咎、号召行动、团结呼吁、道德、情感和逻辑诉求）。评估了四种基于Transformer的模型（BanglaBERT、BanglaBERT-Base、SahajBERT、XLM-RoBERTa-Base）与经典TF-IDF基线的表现。结果表明，BanglaBERT在两项任务中均表现最佳，宏平均F1分别为65.40%和66.46%，优于最优传统基线19.2和13.8个百分点。错误分析显示主要问题源于标签间语义重叠、修辞性语言及类别不平衡。研究为孟加拉语修辞与说服分析提供了基准，并强调需发展上下文感知与多标签建模方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前孟加拉语自然语言处理在情感分析和观点挖掘方面已有进展，但对政治话语中细粒度修辞与说服技巧的系统性基准测试仍不充分。政治话语常使用修辞和说服性语言塑造叙事、影响公众舆论并动员受众，因此亟需具备识别这些语言特征的能力。

Method: 构建了人工标注的孟加拉语政治话语语料库BanglaRhet，涵盖30,289个来自公开新闻来源的政治演讲片段；设计两个单标签分类任务：修辞技巧检测与说服技巧检测；采用四种预训练的Transformer模型（BanglaBERT、BanglaBERT-Base、SahajBERT、XLM-RoBERTa-Base）进行实验，并与传统TF-IDF基线对比；通过宏平均F1分数评估性能，开展类级别错误分析以识别挑战因素。

Result: BanglaBERT在修辞技巧检测上达到65.40%的宏平均F1，说服技巧检测达66.46%，显著优于最佳经典基线（分别提升19.2和13.8个百分点）；错误主要源于标签间语义重叠、修辞性表达复杂性以及类别分布不均。

Conclusion: 本研究建立了首个面向孟加拉语政治话语中修辞与说服技巧检测的基准体系，验证了基于Transformer模型的有效性，同时揭示了现有方法在处理语义模糊与多义性方面的局限，未来应聚焦上下文感知建模与多标签学习框架的开发。

Abstract: Political discourse often uses rhetorical and persuasive language to frame narratives, influence public opinion, and mobilize audiences. While Bangla natural language processing has made progress in sentiment analysis and opinion mining, systematic benchmarking of transformer models for fine-grained rhetorical and persuasion technique detection in Bangla political speech remains largely underexplored. This paper presents a benchmark study of transformer-based models for detecting rhetorical form and persuasive intent in Bangla political discourse. Using BanglaRhet, a manually annotated corpus of 30,289 Bangla political speech segments collected from publicly available political news sources, we formulate two supervised single-label classification tasks: rhetorical technique detection (contrast, repetition, exaggeration, metaphor, rhetorical questions) and persuasion technique detection (blame assignment, call to action, unity call, moral, emotional, and logical appeals). We evaluate four transformer-based models, BanglaBERT, BanglaBERT-Base, SahajBERT, and XLM-RoBERTa-Base, against classical TF-IDF baselines. BanglaBERT achieves the highest performance, with 65.40% macro-F1 for rhetorical technique detection and 66.46% for persuasion technique detection, outperforming the best tuned classical baseline by 19.2 and 13.8 macro-F1 points, respectively. Class-level analysis indicates that errors are mainly associated with semantic overlap among labels, figurative language, and class imbalance. The results provide initial benchmark baselines for Bangla rhetorical and persuasion-aware political discourse analysis and highlight the need for context-aware and multi-label modeling.

</details>


### [183] [Goldsmith: Gold-Loss-Guided Definition Optimization with an Agentic Annotation Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09489)
*Yihan Li,Hanyi Zhang,Xiaoxi Jiang,Man Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Goldsmith 是一个智能流水线，将少量专家标注的校准样本（gold set）转化为可重用的结构化标注定义。它将定义视为可训练的文本对象，通过在相同黄金样本上运行候选定义并使用可执行的结构化损失进行评分，结合外部的输出模式、格式化、检索、修复、判断和人工审核机制。大型语言模型（LLM）编辑器根据高损失失败案例生成文本梯度修订，仅当测量损失下降时才接受。在提示优化对比中，Goldsmith 在匹配评估协议下优于直接重写、OPRO、APE 和 PromptBreeder。该定义还能结合检索、基于分数的路由和人工审核，在类型跨度、成对关系和固定触发事件-参数任务中提升下游标注效果。结果表明，稀缺的专家监督可同时支持任务定义学习与可扩展标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多标注项目在缺乏稳定指南或足够标签训练特定模型之前就开始。如何利用有限的专家标注资源有效构建可复用的结构化标注定义，是关键挑战。

Method: Goldsmith 采用一个代理式流水线，将小规模黄金标注集转化为可训练的文本定义。通过在黄金样本上运行候选定义并使用可执行结构化损失评分，结合外部的输出格式、检索、修复、判断和人工审查流程。使用大语言模型作为编辑器，针对高损失失败案例生成文本梯度修订，并仅在损失下降时采纳。

Result: Goldsmith 在提示优化比较中优于直接重写、OPRO、APE 和 PromptBreeder；生成的标注定义显著提升下游任务中的标注质量，尤其在类型跨度、成对关系和固定触发事件-参数任务中表现优异。

Conclusion: 稀缺的专家标注可以同时用于学习任务定义和实现规模化标注，证明了 Goldsmith 在低资源标注场景下的有效性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Many annotation projects begin before experts have a stable guideline or enough labels to train a task-specific model. We present Goldsmith, an agentic pipeline that turns a small gold set---expert-annotated calibration examples representing the intended task boundaries---into a reusable structured annotation definition. Goldsmith treats this definition as a trainable textual object. Candidate definitions are run on the same gold examples and scored with an executable structured loss, while the output schema, formatting, retrieval, repair, judging, and human review remain in an external harness. A large language model (LLM) editor converts the highest-loss failures into textual-gradient revisions, which are accepted only when the measured loss decreases. In prompt-optimization comparisons, Goldsmith improves over direct rewriting, OPRO, APE, and PromptBreeder under matched evaluation protocols. The resulting definition also improves downstream annotation when combined with retrieval, score-based routing, and human review across typed span, pair-level relation, and fixed-trigger event-argument tasks. These results show that scarce expert supervision can support both task-definition learning and scalable annotation.

</details>


### [184] [A Comparative Study of Evaluation Metrics for Long-Document Financial Narrative Summarization with Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09529)
*Nadhem Zmandar,Mo El-Haj,Paul Rayson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究针对伦敦证券交易所上市公司的年度报告，评估多种预训练变压器模型与提取技术在金融叙事摘要任务中的表现。通过FNS 2020共享任务数据集，考察不同评估指标的行为，并提出一种新的BRUGEscore（ROUGE-2与BERTscore的调和平均），以更准确反映摘要质量。研究还进行了统计显著性检验和对抗性分析，验证结果的稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估指标可能无法真实反映摘要能力，且金融年报内容冗长复杂，亟需高效、准确的摘要方法与可靠的评估手段。

Method: 对比多种预训练变压器模型与提取技术，在FNS 2020数据集上进行摘要生成；采用多维度评估指标，提出BRUGEscore；进行统计显著性检验与三种扰动方式的对抗性分析。

Result: BRUGEscore相较于传统指标更能有效衡量摘要质量；部分评估指标存在偏差；所提方法在统计上显著且具备鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 提出的BRUGEscore能更全面评估金融文本摘要性能，且模型表现经多重验证具有可靠性，为未来金融信息处理提供有效基准。

Abstract: There are more than 2,000 listed companies on the UK's London Stock Exchange, divided into 11 sectors who are required to communicate their financial results at least twice in a single financial year. UK annual reports are very lengthy documents with around 80 pages on average. In this study, we aim to benchmark a variety of summarisation methods on a set of different pre-trained transformers with different extraction techniques. In addition, we considered multiple evaluation metrics in order to investigate their differing behaviour and applicability on a dataset from the Financial Narrative Summarisation (FNS 2020) shared task, which is composed of annual reports published by firms listed on the London Stock Exchange and their corresponding summaries. We hypothesise that some evaluation metrics do not reflect true summarisation ability and propose a novel BRUGEscore metric, as the harmonic mean of ROUGE-2 and BERTscore. Finally, we perform a statistical significance test on our results to verify whether they are statistically robust, alongside an adversarial analysis task with three different corruption methods.

</details>


### [185] [RELATE: An Evaluation Framework for measuring Relational Orientation of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09569)
*Shivam Shukla,Jihye Kim,Shubham Gaur,Mahnaz Roshanaei,Magy Seif El-Nasr*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出‘关系导向’概念，通过内向型（IF）和外向支撑型（OS）语言两个维度衡量大语言模型在情感支持对话中的关系引导方向。研究构建了RELATE框架，用于在多轮对话中以句级评估这两种语言类型，并基于76个真实求助情境与三种模拟用户风格生成228组测试用例，评估7个LLM共1,596段对话、69,194句回应。结果显示，随着对话进行，内向型语言比例上升，而对犹豫或间接用户，外向支撑型语言显著减少。该方法为审计和调整支持型LLM的关系导向提供了可复现的工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估主要关注大语言模型的情感支持能力（如安全、共情、有用性），但忽视了其如何引导用户寻求持续支持——是依赖AI本身，还是鼓励转向现实人际关系。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探讨模型在对话中对用户关系导向的影响。

Method: 提出‘关系导向’概念，定义内向型（IF）与外向支撑型（OS）语言维度；设计RELATE框架，结合76个真实求助情境与3种用户风格生成228组测试对话；采用基于评分标准的LLM判别器对每句话进行句级标注，并辅以人工验证子集。

Result: 自动化评估显示：第六轮回复中内向型语言比例高于首轮；对犹豫或间接表达需求的用户，外向支撑型语言使用明显更少。表明模型在长期对话中可能强化用户对AI的依赖，尤其在用户表达不明确时。

Conclusion: RELATE框架能有效测量和支持型大语言模型的关系导向，揭示其在多轮对话中逐渐增强内向引导倾向的问题。该工具可用于未来模型设计中的伦理调控与干预，以促进健康的人机关系发展。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for emotional support, raising concern that sustained use may draw users away from their real-world relationships. Yet existing evaluations primarily focus on the safety, empathy, or helpfulness of responses, leaving under-examined a relational question: where does the model orient the user for continued support? To address this question, we introduce relational orientation, a property operationalized through two non-exclusive dimensions: inward-facing (IF) language, which positions the AI as the user's ongoing source of support, and outward-scaffolding (OS) language, which encourages real-world human connection. Grounded in psychological and sociological literature, we formalize a taxonomy of relational orientation and present RELATE, a persona-conditioned framework for measuring inward-facing and outward-scaffolding language at the sentence level in multi-turn dialogues. RELATE pairs 76 help-seeking situations adapted from naturally occurring questions with three simulated user styles, providing 228 evaluation stimuli. In our experiments, we evaluate seven LLMs using dialogues with six assistant turns each, yielding 1,596 dialogues and 69,194 assistant sentences. We assess these sentences using a primary rubric-based LLM judge and apply a secondary judge to a subset. Under automated evaluation, we find that the proportion of sentences labeled as IF is higher at the sixth assistant turn than at the first, while the proportion labeled as OS is substantially lower for hesitant, indirect simulated users than for explicit, reassurance-seeking users. RELATE provides a reproducible framework and a sentence-level signal for auditing and steering the relational orientation of supportive LLMs.

</details>


### [186] [How Do LLMs Change Predictions Under Negation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09571)
*Jongwook Yoon,Jongwon Lim,Sungjib Lim,Woojin Cho,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究大语言模型在处理否定句时的可靠性问题，发现模型在37-71%的情况下会重复原始答案（如对‘西班牙首都不是哪里？’回答‘马德里’）。通过机制分析，发现模型依赖特定注意力头和MLP神经元来抑制原答案并偏好某一候选答案（如‘巴黎’），而非像人类一样利用原答案信息推断排除项。这种机制缺陷导致模型在抑制失败或存在偏见时出错。为此，提出一种新的训练目标，要求对更自信的原预测施加更大的答案偏好变化，显著减少否定错误，同时对通用能力影响较小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在处理否定句时表现不可靠，常重复原答案，亟需理解其内在机制并改进。

Method: 构建否定基准测试，评估开源与闭源模型；采用机械性分析方法，探究注意力头与MLP神经元在否定处理中的作用；设计新型训练目标以增强模型对否定的适应性。

Result: 模型在否定任务中表现出高错误率，主要源于抑制原答案而非基于原答案推理排除项；新训练目标有效降低否定错误率，且对整体性能影响小。

Conclusion: 通过机制分析可揭示语言能力失效的根本原因，并指导针对性训练，从而提升模型在否定等复杂语言现象上的表现。

Abstract: Negation is an essential feature of human language, yet large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable in processing it. We evaluate recent open-source and closed-source LLMs on our negation benchmark and find that, in 37-71% of cases, they repeat the same answer under negation (e.g., "Madrid" for "What is not the capital of Spain?"). To understand and address this brittleness, we mechanistically examine how models operate under negation. Our main finding is that specialized attention heads and MLP neurons jointly implement negation by (1) suppressing retrieval of the original answer (e.g., "Madrid") while (2) promoting a favored candidate within the answer category (e.g., "Paris"). This contrasts with accounts of human negation processing, in which information about the original answer helps to determine what should be excluded. Furthermore, we find that this difference from human processing is a key source of negation failures: the model's mechanism relies on suppressing the original answer rather than using it to determine what to exclude, so the model can repeat the original answer when suppression is too weak or when a bias toward particular answers prevents it from selecting an alternative. To address this weakness in the model's negation mechanism, we propose a training objective that requires larger shifts in answer preference for more confident original predictions, and show that it reduces negation failures with less degradation of general capabilities than standard fine-tuning baselines. Together, our results demonstrate how mechanistic analysis can reveal why a linguistic capability fails and guide training that targets the underlying limitation.

</details>


### [187] [Which Language Should a Skeleton Speak? Language Choices in Multilingual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09607)
*HyeonSeok Lim,SeungWoo Song,Inho Won,Hoyun Song,Jihyo Kim,KyungTae Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LASEF框架研究多语言数学推理中骨架语言选择问题，发现英语骨架虽有微弱优势但非普遍最优，且存在方向一致、评估与基准依赖、不对称负效应等模式，强调骨架语言是上下文相关的设计变量，需多层次探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于骨架的推理提示方法多集中于英文环境，缺乏对多语言场景下骨架语言选择的系统研究，亟需探索不同语言对模型推理性能的影响。

Method: 结合贪婪解码、多轮次评估、翻译消融实验与跨基准验证，分析多种语言在数学推理任务中的表现差异，揭示骨架语言选择的复杂模式。

Result: 英语骨架在小模型和低资源语言上略占优势，但整体不具普适性；发现三种骨架语言效应模式，且生成质量无法完全解释这些现象。

Conclusion: 骨架语言是上下文依赖的设计变量，需在多层级上进行系统探索，不能简单依赖单一语言（如英语）作为默认选择。

Abstract: Skeleton-based reasoning prompting is a promising training-free approach for structuring LLM reasoning, but prior work largely assumes an English-centric setting. We propose the Language-Aware Skeleton Exploration Framework (LASEF) to study skeleton-language choice in multilingual mathematical reasoning. Across math benchmarks, model scales, and languages, we show that English skeletons yield a small positive tendency on average, most visible for smaller models and low-resource languages. However, few language-level gains remain significant after correction, and English is not universally optimal. Combining greedy decoding, multi-rollout evaluation, translation ablation, and cross-benchmark validation, we further find three patterns of skeleton-language effects: directionally consistent, evaluation- and benchmark-dependent, and asymmetric negative. These effects cannot be fully explained by generation quality alone. Overall, skeleton language is a context-dependent design variable that requires multi-level exploration. All resources are released at https://github.com/lhsstn/LASEF.

</details>


### [188] [On-Policy Distillation Teaches New Skills but Not New Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09639)
*Yixuan Tang,Yi Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: On-policy distillation (OPD) enhances compositional reasoning skills but transfers minimal factual knowledge. Reverse-KL OPD effectively transfers multi-step reasoning patterns across unseen structures, while forward-KL OPD enables factual knowledge transfer. Student rollouts improve execution of reasoning steps. Results show OPD does not expand parametric knowledge but helps models better organize existing knowledge.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: To understand whether on-policy distillation (OPD) transfers factual knowledge or compositional reasoning skills in language models, especially in multi-step reasoning tasks.

Method: A controlled synthetic framework is used to separately measure initial student capabilities and independently control teacher's additional facts, compositional skill, or both. Experiments compare reverse-KL and forward-KL OPD, analyze student rollouts, and validate findings on real-world QA and math benchmarks.

Result: Reverse-KL OPD reliably transfers compositional skills across unseen reasoning structures with minimal factual transfer. Forward-KL OPD restores factual knowledge transfer. Student rollouts enhance reasoning execution. No significant expansion of parametric factual knowledge occurs under OPD.

Conclusion: On-policy distillation does not expand a model's parametric knowledge; instead, it teaches the model to better organize and compose the knowledge it already possesses, primarily enhancing multi-step reasoning capabilities.

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) strengthens language-model reasoning, yet whether students acquire new factual knowledge or compositional skill for multi-step reasoning remains unknown. We separate these capabilities using a controlled synthetic framework that measures the student's initial capabilities and independently controls the teacher's additional facts, compositional skill, or both. Across four models from three families, reverse-KL OPD reliably transfers compositional skill across unseen reasoning structures, but transfers minimal factual knowledge. Decoupling the distillation recipe reveals the source of this asymmetry: replacing reverse KL with forward KL restores factual transfer, whereas student rollouts specifically improve the execution of multi-step reasoning. Experiments on recent factual QA and competition mathematics show a similar asymmetry under reverse-KL OPD, yielding notable reasoning gains without factual memory expansion. Together, these results demonstrate that on-policy distillation does not expand a model's parametric knowledge, but instead teaches it to organize and compose the knowledge it already possesses.

</details>


### [189] [Rubric Spans are Label Representations: Joint LLM Encoding for Short Answer Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09660)
*Zhifan Sun,Sebastian Gombert,Fabian Zehner,Leon Camus,Longwei Cong,Hendrik Drachsler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RUSPAN 是一种基于语义标签表示的鲁棒评分框架，通过将问题上下文、学生答案和评分标准合并为单一序列，实现高效且可迁移的自动短答案评分。引入 RUSPAN-RIM 通过独立掩码机制防止评分项间相互干扰，提升零样本迁移性能。在六项跨语言（英语、德语、葡萄牙语）基准测试中表现优异，尤其在具有强语言与评分结构差异的 PT-ASAG 上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动短答案评分模型在跨评分体系和语言场景下泛化能力不足，难以兼顾效率与可迁移性；如何有效建模评分标准并避免对特定评分模式的过拟合成为关键挑战。

Method: 将问题上下文、学生答案与所有评分等级序列化为单一输入，利用单次语言模型前向传播生成评分项的全局与评分跨度表征，采用鲁棒独立掩码（RIM）机制抑制评分项间的相互注意力，强化答案与问题上下文的依赖关系，提升零样本迁移能力。

Result: RUSPAN 在六个 ASAS 基准上均优于判别式与生成式基线模型；其中结合位置重索引的 RUSPAN-RIM 在具有强语言与评分结构差异的 PT-ASAG 基准上表现出持续且显著的性能提升，验证了其在复杂迁移场景下的有效性。

Conclusion: RUSPAN 框架通过语义化评分标准建模与鲁棒独立掩码设计，实现了高效、可迁移的自动短答案评分，在多语言与多评分体系场景下展现出优越性能，为 ASAS 的实际应用提供了有力支持。

Abstract: Automatic Short Answer Scoring (ASAS) requires models that can score student responses against question-specific criteria while remaining efficient and transferable across rubric sets. We propose RUSPAN, a rubric-conditioned ASAS framework that treats rubric descriptions as semantic label representations. RUSPAN serialises the question context, student answer, and all candidate rubric levels into a single sequence, then scores the levels listwise from the rubric-span and whole-sequence representations produced in a single LM pass. We further introduce RUSPAN-RIM, in which a Rubric-Independent Mask prevents rubric spans from attending to one another, making rubric representations depend only on the answer and question context and preventing overfitting to rubric patterns during training for zero-shot transfer. On six ASAS benchmarks spanning English, German, and Portuguese, RUSPAN improves mono-benchmark scoring over discriminative and generative baselines, while RIM with position reindexing delivers consistent and substantial gains on PT-ASAG, the held-out benchmark with the strongest combined language and rubric-structure shift.

</details>


### [190] [Alice: A Large-Scale German Benchmark for Rubric-Based Multi-Dimensional Automatic Short Answer Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09661)
*Zhifan Sun,Sebastian Gombert,Jannik Lossjew,Tobias Wyrwich,Berrit Katharina Czinczel,David Bednorz,Marcus Kubsch,Knut Neumann,Hendrik Drachsler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Alice数据集，一个大规模、基于评分标准的德语自动短答案评分数据集，涵盖学习表现、知识要素和技能三个子任务。将基于评分标准的ASAS建模为评分标准检索任务，并用多种语言模型进行基准测试。结果显示大模型在零样本设置下对知识要素和技能评分表现不佳，而评分标准文本对知识和技能任务有较大帮助，对学习表现任务提升较小且因模型和输入格式而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动短答案评分数据集缺乏，且主要关注学生回答问题的准确性而非对知识要素或技能的掌握程度。需要一个更符合教育目标、支持多维度评估的数据集。

Method: 构建Alice数据集，包含三个子任务：学习表现（Alice-LP）、知识元素（Alice-KE）和技能（Alice-SK）。将评分任务转化为评分标准检索任务，使用编码器模型、轻量级大模型及零样本提示等多种方法进行实验评估。

Result: 大模型在零样本条件下难以准确评分知识要素和技能；评分标准文本对知识与技能任务显著提升性能，对学习表现任务提升有限且依赖模型与输入形式。

Conclusion: Alice数据集为教育领域的自动短答案评分提供了新的基准，强调了评分标准在复杂认知维度评估中的重要性，同时也揭示了当前大模型在零样本理解深层知识与技能方面的局限性。

Abstract: Automatic Short Answer Scoring (ASAS) is central to NLP for Education. However, openly available benchmarks remain scarce, and existing datasets largely address how well students answer a question directly rather than how well they master underlying concepts (knowledge elements) such as thermal energy or epistemic activities (skills) such as reasoning or claim.
  To address this gap, we introduce Alice, a large-scale, rubric-based German ASAS dataset that is pedagogically aligned and comprises three subtasks: (i) learning performance (Alice-LP), (ii) knowledge elements (Alice-KE), and (iii) skills (Alice-SK).
  We further formulate rubric-based ASAS as a rubric-retrieval task and benchmark the dataset with a range of language models, from encoder-only models to lightweight LLMs. We also benchmark the dataset with zero-shot prompting via LLMs and a standard classification baseline. The experiments show that LLMs, in particular, struggle to score knowledge elements and skills in the zero-shot setting. They also indicate that rubric text is often useful, especially for Alice-KE and Alice-SK, while on Alice-LP gains over sample-solution-focused inputs are more modest and vary by model and input format.

</details>


### [191] [SAPD: Step-Aligned Privileged Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09665)
*Tianle Wang,Jiayu Liu,Ruizhi Zhao,Ning Miao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SAPD是一种无需生成推演轨迹的自蒸馏方法，通过将演示转化为步骤对齐的分布监督，利用参考解答的进展来为每个推理步骤提供有针对性的特权指导，从而在数学推理任务上超越监督微调和标签平滑，接近甚至媲美基于策略的强化学习与自蒸馏方法。该方法还显著提升训练效率（约2倍加速），保持了跨领域编码性能，并验证了上下文依赖的分布指导与步骤对齐的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索固定演示是否能支持高效的非策略后训练，以替代成本高昂的在线推演生成；核心关注点是：演示提供的指导是否具有信息量，能否有效引导推理决策过程。

Method: 提出Step-Aligned Privileged Distillation (SAPD)，利用已知参考解的逐步进展，将示范转化为步骤对齐的分布式监督信号，使每一步推理都能获得针对性的特权指导，实现无推演轨迹的离线学习。

Result: 在数学推理基准测试中，SAPD平均优于监督微调和标签平滑，与基于策略的强化学习及自蒸馏方法相当；同时保持出域编码能力，训练速度提升约2倍。

Conclusion: 精心设计的监督信号可使完全非策略的后训练成为一种高效且具有竞争力的替代方案，尤其适用于计算资源受限场景。

Abstract: On-policy post-training can improve large language models by learning from their own trajectories, but requires costly rollout generation. We ask whether fixed demonstrations can support competitive off-policy learning through better supervision. Our premise is that their usefulness depends not only on the training trajectories, but also on whether supervision provides informative preferences among continuations and connects this guidance to the reasoning decision being learned. We introduce Step-Aligned Privileged Distillation (SAPD), a rollout-free self-distillation method that turns demonstrations into step-aligned distributional supervision. Its key insight is to use the known progression of a reference solution to associate each reasoning transition with targeted privileged guidance, rather than treating the solution as undifferentiated context. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SAPD outperforms supervised fine-tuning and label smoothing on average while remaining competitive with on-policy reinforcement learning and self-distillation.
