  Results: Among 123 residents (mean age, 24.1 years +/- 1.4; 65 women), radiology residents showed greater accuracy improvement with dual- than single-suggestion support (B-A, 6.69 percentage points [95% CI, 0.97-12.40]; C-A, 7.87 percentage points [95% CI, 1.64-14.11]; Holm-adjusted P = .030 for both), whereas accuracy change did not differ in non-radiology residents (P = .20). When GPT-5.4 was incorrect, AI-assisted accuracy was higher with dual- than single-suggestion support in radiology residents (40.1% and 40.4% vs 20.0%) and non-radiology residents (31.3% and 31.0% vs 12.1%) (all Holm-adjusted P < .001). The dual-suggestion effect differed by specialty (interaction difference, 10.44 percentage points; 95% CI, 4.36-16.52; P < .001).
  Conclusion: Dual-suggestion support may mitigate the influence of erroneous AI suggestions, with greater accuracy improvement observed in radiology but not non-radiology residents.

</details>


### [288] [Learning Situation-Conditioned Thinking Policies for Long-Term LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09590)
*Hong Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种情境条件化的思维记忆框架，将历史推理经验转化为轻量级策略，用于预测当前情境下应思考的内容，同时将详细推理留给大语言模型。该框架能识别跨多个独立体验的长期规律，并将其固化为新的思维知识，提升推理效率与准确性。实验表明，该方法在时间规则泛化、关系发现和未来思考方面表现优异，显著提升推理性能并大幅降低处理时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆机制无法有效学习何时激活特定思维方式，也无法从分散的历史经验中发现新思维知识，导致长期自主代理难以高效复用历史经验。

Method: 提出情境条件化的思维记忆框架，通过分析临时经验中的长期规律，将其转化为轻量级策略，指导大语言模型在不同情境下的思考内容。

Result: 在时间规则泛化上达到1.000 F1，DeepSeek推理F1从0.789提升至0.868，每查询处理时间从0.3636毫秒降至0.0382毫秒（3万历史情境下），关系发现和未来思考准确率均达1.000。

Conclusion: 所提框架有效实现了对历史推理经验的高效利用，通过轻量级策略指导思考，显著提升推理性能与效率，具备良好的泛化能力与可扩展性。

Abstract: Long-running autonomous agents must reuse accumulated reasoning experience without allowing explicit historical memory and LLM context to grow indefinitely. However, existing memory mechanisms mainly retrieve, summarize, or compress past content and do not directly learn when particular kinds of thinking should be activated or discover new thinking knowledge from temporally dispersed experiences. This paper proposes a situation-conditioned thinking memory framework that transforms historical reasoning experience into a lightweight policy for predicting what should be thought about in the current situation, while leaving detailed reasoning to a large language model. Situations may represent temporal or spatiotemporal evolution rather than only current states. Temporary experiences are also periodically analyzed across multiple independent episodes to identify repeated long-range regularities, which are consolidated into new thinking knowledge and further internalized by the lightweight policy. Experiments show that the learned policy achieves 1.000 F1 on temporal-rule generalization, improves DeepSeek reasoning F1 from 0.789 to 0.868, reduces online processing time from 0.3636 ms to 0.0382 ms per query at 30,000 historical situations, and reaches 1.000 relation-discovery F1 and future-thinking accuracy after sufficient repeated cross-experience evidence.

</details>


### [289] [SafeEvo: Deciphering the Safety Alignment Mechanism and Evolution in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09600)
*Miao Yu,Hao Huang,Lu Yuan,Yunpeng Li,Kun Wang,Zuming Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SafeEvo框架，从电路视角分析预训练模型中的安全机制及其在对齐过程中的演化。通过优化提取算法识别出可独立表达拒绝行为的弱拒绝电路，并发现对齐过程中这些电路结构逐步变化，暗示对齐代价可能源于拒绝电路更新影响了与效用相关的参数。进一步提出安全电路对齐（SCA）方法，将安全更新限制在拒绝电路中，实验表明SCA在降低有害性、减少过度拒绝和保持模型能力方面显著优于传统对齐方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注对齐后模型的安全表示、注意力头或神经元，忽视了预训练模型中的安全机制及其在对齐过程中的演变。需要从内部机制层面理解安全对齐的动态过程，以提升对齐效率并减少副作用。

Method: SafeEvo框架包含两个核心步骤：1）使用优化基提取算法识别预训练模型中的弱拒绝电路；2）追踪对齐过程中拒绝电路的演化路径。同时提出安全电路对齐（SCA）策略，仅在拒绝电路上进行安全更新，避免影响其他功能模块。

Result: 在三个LLM和两种对齐算法上验证，SCA平均使有害性降低63.21%，对良性查询的拒绝率下降58.44%，同时保留99.58%的原始模型能力，显著优于传统对齐方法。

Conclusion: 安全机制存在于预训练模型中且随对齐过程动态演化。通过聚焦于拒绝电路进行对齐，可实现更强的安全性、更少的过拒行为以及更高的模型实用性，为高效、低代价的对齐提供了新范式。

Abstract: Safety interpretability advances the study of Large Language Model (LLM) alignment from behavioral constraints driven by data or algorithms towards a deeper understanding of internal mechanisms. However, existing works have focused primarily on safety-related representations, attention heads, or neurons after alignment, while largely overlooking the safety mechanisms in pretrained-only models and their evolution across alignment checkpoints. To address this, we propose SafeEvo, an interpretability framework from the circuit (sparse subgraphs of an LLM) perspective. SafeEvo first applies an optimization-based extraction algorithm to identify weak refusal circuits in pretrained base LLMs that can independently express refusal behavior. Causally ablating these circuits completely eliminates the base model's refusal of harmful inputs. SafeEvo then traces the evolution of refusal circuits across successive alignment checkpoints and finds that their structures change progressively, suggesting that the alignment tax may result from refusal-circuit updates affecting utility-related parameters. To validate this, SafeEvo introduces Safety Circuit Alignment (SCA), which confines safety updates to the refusal circuits. Experiments across three LLMs and two alignment algorithms show that, on average, SCA outperforms vanilla alignment in three aspects: \textbf{(1) stronger alignment}, lowering harmfulness score by 63.21\%; \textbf{(2) less over-refusal}, yielding a 58.44\% decrease in refusal rates for benign queries; and \textbf{(3) better utility}, retaining 99.58\% of the original model capabilities.

</details>


### [290] [How Do Agentic LLMs Decide to Call Tools? A Tool-Call Vector Shaped by Suppression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09624)
*Xijie Gong,Tingxu Han,Jiahao Zhang,Wei Song,Ziqi Ding,Hanqi Yan,Youcheng Sun,Lijie Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了大模型在代理任务中决定是否调用工具的机制，提出通过对比性提示对（仅改变动词）来揭示决策的关键因素。实验发现，执行类动词（如'write'）倾向于触发工具调用，而分析类动词（如'discuss'）则抑制该行为，其背后是由一个名为μ_Δ的紧凑向量状态所控制。该状态在多个模型家族中具有通用性，并可通过注意力头和MLP特征读出。研究还表明，提示中的结构设定了工具调用的先验，而动词类型通过信号影响这一先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解大模型在复杂代理提示下何时选择调用工具而非直接响应的内在机制，现有方法因提示冗长且高度纠缠，难以分离可控变量。

Method: 将复杂的代理提示转化为仅在请求动词上不同的最小对比对（如'write' vs 'discuss'），构建500个跨编程语言的配对提示；通过因果分析、注意力追踪与模型分解（Transcoder）识别关键内部状态μ_Δ。

Result: 发现μ_Δ是工具调用决策的因果必要且充分条件，可在多轮对话和无动词请求中泛化；分析动词通过抑制工具调用先验降低调用概率，执行动词则维持该先验。

Conclusion: 工具调用决策由一个可解释的内部状态μ_Δ驱动，该状态受动词类型调控，且在多个主流模型中具有一致性，为理解与干预代理行为提供了可操作的机制基础。

Abstract: Tool calling, invoking external tools on demand, is central to agentic LLMs, yet the mechanism that decides whether a model calls a tool or responds directly remains poorly understood. Agentic prompts are long and heavily scaffolded, combining role instructions, tool schemas, format templates, and the user's request across hundreds of tokens, creating a noisy, highly entangled context in which no single controllable variable for mechanistic analysis is obvious. To obtain such a variable, we propose a method that converts complex agentic prompts into minimal contrastive pairs in which a single request verb determines the tool-call decision: replacing an execution-verb (e.g., \textit{write}) with an analysis-verb (e.g., \textit{discuss}) reliably flips the decision, suggesting it is mediated by a compact internal state. We construct 500 such paired prompts across Python, Java, and C++ (300 for mechanistic analysis, 200 held out for evaluation). We trace the decision to a vector, $μ_Δ$, that is both causally necessary and sufficient and generalizes beyond the discovery prompts to native multi-turn $τ^2$-Bench trajectories and verb-free requests. Behavioral ablations show that the scaffold establishes a tool-call prior; Transcoder decomposition then reveals that analysis verbs suppress this prior through features signaling that tool use is unnecessary, whereas execution verbs largely leave it intact. Downstream scaffold-reading attention heads and MLP features read out the resulting state, and the same mechanism recurs across seven models from the Qwen, Mistral, and Granite families. Our code is available at https://github.com/XijieGo/MI4ToolCalling.

</details>


### [291] [Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09644)
*Alexis Beer,Liudmyla Klochko,Mathieu d'Aquin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化流程，用于构建机器学习在材料性质预测领域（特别是机器学习原子间势，MLIP）中的知识图谱。该流程包括从文献中提取信息、利用SHACL约束进行错误检测与修正，并以模型为单位迭代构建，确保表示一致性，从而支持新模型的持续加入。通过Matbench Discovery排行榜中的模型实例，展示了该知识图谱可查询的若干有趣特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前材料科学中对概念和实体的语义表示已有诸多研究，但针对快速发展的机器学习材料性质预测领域（尤其是MLIP）仍缺乏系统化、自动化的知识整合方法。现有方法难以保证数据一致性与可扩展性，亟需一种高效、可迭代的知识图谱构建机制。

Method: 采用基于大语言模型（LLM）的多步骤流程：首先从学术文档和论文中提取相关信息；其次引入SHACL约束进行验证与纠错；最后以模型为单位进行构建，确保每个模型的表示一致性，支持迭代更新。

Result: 成功构建了一个高质量的知识图谱，能够有效整合来自不同来源的MLIP模型信息，并支持对模型性能、结构、训练数据等多维度的查询分析。实证表明，该方法在保持一致性的同时具备良好的可扩展性。

Conclusion: 本研究提出的基于LLM与SHACL验证的自动化知识图谱构建流程，为快速演进的机器学习材料预测领域提供了一种可持续、一致且可查询的知识基础设施，有助于推动该领域的知识共享与智能发现。

Abstract: Complementing the many efforts in providing semantic representations of concepts, notions, and entities in materials science, we report and illustrate a process by which we can automatically build a knowledge graph of the fast evolving field of machine learning applied to the prediction of material properties, focusing on MLIP (Machine Learning Interatomic Potential). This LLM-based process relies on multiple steps, from information extraction in documents and articles to a validation loop using SHACL constraints to detect and correct errors. It is carried out on a model-by-model basis, focusing on the consistency of representation, therefore enabling an iterative construction where the addition of new models is facilitated. We illustrate the process by showing a few interesting aspects that can be queried from a knowledge graph built from the models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard.

</details>


### [292] [MeshSIPP: Efficient Lattice Planning in Dynamic Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09652)
*Marat Agranovskiy,Konstantin Yakovlev*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MeshSIPP 是一种高效的规划器，通过将运动原语作为空间包传播，利用轻量级的区间检查筛选，并推迟昂贵的精确出发时间搜索，从而解决动态环境中非完整运动约束下的路径规划问题。该方法通过时间感知剪枝规则提前丢弃冗余时空分支，保证了搜索的完备性和最优性。在超过6000个基准实例和实时ROS2仿真中，MeshSIPP相比现有最先进的时空规划器最高提速3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在动态环境中进行自主导航需要计算满足非完整运动约束的时空轨迹。现有的基于状态格子和安全间隔路径规划（SIPP）的方法虽然能生成可行路径，但因需要丰富的运动原语以实现平滑导航，导致分支因子过大，尤其在时间依赖障碍物情况下计算成本高昂。因此，亟需一种高效且保持理论保障的规划方法。

Method: MeshSIPP 通过将多个相似运动原语组合为空间包进行传播，使用轻量级的边界区间检查快速筛选无效路径，并将精确出发时间搜索延迟到原语到达终点时才执行。同时引入时间感知剪枝策略，提前剔除冗余的时空分支，确保搜索的完整性和最优性。

Result: 在超过6000个基准测试实例和实时ROS2仿真中，MeshSIPP实现了最高达3倍的性能提升，显著降低了计算开销，同时保持了路径规划的可行性、完整性与最优性。

Conclusion: MeshSIPP通过空间打包与分阶段验证机制有效缓解了传统SIPP方法在高分支因子下的计算瓶颈，是一种高效、可靠且理论完备的动态环境时空路径规划方案。

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments requires computing spatiotemporal trajectories that satisfy non-holonomic motion constraints. When the trajectories of the moving obstacles are predictable or known, a promising approach is to rely on the combination of state lattices constructed from precomputed feasible motion primitives and Safe Interval Path Planning -- a search-based algorithm with strong theoretical guarantees. While this approach yields feasible paths, the rich primitive sets needed for smooth navigation induce a large branching factor, which becomes costly when coupled with time-dependent obstacle intervals. To this end, we present MeshSIPP, an efficient planner that removes the computational bottleneck by exploiting the fact that many primitives sweep the same regions and can therefore be validated together. MeshSIPP propagates primitives as spatial bundles, screens them with lightweight bounding-interval checks, and defers the expensive exact departure-time search until a primitive reaches its terminal state. A time-aware pruning rule additionally discards redundant space-time branches early in the search. We prove that the resulting search is complete and optimal. Extensive experiments over more than 6,000 benchmark instances and real-time ROS~2 simulations show that MeshSIPP achieves up to a 3$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art spatiotemporal planners.

</details>


### [293] [Shared and structured inputs undermine collective random choice by reasoning AI agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09667)
*Takahiro Ezaki,Naoto Imura,Katsuhiro Nishinari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究揭示了在AI代理系统中基于标识符的随机选择行为存在可预测的偏差和相关性，即使在明确指令下仍难以完全消除。六种推理模型表现出对阈值和可分性规则的依赖，导致共享标识符时参与率可预测且存在偏倚。改变日期、格式和标识符标签验证了这些模式的稳健性。在人工审查请求的测试中，仅GPT-6 Sol接近目标随机率，其余模型表现不佳且高度依赖输入的随机数。研究强调应关注输入相关的偏差、相关性和可预测性，而不仅仅是选择率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 确保AI代理系统中随机选择的可靠性，尤其是在资源分配和审计场景中，以防止隐蔽的偏见和可预测行为影响系统公平性与透明度。

Method: 通过行为测试六种推理模型，分析其在不同标识符设置下的选择模式；通过改变日期、格式和标签检验结果稳定性；在实际任务中评估模型对随机抽样的执行能力，并对比其与外部提供的随机数的一致性。

Result: 多个模型在共享标识符下表现出可预测的参与模式，且存在输入依赖的关联性；尽管有独立随机化指令，仍无法完全消除相关性；只有GPT-6 Sol接近目标随机率，其他模型选择行为高度可预测并严重依赖输入随机数。

Conclusion: 当前的AI代理在随机选择任务中存在显著的输入依赖偏差、相关性和可预测性，这些特征会掩盖在选择率指标之外的风险，必须纳入未来代理系统的评估框架中。

Abstract: Random selection is widely used in resource allocation and auditing, making reliable implementation essential for AI-agent systems. Behavioural tests across six reasoning models uncovered threshold and divisibility rules used in identifier-based choices. For threshold-following GPT-6 Sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash, single-agent measurements prospectively predicted correlated participation under shared identifiers and biased participation under distinct identifiers with common timestamp bits. Changing dates, formats and identifier labels revealed when these predictions held. Explicit instructions to randomize independently reduced but did not eliminate shared-input correlation. To test implications for oversight, we asked four models to select customer requests randomly for human review. GPT-6 Sol approached the target rate while selecting predictably from identifiers; the others rarely selected requests. All four closely followed supplied random draws. These findings expose collective and audit vulnerabilities that selection rates alone miss, making input-dependent bias, correlation and predictability central targets for agent evaluation.

</details>


### [294] [Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving via Agent Orchestration in Program Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09681)
*Shuangjie Yao,Nikolaus Holzer,Mark Paul Santolucito,Baishakhi Ray,Suman Jana,Dongdong She*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CoCo-Prover introduces a cost-efficient approach to program verification by modeling proof solving as metalevel decision-making under cost, using two-level proof graphs and an agentic router to optimize goal selection and action purchase. It outperforms existing methods in both solve rate and cost efficiency across multiple benchmarks.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing theorem provers focus solely on pass rates without considering the cost of proof attempts, which is critical for large-scale software with many interdependent proof obligations. For LLM-generated code, correctness assurance is essential, but current methods are inefficient at scale.

Method: CoCo-Prover uses a two-level proof graph structure: an AND/OR hypergraph within each declaration and a lemma-dependency graph across declarations. It performs symbolic goal selection via topological traversal and uses an agentic router to orchestrate specialized agents with evolved routing rules based on accumulating evidence.

Result: On five Lean 4 benchmarks (CLEVER, VERINA, AlgoVeri, NTP4VC, Vero), CoCo-Prover achieves the highest solve rate on all benchmarks—up to 100% on two—and reduces computational cost by up to 30.9% compared to the strongest baseline.

Conclusion: CoCo-Prover effectively balances success and cost in program verification, making it a scalable solution for ensuring correctness in LLM-generated code and complex software systems.

Abstract: Program verification establishes software correctness through machine-checkable proofs constructed in theorem provers. It's a guarantee especially valuable for code generated by large language models (LLMs), which is fluent but carries no assurance of correctness. Almost all existing provers, however, pursue pass rates alone at whatever sampling or search budget it takes, and overlook the success-vs-cost frontier; yet real software often carries hundreds of interdependent proof obligations, so what matters at scale is not whether one theorem can be proved, but how many can be proved economically. We introduce CoCo-Prover, which formalizes cost-efficient program proving as metalevel decision-making under cost, grounded on two-level proof graphs: an AND/OR proof hypergraph within each declaration is joined to a lemma-dependency graph across declarations; and at each step, it answers two questions: which open goals to select, and which actions to purchase on these goals. Selection stays symbolic as a topological pass over the proof graphs. Action choice is agent orchestration via metalevel decision-making: an agentic router treats every bounded specialist invocation as a separately priced, best-effort computation, matching heterogeneous specialist agents together with configurations, under evolved routing rules as evidence accumulates. On five program verification benchmarks in Lean 4 including function-level CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri, and repository-level NTP4VC and Vero, we show that CoCo-Prover achieves a better success-vs-cost frontier than baselines including frontier coding agents and state-of-the-art LLM-based provers: it achieves the best solve rate on every benchmark and up to 100% on two benchmarks. It also reduces cost by up to 30.9% compared to the strongest baseline with the strongest LLM in our evaluation.

</details>


### [295] [System Switch: When Should a Fast Decision Model Stop and Think?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09683)
*Gian Luca Bailo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了在实时和回合制环境中，通过快速学习的决策模型与慢速推理型视觉-语言模型结合的双过程代理系统。实验基于Doom游戏环境和新的“System One”类型决策模型，使用llama.cpp接口进行部署。结果表明：(i) 在零样本情况下，0.15B至9B参数的决策模型在错误中选择收集物品的频率比随机高出1.6-1.8倍，且不受选项顺序影响；(ii) 准确率、校准性和敏感性（置信度区分正确/错误答案的能力）是独立指标，即使准确率相近，不同模型的AUROC差异显著，最敏感模型的置信度能反映其失败情境而非具体错误答案；(iii) 离线分析显示，将最低置信度30%的决策委派给推理模型，性能提升与原模型的AUROC呈正相关（相关系数0.87），在真实测试中分别获得+0.13和+0.08的收益，其中推理部分贡献约一半；(iv) 在闭环环境中（33场游戏，三组种子），所有变体均未能抵达终点，但采用计划承诺策略（如固定探索规则或推理器规划）可打开更多门，使原本静止的智能体开始行动，然而前者导致死亡增加。当被告知某些门需钥匙时，推理模型会误将普通门当作锁住的门，因状态无法区分，最终退回到收集行为。作者开源代码、提示、数据和日志。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计一种高效、可适应多种场景的双过程决策框架，解决传统方法中快速决策与深度推理之间的权衡问题，尤其在实时系统中如何合理触发慢速推理以提升整体表现。

Method: 构建一个由快速学习的演员（actor）与慢速推理型视觉-语言模型组成的双过程系统，在闭路Doom环境中运行。使用‘System One’类型的决策模型，并通过llama.cpp统一接口调用。通过控制门控机制决定何时将决策权移交至推理模型。评估方式包括零样本测试、离线性能分析及闭环实测。

Result: (i) 零样本下，0.15B至9B参数模型在错误中收集物品的概率高于随机水平1.6-1.8倍，且对选项顺序鲁棒；(ii) 准确率、校准性和敏感性三者独立，最敏感模型的置信度反映失败情境而非错误答案；(iii) 离线分析表明，按置信度最低30%进行委派，性能增益与演员的AUROC高度相关（相关系数0.87），闭环测试中分别获得+0.13和+0.08的收益，推理贡献约一半；(iv) 闭环中所有方法未成功通关，但引入计划承诺机制可提升探索能力，而推理模型在缺乏钥匙信息时会误判门的状态。

Conclusion: 该双过程架构在复杂环境中展现出良好的灵活性与可扩展性，证明了合理触发推理机制的重要性。虽然当前仍无法实现通关，但通过置信度引导的延迟决策显著提升了性能，为未来自主系统中的高效推理集成提供了新思路。

Abstract: Dual-process agents pair a fast policy with a slow deliberative model. In real-time settings the slow model usually runs continuously; in turn-based agents and robot planners it is invoked on events such as uncertainty or a detected failure. We study a fast learned actor that takes every decision and hands control to a reasoning vision-language model only when a gate opens, while the game keeps running. We use closed-loop Doom and the new open "System One" typed-decision models, served through a common llama.cpp interface. On 900 held-out questions, (i) zero-shot decision models from 0.15B to 9B parameters choose to collect items 1.6-1.8 times more often than chance among their errors, in any option order, although the order changes some models' accuracy; (ii) accuracy, calibration and sensitivity (how well confidence separates right from wrong answers) are distinct: models of similar accuracy differ widely in AUROC, and the confidence of the most sensitive one tracks which kinds of situation it fails, not which answers are wrong; (iii) offline, deferring the least confident 30% of decisions to a reasoning model gains over random deferral in proportion to the actor's AUROC (rank correlation 0.87); with actor and rate chosen on held-out games the gain is +0.13 [0.08, 0.18] with doomLaya's option order and +0.08 [0.02, 0.14] with shuffled options, and reasoning carries about half of it; (iv) in closed loop (33 games, three seeds) no variant reaches the exit. Committing to plans, the reasoner's or a fixed explore rule's, opens more doors and makes an actor that stands still play; with the rule the agent dies more often. Told that some doors need keys, the reasoner takes ordinary doors for locked ones, which the state cannot tell apart; without that knowledge it goes back to collecting. We release code, prompts, data and logs.

</details>


### [296] [A Tale of Two Error Categories: Exploring Concealed Trade-Offs in the Errors of Automated Judges in Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09693)
*Evgenia Ilia,Wilker Aziz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了在自然语言生成（NLG）任务中，不确定性量化（UQ）评估的可靠性问题。尽管自动化评判被广泛使用，但其错误会严重影响评估结果的可信度，且很少经过人工验证。通过实验发现，评判者的性能只能粗略预测其错误对评估的影响，且评判错误最严重地扭曲了信息丰富型UQ的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在广泛采用大语言模型（LLM）进行自然语言生成（NLG）应用的背景下，如何有效避免错误和幻觉成为关键挑战。不确定性量化（UQ）被视为一种潜在解决方案，通过低不确定性（高置信度）来代理正确性，使用户能够选择性采纳或拒绝响应。然而，在NLG中，由于存在多种合理回答，自动判断正确性极为困难，且自动化判断中的错误会显著降低评估协议的可靠性。

Method: 本研究进行了元分析，回顾现有文献中自动化评判的普遍性；并通过在问答任务中使用4个LLM、人类与自动化评判以及7种主流UQ方法进行实验，系统评估评判错误对UQ评估可靠性的影响，并分析信心与不同类别评判错误之间的相关性模式。

Result: 实验发现：1）评判者的表现仅能粗略预测其错误对UQ评估可靠性的影响；2）评判错误尤其倾向于扭曲信息量丰富的UQ的评估表现。这些现象与信心水平和评判错误类别的相关性模式密切相关。

Conclusion: 当前基于自动化评判的不确定性量化评估存在显著缺陷，尤其在面对信息丰富型UQ时更为明显。为提升评估可靠性，亟需引入人工验证机制，并改进评判标准与评估设计。

Abstract: The wide adoption of LLMs across broad NLG applications heightens the importance of providing users with the means to avert errors and hallucinations. Uncertainty quantification is poised to fill that gap; with low uncertainty (high confidence), as a proxy for correctness, allowing users to be selective (e.g., reject low-confidence, likely incorrect responses). Correlation between confidence and correctness then serves as a useful criterion for evaluation of uncertainty quantifiers (UQs). But in NLG, where diverse responses can be adequate to a prompt, obtaining reliable correctness judgements is not simple, especially without human intervention. Errors in automated judgement are hardly avoidable and known to diminish the reliability of evaluation protocols (Santilli et al., 2025; Ielanskyi et al., 2025). In a meta-analysis of published work, we show that automated judgement is the present norm. Besides, automated judgements are rarely validated against human ones, and the validation of the UQ evaluation they automate is even rarer. With experiments in question answering, using 4 LLMs, human and automated judgements and 7 popular UQs, we find that i) a judge's performance can only coarsely predict the observed impact of its errors on the reliability of UQ evaluation, and that ii) judgement errors tend to misrepresent informative UQs most. We link these observations to patterns of correlation between confidence and categories of judgement error.

</details>


### [297] [From Expert-Guided Proof Search to Automated Open-Problem Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09769)
*Adrián Zámečník,Matěj Kripner,Martin Koutecký,Martin Balko,Jan Grebík,Pavel Hubáček,Robert Šámal,Václav Rozhoň*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Bolzano is a multi-agent open-source system leveraging parallel prover agents and a verifier to advance mathematical research through efficient proof search and verification. It successfully solved ~200 open problems from 3,800 tested, including four from STOC 2026 papers confirmed by authors.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: To enhance mathematical research by automating proof search, enabling incremental improvements, and ensuring rigorous verification, reducing reliance on manual effort.

Method: Bolzano employs parallel prover agents working in concert with a verifier agent, maintaining a human-readable research state for transparency and collaboration.

Result: The system solved approximately 200 open problems from diverse sources, including four confirmed answers to questions in STOC 2026 papers, demonstrating effectiveness without problem-specific human guidance.

Conclusion: Bolzano demonstrates the viability of multi-agent systems in advancing mathematical research, offering a scalable, verifiable, and transparent approach to solving complex open problems.

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly contributing to mathematical research, where progress often depends on efficient proof search, incremental improvements and careful verification. We describe Bolzano, a multi-agent open-source system that uses parallel prover agents with a verifier agent and maintains a human-readable research state. Initial manual use on expert-selected problems yielded 8 results whose proofs were checked by domain experts. Motivated by these case studies, we ran Bolzano without problem-specific human guidance on about 3,800 open problems extracted from four sets of papers, solving about 200 open problems. One experiment used papers accepted to STOC 2026, a top conference in theoretical computer science. There, we answered four questions raised in the papers, as confirmed by their authors.

</details>


### [298] [SkillForge: Co-Evolving Skills and Agents via Dynamic Skill Lifecycles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09832)
*Yuyao Ge,Yiwei Wang,Yuchen He,Baolong Bi,Lingrui Mei,Jiayu Yao,Lizhe Chen,Shenghua Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillForge 是一种基于代理的强化学习方法，通过驱动技能生命周期（试用、活跃、稳定、退役）来编译和演化技能库，使技能与模型在训练过程中共同进化。该方法首先通过基础模型的回放预淘汰低质量技能，生成过滤后的技能库用于监督微调；随后在强化学习阶段持续进行选择性退役、稳定化和由大语言模型引导的突变，从而优化技能库与策略。在多个交互式智能体基准测试中，SkillForge 实现了最高的综合成功率，相比最强基线提升高达 7.8%，且保持技能库紧凑。此外，研究团队还发布了 SkillFurnace 数据集，包含超过 5000 条标注数据，涵盖退役筛选的 SFT 轨迹、演化后的技能库及人类标注的失败类别，以支持技能质量与生命周期管理的研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆增强型强化学习方法在处理长时序复杂任务时面临技能库冗余问题，即随着策略优化，过时或有害的技能会不断积累，干扰智能体决策。为解决此问题，需要一种机制实现技能库的动态演化与质量控制，确保技能始终有效且高效。

Method: 提出 SkillForge 方法，采用基于适应度的技能生命周期管理机制，包括试用、活跃、稳定和退役四个阶段。通过预强化学习评估阶段利用基础模型的回放轨迹预淘汰低质量技能，形成初始过滤库；随后进入监督微调阶段；在强化学习迭代中，执行选择性退役、稳定化和大语言模型引导的技能突变，实现技能库与策略的协同演化。

Result: 在多个交互式智能体基准上，SkillForge 实现最高综合成功率达到 7.8% 的相对提升，同时保持技能库规模紧凑。所提出的 SkillFurnace 数据集为技能质量评估与生命周期管理提供了高质量的标注资源。

Conclusion: SkillForge 通过构建动态演化的技能生命周期机制，有效解决了技能库退化问题，实现了技能与策略的协同优化，显著提升了智能体在复杂长时序任务中的表现，并为未来研究提供了可复用的数据基础。

Abstract: Memory-augmented reinforcement learning strengthens LLM agents' ability to solve complex long-horizon tasks. Skills are one such form of memory, pairing instructions with an applicability condition over task types. However, retaining every skill indiscriminately as the policy improves lets obsolete or harmful entries accumulate and mislead the agent. We propose SkillForge, an agentic RL method that compiles and evolves the skill library through a fitness-driven skill lifecycle of trial, active, stable, and retired states, so that the skills and the model co-evolve throughout training. A pre-RL evaluation phase first uses the base model's own rollouts to pre-retire low-fitness skills, yielding a filtered library that then seeds supervised fine-tuning. Reinforcement learning takes over from this checkpoint, and at each iteration selective retirement, stabilization, and LLM-guided mutation continue to forge the skill library alongside policy optimization. Across multiple interactive agent benchmarks, SkillForge achieves the highest aggregate success rate, delivering up to 7.8% relative improvement over the strongest baseline while keeping the skill library compact throughout training. We introduce SkillFurnace, a dataset of 5k+ annotated records bundling retirement-filtered SFT trajectories, evolved skill libraries with fitness annotations, and retirement events with human-annotated failure categories to support research on skill quality and lifecycle management.

</details>


### [299] [Self-Evolve With a Reference:Anchored Training of Tool-Integrated Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09856)
*Wenjie Liao,Liangjie Zhao,Zehong Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AnchorLoop引入一个冻结的前一迭代版本的执行器作为历史参考，以解决自演化工具集成代理中仅依赖当前执行器反馈的局限性。该方法在执行器端提供跨参考优势，在课程生成端提供基于一致性的参考，从而提升任务选择的有效性。在13个推理基准上，AnchorLoop相比Agent0在数学推理上提升2.5%，一般推理任务上提升2.8%，并保持更高的有效优势方差和持续改进能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自演化工具集成代理依赖当前执行器提供反馈，存在群体相对优势消失于完全共识、以及基于不确定性的课程奖励偏向分歧但无法判断任务是否支持进一步学习的问题。因此需要引入一个额外的历史参考以克服这些局限。

Method: 提出AnchorLoop框架，使用一个冻结的前一迭代执行器作为锚点，同时在执行器和课程生成器两端复用该锚点。执行器通过对比当前输出与历史多数答案获得交叉参考优势；课程生成器则利用采样多数一致性差异作为任务选择的依据。由于执行器与锚点参数相同，该比较仅作为任务选择的代理信号而非版本间改进证据。

Result: 在13个推理基准测试中，AnchorLoop在数学推理任务上比Agent0提升2.5%，在一般推理任务上提升2.8%。其有效优势方差更高，且在后期迭代中仍持续改进，而未使用锚点的基线模型收益逐渐下降。

Conclusion: 引入轻量级历史参考（即锚点）可显著提升自演化工具集成代理的性能与稳定性，无需外部任务或答案监督即可实现更有效的自我演进。

Abstract: Self-evolving tool-integrated agents learn from tasks and feedback generated within their own training loop. A Curriculum Agent generates tasks, while an Executor Agent learns from self-consistency signals through reinforcement learning. However, relying solely on the current Executor for feedback has two limitations: group-relative advantages vanish under full consensus, while uncertainty-based curriculum rewards favor disagreement without showing whether the generated tasks support further learning. These limitations motivate an additional reference beyond the current Executor. We propose \textit{AnchorLoop}, which introduces a frozen copy of the previous iteration's Executor as a historical reference and reuses it on both sides of the training loop. For the Executor, the anchor provides a cross-reference advantage that evaluates current outputs against both current and historical majority answers. For the Curriculum, it provides an agreement-based reference based on differences in sampled majority agreement. Since the Executor and anchor have identical parameters during Curriculum training, this comparison serves as a proxy for task selection rather than evidence of inter-version improvement or correctness. Across 13 reasoning benchmarks, AnchorLoop improves over Agent0 by 2.5\% on mathematical reasoning and 2.8\% on general reasoning tasks. It also maintains higher effective-advantage variance and continues improving in later iterations as the unanchored baseline shows diminishing gains. These results demonstrate the benefit of introducing a lightweight historical reference into self-evolving tool-integrated agents without external task or answer supervision.

</details>


### [300] [LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09872)
*Jun Zhao,Leiming Fu,Yanbo Wen,Yiding Wang,Xuantong Liu,Yang Shu,Yuyang Lu,Xuanran Xing,Jingqi Tong,Hao Xu,Qi Zhang,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LiveMACEBench 是一个基于实时金融市场的过程感知基准，用于评估持续运行的大型语言模型（LLM）代理在动态环境中的能力。通过跟踪决策轨迹，该研究揭示了结果与实际能力之间的显著差距，并识别出不同机制（如工具使用、持久记忆等）在性能中的具体瓶颈，证明机制访问、有效使用和下游表现不可互换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅通过结果评估智能体的能力会掩盖其背后的实际行为机制，尤其在动态环境中，结果受代理行为与外部变化的闭环交互影响，难以反映真实能力。需要一种能区分结果与机制使用的评估方法。

Method: 引入 LiveMACEBench 基准，利用实时金融市场作为自然演化的测试环境，让五个前沿 LLM 代理在统一配置下持续运行 30 天，收集完整的决策轨迹，并结合结果指标与机制特定诊断进行评估。

Result: 发现结果与能力之间存在明显差距：相似结果可能源于截然不同的机制使用模式；追踪诊断揭示了各能力维度的具体瓶颈，表明机制可用性、使用效率与最终表现并非等价。

Conclusion: LiveMACEBench 将实时市场从单纯的结果排名工具转变为可量化分析代理能力的诊断环境，推动对智能体能力的深层理解。

Abstract: Evaluating agents by outcomes alone can obscure the capabilities that produce them. This problem is especially pronounced in evolving environments, where outcomes reflect a closed-loop interaction between agent behavior and changing external conditions. We introduce LiveMACEBench, a process-aware benchmark that uses live financial markets as a naturally evolving testbed for persistent LLM agents. Five frontier LLMs operate along continuous trajectories under matched Tool Use, Persistent Memory, Rule Following, and Multi-Agent Collaboration configurations. We evaluate them through both realized outcomes and mechanism-specific diagnostics derived from complete decision traces. Across 30 days of live evaluation, we find a pronounced outcome-capability gap: realized returns often diverge from capability-specific measurements, and similar outcomes can arise from markedly different patterns of mechanism use. Trace-level diagnostics further expose distinct bottlenecks across capabilities, demonstrating that mechanism access, effective mechanism use, and downstream performance are not interchangeable measures of agent capability. LiveMACEBench makes this distinction measurable, turning live markets from a performance leaderboard into a diagnostic environment for agent capability

</details>


### [301] [Think Before You Paint: Recursive Latent Reasoning for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09876)
*Paweł Skierś,Małgorzata Grzanka,Wojciech Masarczyk,Jan-Willem van de Meent,Kamil Deja*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Painter-Thinker (PaTh) integrates recursive reasoning into pixel-space diffusion models without symbolic supervision, enabling strong performance on visual reasoning tasks like Sudoku and mazes. It uses a small Thinker network to refine latent states during denoising steps and steer a frozen diffusion model via ControlNet, achieving 92.5% accuracy on hard MNIST Sudoku puzzles (vs. 75% prior) and 71.2% on extreme ones (vs. 4.1%). With only 10M parameters, it outperforms larger models and generalizes well to spatial reasoning tasks.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Diffusion models excel at generating realistic images but struggle with visual reasoning tasks such as solving Sudoku or navigating mazes. Existing solutions rely on symbolic representations and recursive methods, but these are not directly applicable in pixel space where no explicit symbols exist. The goal is to transfer symbolic reasoning capabilities into pixel-level generation without requiring symbolic supervision.

Method: PaTh consists of two components: the Thinker, a small recursive network that reasons over learned tokens encoding noisy image and conditioning information; and the Painter, a frozen diffusion model guided by ControlNet adapters. The Thinker refines a latent state at each denoising step and steers the Painter. Training uses only reconstruction loss—no symbolic targets, solvers, or verifiers are needed.

Result: PaTh achieves 92.5% accuracy on hard MNIST Sudoku puzzles (previous best: 75%) and 71.2% on extreme puzzles (previous best: 4.1%). It also improves performance on mazes, Queens, and CLEVR scenes with spatial relations, with gains increasing as problem size grows. Diagnostic tests show PaTh can recover from injected errors that standard diffusion models cannot fix, especially when multiple cells are incorrect.

Conclusion: This work demonstrates that reasoning mechanisms developed for symbolic data can be successfully transferred to pixel space in diffusion models without symbolic supervision. By integrating recursive reasoning via a lightweight Thinker network, PaTh enables more reliable and accurate generation under complex constraints, paving the way for future AI systems capable of handling increasingly sophisticated visual reasoning tasks.

Abstract: Diffusion models generate realistic images but often fail on visual reasoning tasks, such as filling in a Sudoku or drawing the path through a maze. When a discrete symbolic representation is available, recursive methods such as the Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) solve even hard instances of these puzzles. We ask how such reasoning can be carried over to pixels, where no symbolic representation is available. We propose Painter-Thinker (PaTh): a small recursive network (the Thinker) reasons over a grid of learned tokens that encode the noisy image and the conditioning, refines a latent state within every denoising step, and steers a frozen diffusion model (the Painter) through ControlNet adapters. The Thinker is trained with the standard reconstruction loss alone, without symbolic targets, a solver, or a verifier. PaTh solves 92.5% of hard MNIST Sudoku puzzles (prior best 75%) and 71.2% of extreme ones (prior best 4.1%), with 10M parameters against 82M for a standard diffusion model. It also improves on mazes, Queens, and CLEVR scenes with specified spatial relations, and its advantage grows with problem size. Diagnostic experiments show that PaTh recovers from injected mistakes that the diffusion model cannot repair, especially when many cells are wrong. Together, these results show that reasoning mechanisms developed for symbolic data can be integrated into pixel-space diffusion without symbolic supervision, opening a path toward generating data under increasingly complex constraints.

</details>


### [302] [Outperformance Inverse Optimization: Learning Objective Functions that Outperform Agent Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09890)
*Akira Kitaoka*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种新的逆优化方法——出表现逆优化，旨在为混合整数线性规划（MILP）找到使观测行为被严格优于的最优解的权重。该方法通过仅依赖前向问题求解器的损失函数，结合基于梯度和DC优化的算法进行最小化，并在理论上证明了其泛化误差随观测数量增加而减小，且边界紧致。实验表明，该方法在合成与真实数据上均优于现有方法，在预测超越观测行为的解方面表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有逆优化方法在观测解非最优时会学习妥协权重，难以保证新状态下仍能产生更优解。本文旨在解决这一问题，通过设计一种新目标：寻找使每个状态下的最优解在所有分量上都优于观测行为的权重，从而提升预测性能和泛化能力。

Method: 提出基于前向问题求解器的损失函数，利用梯度下降和DC优化算法最小化该损失；对于唯一可诱导出表现最优解的权重，建立泛化误差的理论界，证明其与观测样本数成反比关系。

Result: 在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明，所提方法显著提升了对超越观测行为的最优解的预测能力，且其泛化误差随样本量增长而快速下降，理论边界紧致。

Conclusion: 出表现逆优化提供了一种有效、可扩展的逆优化框架，适用于MILP，能够生成在所有维度上优于观测行为的解，具有良好的理论保证和实证性能。

Abstract: Inverse optimization estimates the weights of an objective function that explain observed decisions as optimal solutions, and is used in a variety of fields. For mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs), existing methods aim to reproduce the observations as optimal solutions, and thus learn compromise weights when the observations are suboptimal. We propose outperformance inverse optimization, which instead seeks weights that induce, at each state, an optimal solution outperforming the observed action in every component. We give a loss function that can be evaluated with forward-problem oracles alone and is thus applicable to MILPs, together with gradient-based and DC optimization algorithms for minimizing it. For weights inducing a unique outperforming optimal solution at all observations, we prove that the probability of failing to induce such a solution at a new state (the generalization error) is bounded by a quantity inversely proportional to the number of observations, and that this bound is tight in the number of observations up to logarithmic factors. In experiments on synthetic and real data, the proposed methods improve the prediction of solutions outperforming the actions over existing methods.

</details>


### [303] [NL2Hull: A Natural Language-Driven Constrained Ship Design Decision Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09896)
*Wenhua Huo,Fenglei Han,Wangyuan Zhao,Jialin Wu,Jiayi Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出NL2Hull框架，将船体形状编辑建模为类型化的离散决策问题，通过语言指令驱动几何变形。利用NURBS表示水线，结合约束自由形式变形（CFFD）引擎进行局部编辑与重构，并在自建的船体设计决策数据集上评估模型性能。引入Chip模型实现高精度自然语言到船体设计的转换，达到95.90%的问题准确率和99.32%的FFD精确匹配率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统船体设计依赖经验与手动调整，难以高效响应自然语言描述的需求。现有方法缺乏对语言指令与几何控制之间的系统性连接，限制了智能化设计的发展。本文旨在建立一个可复现、可评估的语言驱动船体设计框架，提升设计效率与自动化水平。

Method: 构建基于非均匀有理B样条（NURBS）的水线表示，采用约束自由形式变形（CFFD）对控制点进行编辑；提出自然语言到船体设计的类型化决策模型Chip，结合大规模标注数据集进行训练与验证。

Result: Chip在SDDBench基准上实现95.90%的问题准确率、99.32%的FFD精确匹配率，负对数似然为0.0951，期望校准误差0.0032，布里尔分数0.0551，表现出优异的准确性与可靠性。

Conclusion: NL2Hull框架为语言驱动的船体设计提供了可复现的评估接口，明确了几何建模与连续控制环节的改进方向。该框架具备良好的扩展性与实用性，代码与数据已开源，推动智能船舶设计发展。

Abstract: Ship-form design combines smooth geometric representation, local shape editing, and constraints on the resulting hull. We present the Natural-Language-to-Hull Framework (NL2Hull Framework), which formulates ship-form editing as a typed discrete decision problem and connects language decisions to numerical geometry. Its Constrained Free-Form Deformation Engine (CFFD Engine) represents hull waterlines with non-uniform rational B-splines (NURBS), applies free-form deformation (FFD) to their control points, reconstructs the hull, and checks geometric constraints. We construct the Ship Design Decision Dataset (SDD Dataset) with 134,558 cleaned records and evaluate compared models on its subset Ship Design Decision Benchmark (SDDBench), containing 5,000 records and 43,496 typed questions. We propose Chip, a constrained ship-design decision model for processing natural-language requests. Chip reaches 95.90\% question accuracy and 99.32\% FFD exact match, with a negative log-likelihood of 0.0951, an expected calibration error of 0.0032, and a Brier score of 0.0551. The NL2Hull Framework provides a reproducible interface for evaluating language-based ship-form decisions while identifying the geometry and continuous-control components that require further development. Our code and dataset is available at https://github.com/wenhuahuo/NL2Hull.

</details>


### [304] [Where Can a Decision Model Diagnose HVAC Faults? Reasoning Demand, Physical Representation, and Robustness Under Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09937)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了决策模型（decision model）在暖通空调系统故障诊断中的应用，回答了三个关键问题：模型能做出哪些决策、需要何种输入数据，以及其概率在条件变化时是否可靠。通过在四个公开数据集的128个故障日上测试，发现基于物理特征输入时，决策模型Jev和大型开源模型能够诊断仅依赖单一特征证据的故障，但无法处理需运行上下文信息的复杂故障。在环境或配置变化下，决策模型保持了准确性和校准性，而监督模型则出现0.33的宏观F1分数下降。尽管模型输出的概率仍需校正，且检测能力较弱，但研究明确了决策模型的应用边界，并支持将物理计算由代码完成、故障候选由模型排序的分工模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI方法在建筑运维中面临诸多障碍：专家规则需为每种系统单独调优，监督模型依赖大量标注数据（建筑通常不记录），语言模型返回自由文本需人工核查（因置信度不可靠）。因此亟需一种无需训练、可适应多种决策任务的新模型。

Method: 使用决策模型Jev、开放语言模型与监督模型，在四组真实设备的128个故障日数据上进行九项测试，评估其在不同季节、控制配置和建筑场景下的表现。输入包括原始数据、物理特征及Brick拓扑结构，故障按推理复杂度分级。通过对比准确率、校准性与鲁棒性，分析模型适用范围。

Result: 基于物理特征输入时，决策模型和大语言模型可识别单特征驱动的故障，但难以处理依赖运行上下文的复杂故障；在条件变化下，决策模型保持稳定性能，而监督模型性能显著下降。所有模型的概率输出均需校正，检测能力有限。

Conclusion: 决策模型适用于特定类型的故障诊断，尤其在缺乏标注数据和动态环境变化下具有优势。建议采用‘代码负责物理计算，模型负责故障候选排序’的分工机制，以提升运维效率与可靠性。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence supports building operations in several forms, each with its own barrier. Expert rules must be tuned for every system, supervised models need labeled data that buildings rarely record, and language models return free text that requires human-in-the-loop checking, since their stated confidence is unreliable. A newer kind of pretrained model, here called a decision model, returns a probability for every allowed answer, so one model could serve many decisions without training. This study answers three open questions for fault diagnosis in heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems: which decisions such a model can make, what input it needs, and whether its probabilities hold when conditions change. On 128 fault days from four public datasets of real equipment, faults are graded by the reasoning their diagnosis demands, with data given raw, as physical features, or with Brick topology. The decision model Jev, open language models, and a supervised model face nine tests that change season, control configuration, or building. Given physical features, Jev and the larger open model diagnosed faults whose evidence one feature carries, but not faults that need operating context. Under shift they kept their accuracy and calibration, while the supervised model lost 0.33 macro-F1 yet led or tied within a building. Their probabilities still needed correction, and detection was weak. The study maps which faults a decision model can diagnose and from what input, and supports a division of work in which code computes the physics and the model ranks candidate faults for an operator.

</details>


### [305] [AgentTime: Can Agents Estimate and Control Their Own Runtime?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09944)
*Michael Ofengenden,Maksym Andriushchenko*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AgentTime基准，用于评估AI代理在指定时长内工作、预测运行时间和事后估算经过时间的能力。实验发现不同代理在时间控制上表现差异显著，部分代理虽完成任务但存在虚假结束行为，且预测普遍高估实际耗时。结果表明，任务完成不代表时间可控，长期自主运行需同时评估任务执行与时间控制能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究关注AI代理的时间感知，但缺乏对其在真实场景中按指定时长持续工作及自我时间控制能力的评估。为实现可靠、安全和自主的长期运行，亟需系统性测试代理对时间的掌控能力。

Method: 构建包含222个任务的AgentTime基准，涵盖编码、计算机操作、代理工作和自动化研究等多领域。通过三类实验：持续时长跟随（duration-following）、运行时间预测（forecasting）和事后时间估计（retrospective），评估代理在时间管理上的表现，并分析其误差来源与行为模式。

Result: Fable 5.1在时长指令下平均偏差达2.9倍，而GPT-6 Astra仅1.2倍；14例Astra任务中出现“虚假结束”行为；预测普遍高估实际耗时；移除时间信息后，Sol和Astra的误差翻倍，Fable几乎翻倍。说明任务完成不等于时间可控。

Conclusion: 当前AI代理虽能完成任务，但在长时间自主运行中仍缺乏有效的时间控制能力。未来需将时间管理作为核心评估维度，确保代理在复杂环境中可靠、安全地持续工作。

Abstract: An essential control of AI agents is their ability to manage runtime. This ability requires a sense of time-awareness, to predict and estimate wall-clock time and to control their own actions. Prior work has focused on time-awareness, but duration-following and control in native agent harnesses remain unexplored. We present AgentTime, a benchmark for testing whether agents can work for a requested duration, predict their runtime, and estimate elapsed time afterward. It comprises 222 tasks from 18 sources spanning coding, computer use, agentic work, and automated research. Duration-following experiments append a single instruction specifying how long to work, with requests ranging from about a minute to multiple days. Accuracy on these instructions varies substantially: Fable 5.1 in Claude Code deviates from requested runtimes by a typical factor of 2.9$\times$, compared with only 1.2$\times$ for GPT-6 Astra in Codex. However, matching the requested runtime does not, by itself, establish continued work on the task. Among 158 reviewed Astra runs with classifiable transcripts, 14 explicitly slept after appearing to finish. In forecasting experiments, predictions tend to overestimate natural runtimes. In retrospective experiments, removing temporal information more than doubles deviation for Sol and Astra and nearly doubles it for Fable. An agent's ability to complete a task does not guarantee that it can control its own time or work for the whole requested duration. For agents to run reliably, safely, and autonomously over long horizons, we require the evaluation of both.

</details>


### [306] [Successive Training Stages and Large Language Model Persuasion: Effects of Misalignment, Supervised Fine-Tuning, and Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09964)
*Antony Dalmiere,Pascal Marchand,Guillaume Auriol,Vincent Nicomette*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了大语言模型（LLM）在三个连续训练阶段中的表现：(1) 通过阴谋论数据的监督微调（SFT）导致错位，(2) 额外进行论证数据的说服性SFT，以及(3) 身份偏好优化（IPO）。835名参与者被随机分配到五个组别（中立文本、阴谋论训练模型、说服性训练模型、偏好优化模型和GPT-4），并接触针对10个有争议政治议题的个性化文本。通过比较暴露前后的态度变化（使用连续李克特量表），采用协方差分析（ANCOVA）评估影响。结果显示，训练效果依赖于参与者初始态度，说服性SFT比仅阴谋论训练更能引起态度改变（d = 0.30），而IPO未带来额外增益（d = 0.03），GPT-4与中立文本无显著差异（d = -0.01）。结论表明，针对说服性数据的定向监督训练可提升LLM的说服力，而偏好优化在此基础上无显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 明确大语言模型在不同后训练阶段对人类态度影响的贡献，尤其关注说服性训练与偏好优化的效果差异，以揭示其在意识形态传播中的潜力与局限。

Method: 实验设计包括五组条件（中立文本、阴谋论训练模型、说服性训练模型、偏好优化模型、GPT-4），835名参与者通过Prolific招募，随机分配至各组。所有模型生成内容基于个体用户画像个性化。态度变化通过前后对比的李克特量表测量，并使用协方差分析（ANCOVA）检验条件与基线态度的交互作用。

Result: 存在显著的条件与基线态度交互效应（F(4, 825) = 5.33, p < .001），表明训练效果因初始态度而异。说服性SFT相比单纯阴谋论训练显著提升了态度改变（d = 0.30），但IPO未提供额外增益（d = 0.03），GPT-4与中立文本无显著差异（d = -0.01）。

Conclusion: 针对说服性数据的定向监督训练能有效增强大语言模型的说服力，而身份偏好优化未能进一步提升效果；相比之下，GPT-4在本研究中未表现出超越中立文本的影响力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can be tuned to influence human attitudes, yet the respective contributions of successive post-training stages remain un-clear. This study examines how three successive training stages affect LLM persuasiveness: (1) misalignment through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on conspiracy data, (2) additional persuasive SFT on argumentative data, and (3) Identity Preference Optimization (IPO), a preference-optimization method. A total of 835 participants recruited on Prolific were randomly assigned to five between-subject conditions (neutral text, conspiracy-trained model, persuasion-trained model, preference-optimized model, and GPT-4) and were exposed to texts on 10 divisive political issues, personalized from their individual profiles in all model conditions. Attitude change was measured as the difference between pre- and post-exposure positions on continuous Likert scales and analyzed with an analysis of covariance (ANCOVA). A significant condition x baseline-attitude interaction, F (4, 825) = 5.33, p < .001, indicated that training effects depended on participants' initial attitudes. Persuasive SFT produced greater attitude change than conspiracy training alone, d = 0.30, whereas IPO provided no additional benefit, d = 0.03, and GPT-4 did not differ from neutral text, d = --0.01. These results show that targeted supervised training on persuasive data increases LLM persuasiveness, whereas preference optimization yields no significant gains beyond it.

</details>


### [307] [From Expected Harmfulness to Likelihood: A Probabilistic Reformulation of Jailbreaking LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09973)
*Juanyang Xu,Zheng Wang,Xingyu Zhao,Siddartha Khastgir,Andi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种名为OPUR的新方法，通过建立期望有害性与目标输出似然优化之间的概率联系，实现对大语言模型（LLM）代理的高效越狱攻击。该方法利用采样分布生成高度有害的目标输出，并基于这些样本指导输入优化，从而在实验中有效提升越狱效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当大语言模型（LLM）代理输出的有害性可量化时，越狱的目标自然应是最大化经过允许的输入修改下的期望有害性。此外，另一种策略是构造或选择有害目标输出，并通过修改输入来提高其出现概率。然而，这两种方法缺乏统一的理论基础，因此需要建立连接以提升攻击效率和可解释性。

Method: 论文通过概率重写的方式，证明了输入的期望有害性对输入的梯度等于在有害性加权输出分布下模型对数似然的输入梯度期望。这一关键身份为两种越狱策略提供了统一的解释框架。在此基础上，提出一种新的采样分布OPUR，用于生成高度有害的目标输出，并用这些样本引导基于似然的输入优化过程。

Result: 实验表明，所提出的OPUR方法在多个基准测试中显著提升了越狱攻击的成功率，验证了其有效性与通用性。该方法不仅在性能上优于现有技术，还提供了更清晰的攻击机制理解。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了期望有害性最大化与目标输出似然优化之间的深层联系，提出了一种高效的越狱框架OPUR，为评估和增强大语言模型的安全性提供了新工具。

Abstract: When the harmfulness of an LLM agent's output can be quantified, a natural jailbreaking objective is to maximize expected harmfulness over admissible input modifications. An alternative approach constructs or selects harmful target outputs and modifies the input to increase their likelihood. We establish a precise connection between these two approaches through a probabilistic reformulation. Specifically, we show that the gradient of the logarithm of expected harmfulness with respect to the input equals the expected input gradient of the model's log-likelihood under a harmfulness reweighted output distribution. This identity provides a unified interpretation of expected harmfulness and target likelihood optimization. Building on this connection, we propose OPUR, a sampling distribution designed to generate highly harmful target outputs and use the resulting samples to guide likelihood-based input optimization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the resulting method in jailbreaking LLM agents.

</details>


### [308] [SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10088)
*Serin Kim,Kwangwook Seo,Dokyung Song,Jinyoung Yeo,Dongha Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillSandbox是一个动态合成任务和环境的框架，用于验证技能在新任务中的可重用性。通过提议、构建和验证三个阶段，评估技能的可执行性、效用和效率，决定是否将其保留在技能库中。在ALFWorld和WebShop上测试显示，该框架显著提升下游性能和执行效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能可能包含错误的程序或非可迁移的知识，因此需要验证其在新任务中的可重用性，但传统任务难以暴露技能的实际应用情境。

Method: 提出SkillSandbox框架，包括Proposer（指定保留条件与变化细节）、Builder（构建可执行场景）和Verifier（对比有无技能的执行效果，评估可执行性、效用与效率）。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，使用三个模型进行实验，SkillSandbox consistently带来最强的下游性能和更高的执行效率；分析表明其性能提升源于对技能可重用性的准确评估。

Conclusion: SkillSandbox能够有效验证技能的可重用性，显著提升智能体的任务解决能力与执行效率，是构建可靠技能库的关键工具。

Abstract: Self-evolving agents distill task-solving experience into skills for future reuse, but these skills can encode incorrect procedures or non-transferable knowledge. It is therefore critical to verify each skill's reusability: whether its guidance remains useful beyond the experience from which it was distilled. Such verification requires observing how a skill affects execution in new tasks, yet existing tasks may not expose the situations where the target skill can actually be exercised. To construct such situations, we propose SkillSandbox, a framework that dynamically synthesizes a task and its environment for each skill that are skill-relevant yet novel. A Proposer specifies the conditions to preserve and the source-specific details to vary, a Builder constructs an executable scenario, and a Verifier compares executions with and without the skill. The Verifier assesses executability, utility, and efficiency to assign a Keep or Reject verdict, determining whether the skill enters the library. Across ALFWorld and WebShop with three models, SkillSandbox consistently yields the strongest downstream performance and improved execution efficiency. Further analyses examine whether these gains reflect accurate assessment of skill reusability and identify which components of SkillSandbox contribute to them.

</details>


### [309] [What the Sleeve Feels: Explainable Machine Learning for Textile Pressure-Based Postural Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10015)
*Limon Bin Hossain,Md Sadib Rahman Ananta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究提出一种基于针织压阻袖套的可穿戴姿态筛查系统，通过手工程设计的29个可解释压力分布特征（涵盖全局强度、压力中心、象限不对称性、分布复杂度及短时序变化等），在严格按受试者划分的数据集上实现对日常活动的三类粗粒度分类（中性、潜在不良、功能或过渡性）。采用调优后的XGBoost分类器，在未见受试者上达到0.818准确率、0.788平衡准确率和0.801宏F1，且置信区间窄（±0.01）、跨受试者标准差低（约0.06）。尽管原始帧输入的2D-CNN基线表现相近，表明手工特征仍具竞争力。结合SHAP解释、特征组消融、错误分析、类别映射敏感性及模拟穿脱旋转测试，系统全面揭示了模型依赖因素、性能下降位置与原因，有效解决泛化、可解释性与鲁棒性三大部署瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有压力传感智能纺织品虽具低成本潜力，但实际部署受限于泛化能力弱、决策不可解释、对穿戴偏移敏感等问题。为实现可落地的可穿戴姿态筛查，需同时满足对未见受试者的泛化能力、决策过程的物理可解释性以及对穿戴微小偏移的鲁棒性。

Method: 采用针织压阻袖套作为测试平台，将细粒度动作聚类为三类粗粒度筛查类别；人工设计29个可解释的压力分布特征，覆盖空间分布与时间动态特性；使用主题间交叉验证评估性能；通过XGBoost分类器建模，并对比2D-CNN基线；利用SHAP、特征组消融、误差分析、类别映射敏感性与模拟穿脱旋转测试进行综合解释与鲁棒性验证。

Result: XGBoost模型在未见受试者上取得0.818准确率、0.788平衡准确率、0.801宏F1，置信区间紧（±0.01），跨受试者标准差约0.06；2D-CNN基线表现相近，表明手工特征在该任务中不逊于深度学习的空间表示；多维度解释分析明确揭示模型依赖因素、失效场景与原因，验证了系统在泛化、可解释性与鲁棒性上的优势。

Conclusion: 本研究构建的基于可解释特征与严谨验证的压感智能纺织系统，成功应对了部署中的关键挑战，具备向真实场景应用转化的潜力，为可穿戴姿态筛查提供了可靠、透明、稳健的技术路径。

Abstract: Pressure-sensing smart textiles convert body-surface contact into a dense, image-like signal closely tied to posture and movement, making them a promising low-cost route to wearable posture screening. Realizing that promise, however, requires more than classification accuracy: a deployable system must generalize to wearers unseen during training, expose the physical evidence behind its decisions, and tolerate the small donning offsets that occur whenever a garment is removed and re-worn. This paper addresses these three requirements jointly using a knitted piezoresistive sleeve worn on the forearm as a testbed. We regroup fine-grained everyday activities into three coarser screening categories (neutral, potentially undesirable, and functional or transitional), engineer 29 interpretable pressure-distribution features spanning global intensity, spatial center of pressure, quadrant asymmetry, distribution complexity, and short-horizon temporal change, and evaluate under a strict subject-wise split. A tuned XGBoost classifier reaches 0.818 accuracy, 0.788 balanced accuracy, and 0.801 macro F1 on unseen test subjects, with tight frame-level bootstrap 95% intervals of about plus-minus 0.01 and a subject-to-subject standard deviation near 0.06 under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation. A simple 2D-CNN baseline trained on raw frames achieves broadly similar performance, showing that hand-engineered features are not left behind by a learned spatial representation on this task. SHAP-based explanation, a feature-group ablation, per-activity error analysis inside the pooled undesirable class, class-mapping sensitivity, and a simulated donning-rotation stress test together locate what the model relies on, where it degrades, and why, directly targeting the generalization, interpretability, and robustness gaps that determine whether such a system is deployable.

</details>


### [310] [Learning to Accumulate Knowledge with Mutual Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10042)
*Yuyang Zhao,Lizi Liao,Leyang Shen,Xiaoyan Zhao,Yang Zhang,Fuli Feng,Xiangnan He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Knowledge Weaver 是一种强化学习框架，旨在训练语言模型从智能体轨迹中提炼可重用的知识。通过结合基于词元级互信息（MI）的反馈与边际成功奖励，该框架有效避免知识冗余，促进独特且对任务有益的知识积累。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 任务中，其表现显著优于 GRPO 及其他基线方法，尤其在知识库规模固定时展现出更强的泛化能力与实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在构建知识库时难以避免重复知识的积累，而仅依赖任务成功奖励会强化冗余信息。因此需要一种机制来确保新知识既独特又有实际价值，从而提升知识库长期有效性。

Method: 提出 Knowledge Weaver 框架，融合 token-wise 互信息（MI）反馈与边际成功奖励，以指导语言模型作为“知识编纂者”筛选并存储高质量、非冗余的经验知识。该方法通过双重信号激励知识多样性与任务增益性。

Result: 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上，使用 k=10 的检索条目时，平均成功率分别达到 54.0% 和 42.0%，比 GRPO 提升 16.9 和 18.7 个百分点；同时优于提示工程、人工编写等知识库，在执行器冻结条件下仍具优势。

Conclusion: Knowledge Weaver 成功实现了高效、去冗余的知识积累，为大语言模型智能体的持续学习提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can improve their performance by reusing knowledge distilled from past interactions. However, curating new experiences into a knowledge bank that becomes more useful as it grows remains challenging. Effective knowledge accumulation should limit redundant overlap among entries and ensure that new knowledge contributes beyond what the bank already provides. Yet training a curator with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on standalone task success can reinforce general guidance even when it duplicates existing knowledge. Therefore, we propose Knowledge Weaver, a reinforcement learning framework that trains a language model to curate reusable knowledge from agent trajectories. We couple feedback inspired by token-wise mutual information (MI) with marginal success rewards to guide knowledge accumulation. Together, these signals encourage the curator to preserve distinct information from experience and produce entries that improve task success when added to existing knowledge. Standalone success rewards also favor entries that are useful on their own. On ALFWorld and WebShop, Knowledge Weaver achieves mean success rates of 54.0\% and 42.0\% with k=10 retrieved entries, exceeding GRPO by 16.9 and 18.7 percentage points, respectively. Its knowledge banks also outperform the evaluated prompt-based and established banks, including human-written banks, in overall ALFWorld success rate and WebShop score with the executor frozen. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/LaoKuiZe/Knowledge-Weaver.

</details>


### [311] [GAGR-Lab: Evaluating Joint Spatial-Geometric and Analytic Function Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10201)
*Jingyao Zhang,Yun Li,Lu Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GAGR-Lab 是一个用于评估联合空间-几何与解析函数推理能力的框架，通过笛卡尔游戏场景、显式函数语义和权威的 Rust 轨迹执行实现。该框架区分了空间感知、度量定位、几何关系、函数解释、函数构建和约束合成等环节，并提供四种可配置场景难度预设及24单元诊断设计。初步实验使用 Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct 模型进行测试，共完成72场平衡游戏，432次尝试，429次有效响应，但未命中目标；结构化定位接口也未产生可评分输出。而特权分析搜索控制在300个生成场景中成功处理600个方向性案例，具备完全可重复性，并通过1200次垂直反射或平移验证。框架分离了服务可靠性、符号合规性和几何成功率，保留精确模型可见输入与实际轨迹。采用分阶段协议进行诊断校准、持留复制、多模型比较和配对鲁棒性测试。贡献在于提出一个可操作的研究框架，包含已执行的试点和明确的未来研究计划，完整难度矩阵与模型对比结果尚未测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以全面评估模型在空间-几何与函数推理方面的综合能力，尤其缺乏对符号表达、几何约束满足与轨迹执行一致性的系统测量机制。因此需要一个能精确分离各推理环节、支持可控实验与可复现验证的框架。

Method: 提出 GAGR-Lab 框架，结合笛卡尔游戏场景、显式函数语义定义、基于 Rust 的权威轨迹执行引擎，通过四类可配置场景难度预设与24单元诊断设计，实现对空间感知、度量定位、几何关系、函数解释、函数构建与约束合成的分步评估。采用分阶段协议进行诊断校准、持留复制、多模型比较和配对鲁棒性测试。

Result: 试点实验表明，主流模型（如 Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct）在未受控提示下无法达成目标，探索性提示亦失败；结构化接口无有效输出。但特权分析搜索控制在600个方向案例中实现100%成功且可重复，1200次几何检查全部通过。框架成功分离服务可靠性、符号合规性与几何成功性，并保持输入与路径的精确可追溯性。

Conclusion: GAGR-Lab 构建了一个可操作、可扩展、可复现的研究框架，能够系统评估复杂空间-几何-函数推理能力。尽管当前仅完成部分测试，但其设计清晰地指明了未来研究路径，为后续多模型对比与全矩阵评估奠定基础。

Abstract: Joint spatial-geometric and analytic function reasoning requires translating a perceived spatial configuration into a symbolic function whose executed curve satisfies geometric constraints. We present GAGR-Lab, a framework for measuring this capability through Cartesian game scenes, explicit function semantics, and authoritative Rust trajectory execution. It distinguishes spatial perception, metric grounding, geometric relations, function interpretation, function construction, and constrained synthesis. We specify four configurable scene-difficulty presets and a prospective 24-cell diagnostic design, while reporting only the subset actually evaluated. A bounded pilot of one hosted model (Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct) using two API credentials as execution replicas yields 72 balanced games with 432 attempts, 429 valid provider responses, and no target hits; exploratory ordinary-function prompt variants also fail to hit, while the structured localization interface yields no scoreable outputs. A privileged analytic search control independently succeeds on 600 directional cases from 300 generated scenes, with exact repeatability and 1,200 successful vertical-reflection or translation checks. The framework separates serving reliability, symbolic compliance, and geometric success, and preserves exact model-visible inputs and realized paths. A staged protocol outlines diagnostic calibration, held-out replication, multi-model comparison, and paired robustness tests. The contribution is an operational research framework with an executed pilot and a clearly identified prospective study plan; the full difficulty matrix and comparative model results remain untested.

</details>


### [312] [Loud Failures, Quiet Failures: Fault Detection and Recovery in Tool-Using Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10062)
*Obada Kraishan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过在现有函数调用基准测试的可执行环境中引入故障注入层，系统性地评估了多轮工具使用代理在面对不同类型故障时的表现。研究发现，当工具返回显式错误时，代理在91.3%的情况下能识别问题；但当返回看似合理却错误的结果时，仅58.8%能察觉，远低于正常情况下的26.8%误报率。尽管推理模型在某些方面表现更差（如更少察觉、更多改变计划），但恢复能力并未提升。此外，由于代理的随机性，即使无故障运行，任务状态也仅有63.3%一致；而实际故障中，只有工具缺失显著降低恢复率，其他如超时、模式漂移和数据损坏的影响仍在正常波动范围内。代理倾向于重复使用同一工具，甚至连续三次以上，但完全相同的重复较少。简单提示要求检查结果也无法改善检测能力，表明代理更依赖错误信号而非内容本身，导致格式正确但内容错误的故障容易被忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前工具使用代理的评估主要关注任务完成与否，但实际部署中存在服务超时、接口失效、参数变更、返回值格式正确但内容错误等复杂故障。已有研究表明语言模型对工具输出存在过度信任，尤其在无声失败情况下。本文旨在深入探究这种过度信任如何影响多轮代理在不同故障阶段的感知、规划调整与恢复行为。

Method: 在成熟函数调用基准测试的执行环境上构建故障注入层，可控地在轨迹中某点注入四类典型故障（显式错误、虚假正确输出、超时、模式漂移/数据污染）。选取六种来自三个模型家族的模型（含一半推理变体）进行1,920次实验，覆盖24个复杂多步任务。记录代理是否察觉故障、是否改变计划、能否恢复任务或重复操作。分析不同故障类型下各指标表现，并对比推理模型与非推理模型差异。同时评估运行间一致性与提示干预效果。

Result: 1. 显式错误：91.3%的故障被识别；2. 虚假正确输出：仅58.8%被察觉，显著低于正常误报率（26.8%）；3. 推理模型虽在计划变更上更积极（+10.4点），但识别能力下降（-9.3点，p < .001），恢复能力无显著差异（p = .512）；4. 无故障运行中任务状态一致性为63.3%，而实际故障中仅工具缺失显著降低恢复率（39.9%），其余故障影响未超出运行波动范围；5. 故障后代理会连续三次以上重复使用同一工具达22.2%的试验；6. 提示要求检查结果未能提升检测率。

Conclusion: 代理对格式正确但内容错误的故障具有高度脆弱性，其判断机制依赖于错误信号而非输出内容本身。当前评估范式低估了部署中的真实风险。未来需设计更鲁棒的验证机制，避免对工具输出的盲目信任，并重视运行过程的可重复性与状态一致性。

Abstract: Tool-using agents are usually scored on whether they finish a task while the tools work. Deployments are less forgiving: services time out, endpoints disappear, parameter names change, and results come back well formed but wrong. Prior work has shown that language models over-trust tool outputs that fail silently; we ask how that over-trust plays out across the stages of failure handling in multi-turn agents. Wrapping the executable environments of an established function-calling benchmark in a fault-injection layer, we inject one of four typed faults at a controlled point in the trajectory and record whether the agent notices, changes plan, recovers the task, or repeats itself. Six models from three families, half of them reasoning variants, ran 1,920 trials over 24 multi-step tasks. Agents treat a failure as a problem in 91.3% of trials when the tool returns an explicit error, but in 58.8% of trials when it returns a plausible wrong value, against a 26.8% rate of reporting problems when nothing was wrong. Reasoning models are not better placed: paired against instruct siblings, they notice less (-9.3 points, p < .001) and change plan more (+10.4 points, p < .001), and recovery is unchanged (p = .512). Because agents are stochastic, two fault-free runs of the same task end in the same state only 63.3% of the time; against that baseline, only a missing tool clearly lowers recovery (39.9%), while timeouts, schema drift, and corruption stay within run-to-run variation. After a fault, agents return to the same tool three or more times in a row in up to 22.2% of trials, though strictly identical repeats are rare. A prompt line asking the agent to check each result did not move detection. Agents respond to the error channel rather than to the content of what a tool returns, so failures that stay inside the expected format pass through.

</details>


### [313] [HGP:An on-device personalized agent memory via hybrid graph storage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10071)
*Ran Zhou,Xueming Han,Jiaheng Liu,Yuyao Zhang,Fanyu Meng,Junlan Feng,Yuxiang Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HGP，一种混合图记忆框架，用于解决基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在个性化交互任务中因异构、多类型且隐式约束的长期行为痕迹带来的挑战。传统记忆机制在准确路由与检索方面表现不佳，尤其在本地设备上难以实现个性化。HGP通过轻量级自增强分类器实现个性化记忆路由，并构建情景、语义和程序性记忆为图结构，同时提取工作记忆作为状态轨迹以捕捉当前状态与隐式约束，确保可靠决策。该方法减少对大型模型的调用，支持本地部署，图存储方式提升检索准确性并支持用户画像的增量优化。在两个基准测试中，HGP在PAL-Set解决方案选择任务上达到S-score 35.58，较最强基线提升近7分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆机制在处理异构、多类型且隐式约束的长期用户行为痕迹时存在路由与检索不准确的问题，尤其在本地设备上难以实现个性化，且多数方法使用单一向量表示，模糊了类型差异与关系结构。

Method: 提出HGP框架，包含轻量级自增强分类器用于个性化记忆路由，构建情景、语义和程序性记忆为图结构，并提取工作记忆作为状态轨迹以捕捉当前状态与隐式约束。

Result: 在两个基准测试中，HGP在PAL-Set解决方案选择任务上达到S-score 35.58，比最强基线高出近7分，验证了其在准确检索与个性化推理上的优越性。

Conclusion: HGP通过图结构记忆与轻量级分类器设计，在保证高精度记忆路由与检索的同时，支持本地部署与用户画像的持续优化，适用于复杂个性化交互场景。

Abstract: LLM-based agents face challenges in personalized interactive tasks due to heterogeneous, multi-typed, and implicitly constrained long-term traces. Existing memory mechanisms struggle with accurate routing and retrieval, especially on-device where personalization is critical. Most methods use single-vector representations, blurring type distinctions and relational structure. We propose HGP, a hybrid graph memory framework. HGP employs a lightweight self-enhancement classifier for personalized memory routing and constructs episodic, semantic, and procedural memories as graphs. It also extracts working memory as a state trajectory to capture current state and implicit constraints, ensuring reliable decision-making. The classifier reduces large-model calls, enabling on-device deployment, while graph storage enables accurate retrieval and incremental user profile refinement. Experiments on two benchmarks show that on PAL-Set solution selection, HGP achieves an S-score of 35.58, nearly 7 points above the strongest baseline. Code and data are at https://github.com/Ouan6/HGP-.git.

</details>


### [314] [RewardWeaver: Long-Horizon Interactive Learning for Language Agents via Self-Evolving Reward Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10120)
*Hengbo Xiao,Boyao Zhang,Purui Liu,Yuxuan Zheng,Haoran Yin,Haibo Liu,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RewardWeaver 是一种自演化奖励适应框架，用于语言智能体在长时交互中的强化学习。它通过维护一个语义固定的已验证能力空间，结合策略优化、任务评估、失败归因与奖励动态调整的闭环机制，在每次训练阶段后对低绩效轨迹进行基于结果的反向归因，聚合重复且受策略控制的能力瓶颈，并动态选择下一阶段的过程奖励。对于现有能力空间无法覆盖的重复失败，则触发受控扩展过程。在 SOTOPIA、Amazon?HistoryPrice 和新构建的 Sales Benchmark 上，RewardWeaver 均取得了新的 SOTA 结果，证明了动态奖励分配、基于失败的归因和稳定语义的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时交互中的强化学习面临稀疏终端反馈和信用分配困难的问题。尽管过程奖励可提供更密集的监督，但当前最关键的瓶颈能力可能随策略演化而变化，静态奖励设计难以适应这种动态需求。因此需要一种能自动识别并适应关键能力瓶颈的自演化奖励机制。

Method: RewardWeaver 构建了一个语义固定的已验证能力空间，通过在每轮训练后对低绩效轨迹进行基于结果的反向归因，识别出反复出现且由策略控制的能力瓶颈；然后动态选择对应的过程奖励以指导下一阶段训练；当出现未被覆盖的重复失败时，启动受控扩展流程以更新能力空间。

Result: 在 SOTOPIA、Amazon?HistoryPrice 以及新构建的 Sales Benchmark 上，RewardWeaver 均实现了新的 SOTA 性能，尤其在社交互动、双边谈判和领域特定销售任务中表现突出。消融实验验证了动态奖励分配、失败归因和能力语义稳定性对性能提升的关键作用。

Conclusion: RewardWeaver 通过构建闭环的自演化奖励机制，有效应对了长时交互中动态能力瓶颈识别与奖励适应的挑战，显著提升了语言智能体在复杂任务中的表现，为未来自主智能体的设计提供了新范式。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has driven substantial progress in domains where task outcomes can be reliably evaluated, but long-horizon interaction remains challenging due to sparse terminal feedback and difficult credit assignment. Process rewards provide denser supervision, yet the capabilities most relevant for training can change as the policy evolves: a behavior that is easy to evaluate or frequently deficient need not be the bottleneck currently limiting task success. We introduce RewardWeaver, a self-evolving reward adaptation framework for language agents in long-horizon interaction. RewardWeaver maintains a validated capability space in which the semantics of admitted Rubrics remain fixed, and closes the loop between policy optimization, task evaluation, failure attribution, and reward adaptation. After each training stage, it performs outcome-grounded backward attribution on low-outcome trajectories, aggregates recurrent and policy-controlled capability bottlenecks, and dynamically selects the corresponding process rewards for the next stage. Recurrent failures not covered by the existing capability space trigger a separate, controlled expansion procedure. We evaluate REWARDWEAVER on SOTOPIA, Amazon?HistoryPrice, and a newly constructed Sales Benchmark. Across social interaction, bilateral bargaining, and domain-specific sales, REWARDWEAVER establishes new state-of-the-art (SOTA) results. Ablations further demonstrate the importance of dynamic reward allocation, failure-grounded attribution, and stable semantics for admitted capabilities.

</details>


### [315] [UniSkill: Learning Actor-Aligned Skill Proposals for an Evolving Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10164)
*Yifei Lu,Cheng Liu,Dianzhi Yu,Hui Xiang,Ji Zhang,Yuanchu Xiao,Rong Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: UniSkill提出一种共享策略框架，通过对比动作反馈引导技能提议学习，避免额外的演员滚动，实现任务执行与技能提取的协同进化。该方法通过衡量替换检索技能后动作对成功与失败轨迹的似然差距变化，提供对齐信号，并引入技能编辑支持正则化以保持探索性。实验表明，UniSkill在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别达到98.4%和84.7%的成功率，且训练稳定，即使使用较小的模型骨干也表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在联合优化任务执行与技能提取时，因奖励技能复用而混淆技能价值与演员改进，且直接测试技能需昂贵的额外滚动，导致效率低下。需要一种无需额外滚动、能准确评估技能提议的方法。

Method: 采用共享策略同时完成环境交互与技能库修改（添加、更新或无操作）；利用对比动作反馈作为对齐信号，通过比较替换技能前后演员在成功与失败轨迹上的动作对数似然差距来指导技能提议学习；引入技能编辑支持正则化以防止因提议质量差而抑制合理编辑操作。

Result: 在ALFWorld上取得98.4%的成功率，在WebShop上达到84.7%的成功率，训练过程稳定；即使使用较小的模型骨干，仍保持高效性能。

Conclusion: UniSkill通过共享策略与对比反馈机制，在无需额外滚动的前提下实现了高效的技能提取与任务执行协同优化，具备良好的泛化性和稳定性，为大规模语言模型代理的持续学习提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Large language model agents can improve across tasks by retaining reusable skills distilled from prior interactions. Recent work jointly optimizes task execution and skill extraction, enabling the policy and skillbank to co-evolve. However, as the actor continues learning, rewarding skill proposals through their reuse in subsequent training steps may conflate skill benefits with actor improvement, while directly testing each proposed skill requires costly additional actor rollouts. In this paper, we introduce UniSkill, which uses a shared policy to interact with the environment and propose skillbank edits (Add, Update, or No Edit) from the resulting trajectories. Specifically, the actor learns from environment rewards, while contrastive action feedback guides skill proposal learning. This feedback provides an actor-alignment signal by measuring how replacing the retrieved skill with a proposed skill changes the current actor's action log-likelihood gap between previously collected successful and failed trajectories from the same task, thereby avoiding new rollouts for each proposal. Since proposal-level feedback may suppress an otherwise appropriate edit operation when the proposed skill content scores poorly, we further apply skill-edit support regularization to preserve exploration. Empirically, UniSkill achieves strong performance, reaching 98.4% success on ALFWorld and 84.7% on WebShop while maintaining stable joint training. Further ALFWorld experiments show that UniSkill remains effective when the shared policy uses a smaller backbone. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/LimOkii/UniSKill.

</details>


### [316] [Reasoning-Token Spikes Under Prompted Untruthful Responding in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10405)
*Maverick Morales,Tomáš Dominik,Vermut Gao,Katrina Shirey,Paulius Rimkevičius,Aaron Schurger,Uri Maoz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了在大语言模型中，通过分析推理过程中生成的推理标记数量（reasoning token count）来检测谎言或不当行为的可能性。基于认知负荷理论，研究发现，在要求模型说真话时，其生成的推理标记数少于说谎或不关心真相的情况。该信号无需访问推理内容，具有内容无关性，可作为在无法获取原始推理轨迹时的一种简单、低带宽的探测信号，证明了其在群体层面区分诚实与不诚实行为的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对大语言模型的链式思维监控依赖于推理过程的可读性和忠实性，但现有证据表明这些推理输出可能变得不可读或不可靠。因此需要寻找一种不依赖于推理内容、且更稳健的替代信号。

Method: 基于认知负荷理论，选取三个具备推理能力的大语言模型，在不同任务类型（分析型、描述型、规范型）和领域（道德与非道德）下，让模型在系统提示下以诚实、说谎或无视真实性的策略回答210道多选题，并统计其生成的推理标记数量。

Result: 所有三个模型均显示：在诚实回应条件下，生成的推理标记数量显著低于说谎或不关心真相的条件。这表明，明确诱导的虚假回应策略会引发可测量的推理标记使用差异。

Conclusion: 推理标记数量可作为一种简单、内容无关的候选信号，用于在缺乏可靠推理轨迹的情况下区分模型的诚实与不诚实行为。尽管尚不能用于检测自发性欺骗或普遍性偏差，但本研究为未来探索提供了初步证据，建议后续研究检验个体实例检测率、跨分布泛化能力、学习到的欺骗策略等。

Abstract: Monitoring the chain-of-thought of reasoning artificial intelligence (AI) models remains a key approach to detecting deception and other forms of misbehavior in such models. However, semantic chain-of-thought monitoring depends on reasoning traces being legible and sufficiently faithful to the underlying computations that produced the model's behavior, not to mention accessible. Moreover, there is increasing evidence that chain-of-thought outputs may soon become illegible or unfaithful, if they even remain accessible. Based on cognitive load theory, we investigate a lower-bandwidth signal -- the number of reasoning tokens generated -- which does not require access to the content of the reasoning trace. Three reasoning-capable large language models answered 210 multiple-choice questions -- across analytic, descriptive, and normative reasoning types as well as moral and non-moral domains -- under system prompts instructing them to respond truthfully, falsely, or without regard for truth. Across all three models, truth-directed responding elicited fewer reasoning tokens than both lie-directed and truth-indifferent responding. These findings show that explicitly prompted untruthful response policies can produce robust group-level differences in test-time reasoning-token use. While not yet establishing reasoning-token count as a detector of spontaneous deception or general misalignment, our results are a proof of concept that it can serve as a simple, content-independent candidate signal for differentiating untruthful from truthful model behavior when raw reasoning traces are unavailable or unreliable. Future work should test instance-level detection rates, out-of-distribution generalization, learned deceptive policies, hidden objectives, and robustness under adversarial pressure.

</details>


### [317] [Agentic AI-Assisted Modeling for Production Scheduling: Assessment in Constraint Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10184)
*Ángel Sánchez-Fernández,Javier Pernas-Álvarez,Diego Crespo-Pereira*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了通用大语言模型（LLM）在无需特定任务训练的情况下，能否通过代理架构从自然语言描述中自动构建并实现约束编程模型。通过单代理与多代理架构结合上下文感知的模型上下文协议服务器，有效减少实现过程中的幻觉问题。实验在六个工业导向问题上评估了三种LLM的表现，结果显示建模已基本可行，但实现仍是主要挑战。多代理工作流将正确运行脚本的比例从直接调用LLM的14.8%提升至59.3%，在较简单问题上达到80.6%，而复杂物流模型仍具挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前生产调度优化建模需大量专家投入，现有LLM研究或依赖专用训练/架构（限制工业应用），或假设已有优化模型（不解决建模问题）。亟需一种无需专门训练、能从自然语言自动生成并实现优化模型的方法，以推动工业落地。

Method: 采用单代理与多代理架构，结合模型上下文协议服务器（提供求解器文档的上下文感知检索），使LLM在无任务特定训练下完成从自然语言到约束编程模型的构建与实现。通过六类工业问题（包括流水车间、作业车间、柔性作业车间及资源受限仓库调度）进行测试，评估建模准确率、执行成功率、延迟和令牌消耗。

Result: 建模能力已基本可达，但实现仍是主要瓶颈。多代理流程将正确运行脚本比例从14.8%（直接调用LLM）提升至59.3%，在四类较简单问题上达80.6%；复杂内部物流模型仍难以处理。

Conclusion: 通用大语言模型在代理架构支持下，可有效完成复杂调度问题的建模与部分实现，尤其在多代理协作与上下文增强下表现显著提升。未来需进一步优化复杂系统建模能力，推动其在工业场景中的广泛应用。

Abstract: Developing optimization models for production scheduling requires substantial expert effort. Research on large language models (LLMs) has followed two directions: specialized approaches for automated modeling, mostly for mixed-integer linear programming, which often rely on dedicated training or problem-specific architectures that limit industrial deployment; and agentic artificial intelligence for operational decision support, which generally assumes that the optimization model already exists. This study bridges both directions by assessing whether general-purpose LLMs, orchestrated as agents without task-specific training, can formulate and implement constraint programming models from natural-language problem descriptions. Singleagent and multi-agent architectures are integrated with a Model Context Protocol server that provides context-aware retrieval of solver documentation to mitigate hallucinations during implementation. Both are compared with a direct LLM baseline on six industry-oriented problems covering flow-shop, job-shop, flexible job-shop and resource-constrained warehouse scheduling, using three LLMs and assessing modeling accuracy, execution success, latency and token consumption. Formulation proves largely within reach of current LLMs, whereas implementation is the main barrier. The multi-agent workflow raises the share of scripts that run correctly as generated from 14.8% with a direct LLM call to 59.3%, reaching 80.6% on the four less complex problems, while tightly coupled intralogistics models remain an open challenge.

</details>


### [318] [OOM-RL II: Reality Is an Oracle, Not a Debugger Provenance-Constrained Diagnosis in Continually Evolving Agent-Engineered Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10256)
*Kun Liu,Liqun Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨了在生产机器学习系统中，结果证据与过程解释之间的差距问题。研究以一个由人类指导、代理驱动的量化交易系统为例，使用‘oracle’作为外部结果来源而非完整正确性规范。尽管账户在一年内表现优于市场指数，但其年度阿尔法在主要回溯分析下不显著区别于零。回溯选择的子周期显示相对表现不佳及候选策略层面的弱化。工程记录显示期间存在代码、配置和工件的变化，且推荐与运行时的绑定关系不完整。数据存档无法确立统一的冻结实例或唯一因果原因。因此提出‘结果-诊断差距’概念：结果证据、评估对象身份和因果解释支持不同主张。文章区分了冻结实例、预设自适应流程与临时开发；构建了基于存档的主张可识别性框架和证据层级；并提出一种前瞻性生产绑定协议。通过一个兼容历史的例子说明，事实绑定可在不提供反事实效果的情况下确定推荐的指称。该协议为建议而非经过前瞻性验证。外部反馈约束结果主张，而溯源信息和额外标识结构决定诊断的解决方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在生产级机器学习系统中，外部反馈积累的同时，代码、配置和工件持续变化，导致难以确定某个结果是由哪个具体过程产生的，也难以解释其原因。这种‘结果-诊断差距’影响系统可信度和可解释性，尤其在金融等高风险领域尤为重要。本文旨在揭示这一问题，并推动建立更严谨的追溯与绑定机制。

Method: 采用真实世界中的量化交易系统作为案例，利用外部反馈（oracle）作为结果依据，进行回溯分析。通过分析一年内的绩效表现、子周期表现以及工程变更记录，识别出结果与过程之间的脱节现象。引入‘冻结实例’、‘预设自适应流程’和‘临时开发’三类模式，构建基于存档的主张可识别性框架与证据层级，并提出一种前瞻性生产绑定协议。

Result: 研究发现，尽管系统整体表现优于市场指数，但其超额收益（阿尔法）在统计上不显著。回溯分析揭示多个不利子周期及候选策略层面的薄弱点。工程记录表明系统在运行过程中存在大量未被记录的变更，且推荐与实际执行之间缺乏完整绑定。数据存档无法锁定单一因果解释，凸显‘结果-诊断差距’的存在。提出的协议虽未经过前瞻性验证，但展示了在特定情境下如何通过事实绑定确定推荐的指称。

Conclusion: 外部反馈只能约束结果主张，而诊断的准确性依赖于系统的溯源信息与标识结构。必须建立明确的生产绑定机制，以弥合结果与解释之间的差距。本文提出的协议为未来系统设计提供了方向，强调在生产环境中应确保推荐与执行间的可追溯性和一致性。

Abstract: Reality may establish that an outcome occurred without identifying which evolving procedure produced it or why. This distinction matters in production ML systems whose code, configuration, and artifacts change while external feedback accumulates. We examine it in a human-directed, agent-engineered quantitative trading system, using oracle to mean an external source of realized outcomes rather than a complete correctness specification. Across one year, the account gained and outperformed a broad market index, while annual alpha was not statistically distinguishable from zero under the main retrospective specification. Retrospectively selected subperiods include adverse relative performance and conditional candidate-level weakness under declared approximate references. Engineering records document changes during the episode, and complete recommendation-to-runtime binding is unavailable. The archive does not establish a common frozen instance or a unique cause. The case motivates an outcome--diagnosis gap: outcome evidence, evaluated-object identity, and causal explanation support distinct claims. We distinguish frozen instances, pre-specified adaptive procedures, and ad-hoc development; organize archive-relative claim identifiability and an evidence hierarchy; and propose a prospective production-binding protocol. An illustrative compatible-history example shows how factual binding can resolve a recommendation's referent without supplying its counterfactual effect.
